signals.title: Anthropic Compliance API extends enterprise audit visibility to local Cowork and Claude Code sessions
signals.title_zh: Anthropic Compliance API 将企业审计可见性扩展到本地 Cowork 与 Claude Code 会话
signals.summary: Claude Enterprise can list local sessions, retrieve session metadata, and retrieve transcripts for Cowork and Claude Code activity running on users' machines through Compliance API endpoints guarded by the existing compliance access key and read:compliance_user_data scope.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Enterprise 可通过 Compliance API 枚举用户机器上的本地 Cowork / Claude Code 会话、读取会话元数据与转录，并继续使用既有 Compliance Access Key 与 read:compliance_user_data 权限域。

signals.title: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains adds cross-session memory with enterprise-managed agent controls
signals.title_zh: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains 增加跨会话记忆与企业级 Agent 管理控制
signals.summary: The JetBrains release adds persistent Copilot memory across agent chat sessions while exposing organization-level controls for plugin availability, MCP access, permission bypass behavior, and OpenTelemetry settings.
signals.summary_zh: JetBrains 版本增加跨 Agent Chat 会话的持久 Copilot Memory，并提供插件可用性、MCP 访问、权限绕过行为与 OpenTelemetry 的组织级控制。

signals.title: GitHub Copilot usage reports expose per-model token and cache-cost composition
signals.title_zh: GitHub Copilot 使用报告公开每模型 Token 与缓存成本构成
signals.summary: AI usage reports now break each model's credit consumption into input, output, cache-read, and cache-write tokens, strengthening cost attribution for governed agent workloads.
signals.summary_zh: AI 使用报告现在按模型拆分输入、输出、缓存读取与缓存写入 Token，并对应 AI Credit 消耗，增强受治理 Agent 工作负载的成本归因。

signals.title: Codex changes queued-user-message admission to resolve at Core acceptance
signals.title_zh: Codex 将排队用户消息的接纳时点改为 Core 接受时
signals.summary: Queued input is now considered admitted when Core accepts it as a new turn or steer, rather than after rollout persistence; the queue entry is deleted at acceptance even if a later prompt hook stops the turn.
signals.summary_zh: 排队输入现在在 Core 接受为新 Turn 或 Steer 时即视为已接纳，而不是等 Rollout 持久化；即使后续 Prompt Hook 停止 Turn，队列项也在接纳时删除。

signals.title: Codex MCP OAuth registration prefers CIMD with validated DCR fallback
signals.title_zh: Codex MCP OAuth 注册优先使用 CIMD，并保留经校验的 DCR 回退
signals.summary: Automatic MCP OAuth registration can select Client ID Metadata Documents for native-loopback public clients, fall back to advertised DCR, and validates CIMD metadata and callback URLs before authorization.
signals.summary_zh: MCP OAuth 自动注册可为原生 Loopback 公共客户端选择 Client ID Metadata Documents，并回退到服务端声明的 DCR；授权前会校验 CIMD 元数据和回调 URL。

signals.title: Codex unifies MCP tool approvals under ReviewDecision with persistent policy amendments
signals.title_zh: Codex 将 MCP 工具审批统一到 ReviewDecision，并支持持久策略修订
signals.summary: MCP approval responses now use the shared ReviewDecision contract, including a persistent ApprovedMcpPolicyAmendment while preserving session approvals, rejection reasons, timeouts, and cancellations and rejecting MCP-only decisions in non-MCP approval paths.
signals.summary_zh: MCP 审批响应统一使用 ReviewDecision，并新增可跨会话持久的 ApprovedMcpPolicyAmendment；同时保留会话审批、拒绝原因、超时与取消，并阻止 MCP 专用决策进入非 MCP 审批路径。

signals.title: Codex gRPC code-mode callbacks gain explicit ownership, cancellation, limits, and concurrent-session isolation
signals.title_zh: Codex gRPC Code Mode 回调增加显式所有权、取消、限额与并发会话隔离
signals.summary: Nested tool and notification callbacks are forwarded to session delegates with bounded results/errors, explicit callback ownership and cancellation, validation of cell ownership and enabled tools, and non-serialized independent sessions.
signals.summary_zh: 嵌套工具与通知回调现在转发给 Session Delegate，并具有结果/错误上限、显式回调所有权与取消、Cell 所有权和启用工具校验，同时保持独立会话不被串行化。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK deterministically closes model streams on terminal streamed-turn failures
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 在流式 Turn 终止失败时确定性关闭模型流
signals.summary: The runner now explicitly aclose()s streaming generator chains when terminal events raise out of the loop, preventing cleanup from waiting on garbage collection and ensuring a failed run releases shared websocket request locks for waiting runs.
signals.summary_zh: Runner 在终止事件导致流式循环抛错时显式 aclose() 生成器链，避免清理依赖垃圾回收，并确保失败 Run 释放共享 WebSocket 请求锁，使等待中的 Run 能继续。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK isolates MCP manager lifecycle results from manager-owned active state
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 将 MCP Manager 生命周期返回值与 Manager 自有活动状态隔离
signals.summary: connect_all() and reconnect() now return copied active-server lists, so callers mutating a lifecycle result cannot mutate MCPServerManager's internal active-server state; regression tests enforce this ownership boundary.
signals.summary_zh: connect_all() 与 reconnect() 现在返回活动服务器列表副本，调用方修改生命周期返回值不会再修改 MCPServerManager 内部活动状态；回归测试固定了这一所有权边界。

signals.title: Claude Code 2.1.228 fixes background-task handoff that could prematurely end self-hosted sessions
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.228 修复后台任务交接导致自托管会话提前结束的问题
signals.summary: The release fixes self-hosted runners ending a session in the gap between a background task finishing and the follow-up turn starting, a direct long-running-work continuity boundary; the same release also hardens synced skill execution boundaries.
signals.summary_zh: 该版本修复 Self-hosted Runner 在后台任务结束与后续 Turn 启动之间的间隙提前终止会话的问题，直接涉及长任务连续性边界；同版还强化了同步 Skill 的执行边界。

signals.title: Google ADK fixes sync streaming completion that raised RuntimeError after the final chunk
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 修复同步流在最后一个 Chunk 后错误抛出 RuntimeError 的完成语义
signals.summary: The stream_reasoning_engine adapter now uses a sentinel rather than allowing StopIteration to cross an await boundary, so synchronous generators terminate cleanly instead of logging RuntimeError after every completed stream.
signals.summary_zh: stream_reasoning_engine 适配器改用 Sentinel，避免 StopIteration 穿越 await 边界，使同步生成器在最终 Chunk 后干净结束，而不是每次完成流都记录 RuntimeError。

signals.title: GitHub resolved a run-date disruption affecting login and release-asset downloads
signals.title_zh: GitHub 解决了运行日内影响登录与 Release Asset 下载的服务中断
signals.summary: GitHub Status recorded a disruption beginning at 21:39 UTC on August 12 (05:39 Asia/Shanghai on August 13) affecting login and release-asset downloads; GitHub identified the root cause, mitigated the errors, and marked the incident resolved at 22:56 UTC.
signals.summary_zh: GitHub Status 记录了一次始于 8 月 12 日 21:39 UTC（上海时间 8 月 13 日 05:39）的服务中断，影响登录与 Release Asset 下载；GitHub 随后识别根因、实施缓解，并于 22:56 UTC 标记为已解决。

signals.title: Codex unifies turn input admission into atomic start-or-steer routing
signals.title_zh: Codex 将 Turn 输入接纳统一为原子化 Start-or-Steer 路由
signals.summary: Codex introduced a typed TurnInputRequest path that atomically starts a turn, steers an active turn, or declines input with a specific reason; app-server turn/start can steer an active regular turn and incompatible schemas or non-steerable states are rejected without applying settings or enqueuing input.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 引入类型化 TurnInputRequest 路径，以原子方式启动 Turn、Steer 活动 Turn，或带明确原因拒绝输入；app-server 的 turn/start 可 Steer 活动常规 Turn，而不兼容 Schema 或不可 Steer 状态会在不应用设置、不入队输入的情况下被拒绝。

signals.title: Codex extends plugin measurement to remote and background execution with bounded private sidecars
signals.title_zh: Codex 将插件度量扩展到远程与后台执行，并使用有界私有 Sidecar
signals.summary: A same-mechanism sequence of Codex changes keeps plugin measurement alive for background commands, finalizes late completions exactly once, and extends collection to remote executors using executor-native owner-private temporary directories, bounded streamed output, validation, and cleanup.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 一组同机制变更使插件度量在后台命令结束前持续有效，对晚到完成事件只收口一次，并扩展到远程执行器：使用执行器原生的仅所有者可访问临时目录、有界流式输出、校验与清理。

signals.title: Codex makes code-mode session recovery generation-aware after gRPC host restarts
signals.title_zh: Codex 在 gRPC Host 重启后实现具备 Generation 语义的 Code Mode 会话恢复
signals.summary: Codex now reopens cached code-mode sessions after a gRPC host stops, serializes concurrent reconnection attempts, scopes cell IDs to the new host generation, coordinates shutdown, and rejects stale wait or terminate requests.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 现在会在 gRPC Host 停止后重新打开缓存的 Code Mode 会话，串行化并发重连尝试，将 Cell ID 绑定到新的 Host Generation，协调关闭过程，并拒绝过期的 wait 或 terminate 请求。

signals.title: Codex adds constrained dynamic HTTP header helpers for local MCP servers
signals.title_zh: Codex 为本地 MCP Server 增加受约束的动态 HTTP Header Helper
signals.summary: Local streamable-HTTP MCP servers can obtain connection-scoped headers from a configured helper command; Codex constrains the mechanism with origin isolation, redirect blocking, reserved and duplicate-header rejection, execution/output limits, managed validation, and command redaction.
signals.summary_zh: 本地 Streamable HTTP MCP Server 可通过配置的 Helper Command 获取连接级 Header；Codex 同时施加 Origin 隔离、禁止重定向、保留/重复 Header 拒绝、执行与输出上限、Managed 校验以及命令脱敏。

signals.title: Claude Code 2.1.229 hardens remote and self-hosted execution paths
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.229 强化远程与自托管执行链路
signals.summary: Claude Code 2.1.229 adds resumable Remote Control documentation, server-supplied hooks for self-hosted runners and SSE keepalives for long thinking pauses, while also making missing Git credentials fail fast, requiring explicit Windows self-hosted base directories, tightening sandbox network parsing, and stopping dangerous git flags from auto-approval.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.229 增加 Remote Control 最近会话恢复说明、自托管 Runner 的服务端 Hook 与长思考间隔 SSE Keepalive；同时让缺失 Git 凭据快速失败、要求 Windows 自托管 Runner 显式指定 Base Directory、收紧 Sandbox 网络地址解析，并取消危险 Git Flag 的自动批准。

signals.title: Google ADK moves recalled memory into turn-scoped context to protect reusable cache identity
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 将召回记忆移入 Turn 级上下文以保护可复用 Cache Identity
signals.summary: ADK changed PreloadMemoryTool so recalled memory is inserted into the current request's trailing user-context batch rather than the system instruction, preventing one query's memory from destabilizing explicit-cache identity or persisting into reusable prefixes.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 修改 PreloadMemoryTool，将召回记忆放入当前请求末尾的 User Context Batch，而不是 System Instruction，从而避免某次查询的记忆破坏 Explicit Cache Identity 或滞留在可复用前缀中。

signals.title: Google ADK repairs HITL resume by restoring transfer-to-agent capability
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 通过恢复 Transfer-to-Agent 能力修复 HITL Resume
signals.summary: ADK fixed human-in-the-loop confirmation resume by injecting the transfer_to_agent tool when the resumed flow requires it, preserving the agent handoff capability across the pause/resume boundary.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 修复 Human-in-the-Loop 确认后的 Resume 流程：在恢复后的流程需要时注入 transfer_to_agent 工具，使 Agent Handoff 能力跨越暂停/恢复边界继续存在。

signals.title: Google ADK makes pre-metric agent crashes fail evaluations instead of yielding empty success
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 将指标执行前的 Agent Crash 视为评测失败而非空成功
signals.summary: ADK now fails an evaluation when an agent crashes before any metric runs, closing a correctness gap where infrastructure or agent failure could otherwise leave an evaluation without meaningful metric evidence.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 现在会在 Agent 于任何 Metric 执行前崩溃时直接判定 Evaluation 失败，关闭了基础设施或 Agent 故障可能留下‘无有效指标证据’的正确性缺口。

signals.title: Google ADK bounds Apigee completion HTTP timeouts and redirects
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 为 Apigee Completion HTTP 请求设置有界超时与重定向
signals.summary: ADK added explicit bounds to the Apigee completions HTTP client for request timeout and redirect behavior, reducing the chance that external inference transport can wait or follow redirects without a defined bound.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 为 Apigee Completions HTTP Client 增加明确的请求超时与重定向边界，降低外部推理传输在没有定义边界的情况下长时间等待或跟随重定向的风险。

2026-08-14.reason: All three Discovery pipelines reached terminal coverage for the run date. Discovery retained material same-day signals but performed no Queue triage.
2026-08-14.reason_zh: 运行日三条 Discovery 管线均完成终态覆盖。Discovery 仅保留当天重要信号，未执行 Queue 筛选。

pipelines.label: AI Platform Change Intelligence
pipelines.label_zh: AI 平台变更情报发现
pipelines.reason: All 45 due public P0 channels were inspected. No material same-day platform announcement or documentation change was retained independently after cross-pipeline normalization; repository-origin changes were represented once in GitHub Engineering where primary maintainer evidence was stronger.
pipelines.reason_zh: 45 个到期的公开 P0 渠道全部完成检查。跨管线规范化后，没有单独保留当天重要的平台公告或文档变更；源自仓库的变化统一在 GitHub Engineering 中以更强的一手维护者证据记录。

pipelines.label: GitHub Engineering Intelligence
pipelines.label_zh: GitHub 工程情报发现
pipelines.reason: All nine P0 daily repositories were inspected incrementally. Fourteen same-day maintainer changes were normalized into material engineering signals; repositories without a qualifying same-day change were recorded as checked with no retained signal.
pipelines.reason_zh: 9 个 P0 Daily 仓库全部完成增量检查。当天维护者变更经规范化后形成 14 个重要工程信号；没有符合条件当天变化的仓库记录为已检查但不保留信号。

pipelines.label: Published Research Intelligence
pipelines.label_zh: 论文与研究成果情报发现
pipelines.reason: All nine P0 research sources were queried. One same-day Zenodo primary research artifact met the configured enterprise-governance scope; other visible items were older, out of scope, or lacked sufficient same-day freshness to retain as signals.
pipelines.reason_zh: 9 个 P0 研究来源全部完成查询。1 个当天发布的 Zenodo 一手研究产物符合企业治理范围；其余可见内容发布时间更早、超出范围，或缺少足够的当天新鲜度，因此未保留为信号。

columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.reason: Discovery retained four primary Digital Employee signals. No Selection is a schema-compatible Discovery-stage marker only; Queue triage remains pending.
columns.reason_zh: Discovery 保留 4 个以数字员工为主栏目的信号。No Selection 仅作为符合 Schema 的 Discovery 阶段标记；Queue 筛选仍待执行。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.reason: Discovery retained two primary Industry Architecture signals. No Selection is a schema-compatible Discovery-stage marker only; Queue triage remains pending.
columns.reason_zh: Discovery 保留 2 个以行业架构为主栏目的信号。No Selection 仅作为符合 Schema 的 Discovery 阶段标记；Queue 筛选仍待执行。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.reason: Discovery retained nine primary Open-source Engineering signals. No Selection is a schema-compatible Discovery-stage marker only; Queue triage remains pending.
columns.reason_zh: Discovery 保留 9 个以开源工程为主栏目的信号。No Selection 仅作为符合 Schema 的 Discovery 阶段标记；Queue 筛选仍待执行。

signals.title: Codex app server adds persistent thread queue APIs with automatic FIFO dispatch
signals.title_zh: Codex App Server 新增持久 Thread Queue API 与自动 FIFO 派发
signals.summary: The app server adds persistent queued user submissions, CRUD/reorder/start operations, change notifications, stable IDs, and automatic FIFO dispatch after completed or failed turns while remaining paused after interruption.
signals.summary_zh: App Server 增加持久化用户提交队列、增删改排与启动操作、变更通知和稳定 ID，并在 Turn 完成或失败后自动 FIFO 派发；中断后保持暂停。

signals.title: Codex preserves thread subscriptions across revert reloads
signals.title_zh: Codex 在 Revert Reload 后保留 Thread Subscription
signals.summary: Thread listeners are restarted from preserved thread state after paginated reloads instead of depending on the requesting connection, protecting existing subscriptions when that connection closes.
signals.summary_zh: 分页重载后，Thread Listener 从保留的 Thread State 重启，而不再依赖发起请求的连接，从而在该连接关闭时仍保护既有订阅。

signals.title: Codex skill metadata now carries supported model annotations
signals.title_zh: Codex Skill Metadata 开始携带受支持的模型标注
signals.summary: Skill frontmatter parsing adds an optional model field, recognizes supported model values, and ignores unsupported values without preventing the remaining skill metadata from loading.
signals.summary_zh: Skill Frontmatter 解析新增可选 model 字段，识别受支持模型值，同时忽略不支持值而不阻塞其余 Skill Metadata 加载。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK redacts tool output values from output-type validation errors
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 从输出类型校验错误中隐藏工具输出值
signals.summary: Tool output values are no longer exposed in output-type validation errors, tightening failure-path data handling.
signals.summary_zh: 输出类型校验错误不再暴露工具输出值，强化失败路径中的数据处理边界。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK snapshots sandbox policy and proxy request state per operation
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 按操作快照 Sandbox Policy 与 Proxy 请求状态
signals.summary: A sandbox fix snapshots per-operation audit policies; an adjacent same-day maintainer fix also snapshots HTTP proxy headers, indicating explicit operation-scoped state capture for concurrent execution paths.
signals.summary_zh: Sandbox 修复按操作快照 Audit Policy；同日相邻维护者修复同时快照 HTTP Proxy Header，体现并发执行路径中显式的操作级状态捕获。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK fixes Codex resume argument ordering
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 修复 Codex Resume 参数顺序
signals.summary: The Codex integration now preserves resume argument ordering, a narrow but directly relevant recovery/resumption correctness fix.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 集成现在保留 Resume 参数顺序，是直接涉及恢复与续跑正确性的修复。

signals.title: Claude Code 2.1.232 makes subagent forking default and expands cross-session messaging
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.232 默认启用 Subagent Forking 并扩展跨 Session 消息
signals.summary: The release enables fork-style subagents by default, backgrounds non-teammate spawns in interactive sessions, adds named cross-session messaging, and exposes inbound message acceptance controls.
signals.summary_zh: 该版本默认启用 Fork 型 Subagent，交互会话中的非队友 Spawn 默认后台运行，并新增命名跨 Session 消息与入站消息接受控制。

signals.title: Claude Code 2.1.232 hardens permissions, repository trust, sandbox paths, and shared messaging sockets
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.232 强化权限、仓库信任、Sandbox 路径与共享消息 Socket
signals.summary: The release closes multiple permission and sandbox bypasses, requires trust per nested repository, protects cross-session messaging socket directories, and restricts sandbox binary overrides to higher-precedence settings.
signals.summary_zh: 该版本关闭多项权限与 Sandbox 绕过，要求嵌套仓库分别确认信任，保护跨 Session 消息 Socket 目录，并把 Sandbox 二进制覆盖限制在更高优先级设置层。

signals.title: Claude Code 2.1.232 strengthens Remote Control reattachment, restart recovery, and reconnect persistence
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.232 强化 Remote Control 重连、重启恢复与持续重试
signals.summary: Remote Control sessions reattach to existing sessions after local resume, restore conversation history after worker restarts, surface reachability correctly to new clients, and keep reconnecting for roughly 30 minutes after network loss.
signals.summary_zh: Remote Control 在本地 Resume 后重新附着既有 Session，在 Worker 重启后恢复会话历史，向新客户端正确暴露可达性，并在网络中断后持续重连约 30 分钟。

signals.title: Gemini CLI rolls back the entire multi-turn request on cancellation or abort
signals.title_zh: Gemini CLI 在取消或中止时回滚整个多 Turn 请求
signals.summary: Cancellation and abort handling now rolls back the entire multi-turn request rather than leaving partial request state behind.
signals.summary_zh: 取消与中止处理现在回滚整个多 Turn 请求，避免留下部分请求状态。

signals.title: Gemini CLI adds context-aware silent retries and availability TTL for capacity errors
signals.title_zh: Gemini CLI 为容量错误新增上下文感知静默重试与可用性 TTL
signals.summary: Capacity-error handling adds context-aware silent retries and a time-bounded availability cache, making retry behavior stateful and explicitly bounded.
signals.summary_zh: 容量错误处理新增上下文感知静默重试和有时限的可用性缓存，使重试行为具有状态且边界明确。

signals.title: Google ADK fixes systemic first-part assumptions in Gemini Live flows
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 修复 Gemini Live Flow 中系统性的首 Part 假设
signals.summary: Core Gemini Live connection and flow modules now scan all message parts instead of assuming the relevant content is always at parts[0].
signals.summary_zh: 核心 Gemini Live Connection 与 Flow 模块现在扫描全部消息 Part，不再假设相关内容始终位于 parts[0]。

signals.title: Google ADK resolves nested providers behind litellm_proxy prefixes
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 正确解析 litellm_proxy 前缀后的嵌套 Provider
signals.summary: Provider resolution now recognizes nested providers behind litellm_proxy prefixes so provider-specific behavior such as Azure file upload handling is not skipped.
signals.summary_zh: Provider 解析现在识别 litellm_proxy 前缀后的嵌套 Provider，避免 Azure 文件上传等 Provider 特定行为被跳过。

signals.title: Google ADK preserves developer instructions when invocation event history is empty
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 在 Invocation Event 为空时仍保留 Developer Instructions
signals.summary: Prompt assembly now populates developer instructions even when invocation_events is empty, closing an initialization-state gap in instruction propagation.
signals.summary_zh: Prompt Assembly 在 invocation_events 为空时仍填充 Developer Instructions，修复初始化状态中的指令传播缺口。

signals.title: DPX-G360 proposes an accountable-AI governance architecture for airline digital operations
signals.title_zh: DPX-G360 提出面向航空数字运营的可问责 AI 治理架构
signals.summary: The same-day Zenodo artifact presents a design-science architecture combining accountable AI, trusted data, integrated enterprise systems, KPI governance, and operational resilience across airline front-stage and back-stage functions.
signals.summary_zh: 该当天 Zenodo 研究产物提出设计科学架构，把可问责 AI、可信数据、企业系统集成、KPI 治理与运营韧性连接到航空前台与后台职能。

2026-08-15.reason: Discovery completed all three configured intelligence pipelines for the run date, resolved every due P0 source, and retained 13 normalized same-day GitHub engineering signals. Topic selection remains exclusively owned by Queue, so all three column decisions remain Waiting.
2026-08-15.reason_zh: Discovery 已完成运行日三条配置情报管线，解析全部到期 P0 来源，并保留 13 个规范化的同日 GitHub 工程信号。选题仍完全由 Queue 负责，因此三个栏目决定均保持 Waiting。

pipelines.label_zh: AI 平台变化情报

pipelines.reason_zh: 已检查全部 45 个配置的公开 P0 平台渠道，并以当前权威页面为准核验。经机制规范化与同日过滤后，没有保留 2026-08-15 的重要平台机制变化。

pipelines.label_zh: GitHub 工程情报

pipelines.reason_zh: 已检查全部 9 个 P0 每日仓库。同日重要维护者变更经规范化后形成 13 个未选题信号；同一底层机制的相关提交已合并去重。

pipelines.label: Published Research Intelligence
pipelines.label_zh: 已发表研究情报
pipelines.reason: All nine configured P0 research sources were checked. No material same-day research object meeting the configured evidence and topic rules was retained.
pipelines.reason_zh: 已检查全部 9 个配置的 P0 研究来源。没有保留符合配置证据与主题规则的重要同日研究对象。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.reason: Discovery recorded two primary-column signals; Queue must independently score and decide selection.
columns.reason_zh: Discovery 记录 2 个以该栏目为主栏目的信号；后续必须由 Queue 独立评分并决定是否选题。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.reason: Discovery recorded seven primary-column signals; Queue must independently score and decide selection.
columns.reason_zh: Discovery 记录 7 个以该栏目为主栏目的信号；后续必须由 Queue 独立评分并决定是否选题。

signals.title: Codex preserves per-environment permission and configuration ownership
signals.title_zh: Codex 保留每个环境的权限与配置所有权
signals.summary: Codex now retains whether an environment attachment inherits thread configuration or owns its own configuration, while honoring per-environment permission profiles across updates and child-thread snapshots.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 现在会保留环境附件是继承线程配置还是拥有自身配置，并在后续更新与子线程快照中继续遵守每个环境独立的权限配置。

signals.title: Codex forwards executor network policy decisions for audit
signals.title_zh: Codex 将执行器网络策略决定转发用于审计
signals.summary: Executor-local proxy decisions are forwarded as best-effort policy notifications, validated against the active process, and converted into audit events with controller-trusted execution metadata.
signals.summary_zh: 执行器本地代理的策略决定会以尽力而为的策略通知转发，并对照活动进程核验，随后以控制器可信的执行元数据写入审计事件。

signals.title: Codex adds MCP protocol discovery observability
signals.title_zh: Codex 增加 MCP 协议发现可观测性
signals.summary: Codex records counters and durations for MCP client protocol discovery and classifies outcomes as modern, legacy, or failure under the configured negotiation mode.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 为 MCP 客户端协议发现记录计数与耗时，并按照配置的协商模式将结果分类为现代协议、旧协议或失败。

signals.title: Codex sources multi-agent role instructions from the model catalog
signals.title_zh: Codex 从模型目录提供多 Agent 角色指令
signals.summary: Root and subagent role instructions, delegation guidance, and model-specific refresh behavior are now supplied through the model catalog with explicit fallback precedence.
signals.summary_zh: 根 Agent 与子 Agent 的角色指令、委派指导以及模型切换后的刷新行为现在由模型目录提供，并具有明确的回退优先级。

signals.title: Codex makes Guardian v2 risk classification policy-driven and configurable
signals.title_zh: Codex 将 Guardian v2 风险分类改为策略驱动且可配置
signals.summary: Guardian v2 risk classification can now resolve security policy and configurable classifier thresholds, reasoning effort, token budgets, and transcript controls instead of relying on one fixed review configuration.
signals.summary_zh: Guardian v2 风险分类现在可以解析安全策略，并配置分类阈值、推理强度、Token 预算与上下文记录控制，而不再依赖单一固定评审配置。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK sandbox honors view_image path grants
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 沙箱遵守 view_image 路径授权
signals.summary: The sandbox path policy now honors extra path grants used by view_image operations, tightening consistency between declared tool permissions and filesystem access.
signals.summary_zh: 沙箱路径策略现在会遵守 view_image 操作使用的额外路径授权，使工具声明权限与文件系统访问之间更加一致。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK stops exposing the mutable MCP tools cache to callers
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 不再向调用方暴露可变 MCP 工具缓存
signals.summary: MCP tool-cache ownership is hardened so callers no longer receive the internal cache object directly, reducing accidental shared-state mutation across tool discovery consumers.
signals.summary_zh: MCP 工具缓存的所有权得到收紧，调用方不再直接获得内部缓存对象，从而减少工具发现消费者之间意外修改共享状态的风险。

signals.title: Google ADK adds native A2A task-mode execution
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 增加原生 A2A Task 模式执行
signals.summary: RemoteA2aAgent can execute in native task mode, including finish-task registration, delegation-scope aggregation, and terminal-state mapping in the A2A executor.
signals.summary_zh: RemoteA2aAgent 可以使用原生 Task 模式执行，包括注册 finish-task 工具、聚合委派任务作用域以及在 A2A 执行器中映射终态。

signals.title: Google ADK cancels background tool tasks when a live agent run ends
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 在 Live Agent 运行结束时取消后台工具任务
signals.summary: Live-agent runs now own and cancel streaming or non-blocking background tool tasks during handoff or teardown, and release stale stream registry entries instead of allowing orphaned tasks to continue.
signals.summary_zh: Live Agent 运行现在会在交接或结束时负责取消流式或非阻塞后台工具任务，并释放陈旧的流注册项，避免孤儿任务继续运行。

signals.title: Google ADK validates session initialization events and tightens HITL resumption
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 校验会话初始化事件并收紧 HITL 恢复
signals.summary: ADK prevents client-supplied session initialization events from seeding runtime state and tightens confirmation handling when resuming human-in-the-loop execution.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 阻止客户端提供的会话初始化事件直接注入运行时状态，并在恢复人在回路执行时收紧确认处理。

signals.title: Google ADK propagates the caller RunConfig into AgentTool execution
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 将调用方 RunConfig 传播到 AgentTool 执行
signals.summary: AgentTool execution now runs under the caller's RunConfig so execution settings remain attached across the agent-as-tool boundary.
signals.summary_zh: AgentTool 现在会在调用方的 RunConfig 下执行，使执行设置能够跨越“Agent 作为工具”的边界继续生效。

signals.title: Google ADK adds memory identity and topic restrictions to Vertex Memory Bank
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 为 Vertex Memory Bank 增加记忆身份与主题限制
signals.summary: Vertex Memory Bank integration adds memory_id and allowed_topics controls, making memory selection and topical scope explicit runtime inputs.
signals.summary_zh: Vertex Memory Bank 集成新增 memory_id 与 allowed_topics 控制，使记忆选择和主题作用域成为显式运行时输入。

signals.title: Google ADK includes grounding metadata in rubric judging
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 在量表评判中纳入 Grounding 元数据
signals.summary: Rubric-judge prompts now include grounding metadata, expanding the evidence context available to automated evaluation rather than judging only the visible response content.
signals.summary_zh: 量表评判提示现在会包含 Grounding 元数据，使自动评估能够使用更完整的证据上下文，而不只是判断可见响应内容。

signals.title: Codex can stage host metadata before a reserved thread is materialized
signals.title_zh: Codex 可在线程实例化前为预留线程暂存宿主元数据
signals.summary: Codex adds reserved thread identities and lets the thread store stage host-owned metadata before Core starts the thread, merging that metadata on the first successful materialization and cleaning it up if the thread never materializes.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 增加预留线程身份，并允许线程存储在线程由 Core 启动前暂存宿主拥有的元数据；首次成功实例化时合并这些元数据，若线程未实例化则清理暂存状态。

signals.title: Codex keeps active-turn model and approval settings stable until the next turn
signals.title_zh: Codex 将活动轮次的模型与审批设置冻结到下一轮再更新
signals.summary: Codex snapshots model, reasoning, service-tier, approval and model-attributed telemetry settings into step context so a thread update cannot change execution semantics partway through an active turn; updates take effect on the next turn.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 将模型、推理、服务层级、审批以及模型归属遥测设置快照到 Step Context，避免线程设置更新在活动轮次中途改变执行语义；新设置从下一轮开始生效。

signals.title: Codex separates executor policy audit telemetry from persistent state logs
signals.title_zh: Codex 将执行器策略审计遥测与持久状态日志分离
signals.summary: Forwarded network-policy decisions now use a log-only OpenTelemetry target, preserving exportable audit evidence while keeping those events out of the persistent runtime state log.
signals.summary_zh: 转发的网络策略决定现在进入仅日志的 OpenTelemetry 目标，在保留可导出的审计证据同时，不再把这类事件写入持久运行状态日志。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK isolates sandbox working directories per run
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 按运行隔离沙箱工作目录
signals.summary: The Agents SDK adds run-scoped sandbox working directories, tightening filesystem isolation between independent agent runs rather than relying on one shared sandbox working location.
signals.summary_zh: Agents SDK 增加按运行范围划分的沙箱工作目录，加强不同 Agent 运行之间的文件系统隔离，而不是依赖同一个共享沙箱工作位置。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK preserves exact tool-call approval decisions
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 精确保留工具调用审批决定
signals.summary: The Agents SDK fixes approval handling so the exact decision attached to a tool call is honored, strengthening the link between human or policy authorization and the concrete action that is executed.
signals.summary_zh: Agents SDK 修复审批处理，使绑定到具体工具调用的精确审批决定得到遵守，加强人工或策略授权与实际执行动作之间的对应关系。

signals.title: Google ADK bounds in-memory retrieval to the ten most relevant events
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 将内存检索限制为相关性最高的十个事件
signals.summary: ADK now ranks in-memory search results by distinct query-word overlap and returns only the ten best events, preventing broad low-relevance retrieval from flooding each model call through preload_memory.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 现在按不同查询词的匹配数量排序内存检索结果，并只返回最佳十个事件，避免低相关的大量历史内容通过 preload_memory 灌入每次模型调用。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK closes all MultiProvider children after failures
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 在失败后关闭全部 MultiProvider 子提供者
signals.summary: The Agents SDK changes MultiProvider failure cleanup so all child providers are closed after failures, reducing leaked lifecycle state and improving failure containment across provider fan-out.
signals.summary_zh: Agents SDK 调整 MultiProvider 的失败清理逻辑，在失败后关闭全部子 Provider，减少生命周期状态泄漏，并改善 Provider 扇出场景的故障隔离。

signals.title: Codex TypeScript SDK adds ordered raw configuration overrides
signals.title_zh: Codex TypeScript SDK 增加有序原始配置覆盖
signals.summary: The TypeScript SDK can now pass ordered raw CLI configuration overrides for TOML structures such as permission maps with literal path keys, while retaining explicit precedence with SDK-managed and thread-specific settings.
signals.summary_zh: TypeScript SDK 现在可以为包含字面路径键的权限映射等 TOML 结构传递有序的原始 CLI 配置覆盖，同时保持与 SDK 管理设置和线程级设置之间的明确优先级。

signals.title: Codex adds a protocol-safe health endpoint to its code-mode gRPC listener
signals.title_zh: Codex 为 code-mode gRPC 监听器增加协议安全的健康检查端点
signals.summary: The code-mode listener now serves GET /healthz over HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 while continuing to require HTTP/2 for all other requests, adding operational health probing without exposing gRPC methods through HTTP/1.1.
signals.summary_zh: code-mode 监听器现在可通过 HTTP/1.1 和 HTTP/2 提供 GET /healthz，同时其他请求仍强制使用 HTTP/2，从而增加运维健康探测但不把 gRPC 方法暴露给 HTTP/1.1。

signals.title: Codex doctor adds workspace storage and Windows Dev Drive diagnostics
signals.title_zh: Codex doctor 增加工作区存储与 Windows Dev Drive 诊断
signals.summary: codex doctor now checks free space for CODEX_HOME and the active worktree, applies warning/failure thresholds, and on Windows reports whether the active worktree is on a trusted Dev Drive with remediation guidance.
signals.summary_zh: codex doctor 现在检查 CODEX_HOME 与活动工作树的可用空间并应用警告/失败阈值；在 Windows 上还会报告工作树是否位于受信任的 Dev Drive，并给出修复提示。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK normalizes apply_patch paths to POSIX form
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 将 apply_patch 路径规范化为 POSIX 形式
signals.summary: The Agents SDK normalizes apply_patch paths to POSIX form inside the sandbox path model, reducing cross-platform path ambiguity in agent-generated patches.
signals.summary_zh: Agents SDK 在沙箱路径模型中将 apply_patch 路径规范化为 POSIX 形式，降低 Agent 生成补丁时的跨平台路径歧义。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK improves reasoning replay for Chat Completions
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 改进 Chat Completions 的推理重放
signals.summary: The Agents SDK fixes reasoning replay behavior on the Chat Completions path, improving continuity when prior reasoning-associated state must be reconstructed across calls.
signals.summary_zh: Agents SDK 修复 Chat Completions 路径上的推理重放行为，提高在跨调用重建先前推理相关状态时的连续性。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK includes compaction usage in run-level accounting
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 将压缩用量计入运行级统计
signals.summary: Session compaction usage is now included in run-level usage totals, making runtime cost and token accounting more complete for long-running agent sessions that compact context.
signals.summary_zh: 会话压缩产生的用量现在计入运行级用量总计，使需要压缩上下文的长时 Agent 会话在成本与 Token 统计上更加完整。

signals.title: Codex rejects obsolete permission-profile fields instead of silently ignoring requested policy
signals.title_zh: Codex 拒绝过时权限字段，避免请求的权限策略被静默忽略
signals.summary: App-server request handling now rejects the removed permissionProfile field on thread/start, thread/resume, thread/fork and turn/start instead of allowing deserialization to ignore it, preventing a caller from believing a permission request took effect when it did not.
signals.summary_zh: App Server 现在会在 thread/start、thread/resume、thread/fork 与 turn/start 上拒绝已移除的 permissionProfile 字段，而不是让反序列化静默忽略，从而避免调用方误以为权限请求已经生效。

signals.title: Codex preserves legacy project-root restrictions as workspace-root policy
signals.title_zh: Codex 将旧 project_roots 继续解释为 workspace_roots 权限策略
signals.summary: Codex parses legacy :project_roots entries as an alias for :workspace_roots, preserving deny rules and read-only carve-outs that could otherwise be dropped when older permission profiles are loaded.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 将旧版 :project_roots 解析为 :workspace_roots 的别名，保留拒绝规则与只读子路径例外，避免加载旧权限 Profile 时意外丢失文件系统限制。

signals.title: Codex applies shell-variable policy from the selected execution environment
signals.title_zh: Codex 按所选执行环境应用 Shell 变量策略
signals.summary: Resolved EnvironmentConfig now carries its ShellEnvironmentPolicy, and shell handlers filter inherited variables according to the selected turn environment while preserving that environment's explicit overrides.
signals.summary_zh: 解析后的 EnvironmentConfig 现在携带各自的 ShellEnvironmentPolicy；Shell 处理器按当前 Turn 选择的环境过滤继承变量，同时保留该环境的显式覆盖。

signals.title: Codex restores independent persisted thread timestamp maxima correctly
signals.title_zh: Codex 独立恢复持久化线程时间戳最大值
signals.summary: State initialization now loads updated_at_ms and recency_at_ms maxima with independent scalar subqueries so each counter is restored correctly even when the maxima belong to different threads, with a reopen regression test covering the case.
signals.summary_zh: 状态初始化现在通过独立标量子查询加载 updated_at_ms 与 recency_at_ms 最大值，因此即使两个最大值来自不同线程也能分别正确恢复，并增加了重开状态数据库的回归测试。

signals.title: Codex compacts successful command activity without discarding the full transcript
signals.title_zh: Codex 压缩成功命令活动展示但保留完整执行记录
signals.summary: The TUI groups consecutive successful agent and unified-exec startup commands into compact entries while preserving the full transcript, and flushes groups at failures, interaction boundaries and a bounded group size; replay follows the same rules.
signals.summary_zh: TUI 将连续成功的 Agent 与 unified-exec 启动命令聚合为紧凑条目，同时保留完整 Transcript；失败、交互边界以及达到有界分组大小时会刷新分组，历史重放也使用相同规则。

signals.title: Codex doctor classifies route-aware network failures into actionable diagnostics
signals.title_zh: Codex doctor 将路由感知网络故障分类为可操作诊断
signals.summary: codex doctor now probes the configured Responses inference endpoint through the route-aware client and classifies TLS, proxy authentication, proxy configuration, resolution and timeout failures while accounting for custom CA and provider-specific routing.
signals.summary_zh: codex doctor 现在通过路由感知客户端探测配置的 Responses 推理端点，并对 TLS、代理认证、代理配置、域名解析与超时故障分类，同时考虑自定义 CA 与 Provider 特定路由。

columns.reason_zh: Discovery 记录 2 个以该栏目为主栏目的有界执行与请求可观测性信号；后续必须由 Queue 独立评分并决定是否选题。

signals.title: Claude Code hardens pre-approval file and permission-preview trust boundaries
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 加固预审批文件访问与权限预览信任边界
signals.summary: Claude Code v2.1.234 rejects Windows NT-namespace paths across pre-approval file reads and related restore/include/upload paths, while permission previews are relayed only to channel servers admitted by the inbound trust gate and preserve decision-relevant commands, paths and destinations under redaction.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code v2.1.234 在预审批文件读取以及相关恢复、include、上传路径上拒绝 Windows NT-namespace 路径；权限预览仅转发给通过入站信任门禁的频道服务器，并确保脱敏不会遮蔽审批所需的命令、路径和目标信息。

signals.title: Claude Code preserves permission state across background subagents and TUI transitions
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 在后台子 Agent 与 TUI 切换中保持权限状态
signals.summary: The release fixes session-scoped permission answers, including denies, being dropped while answering background-subagent prompts, and prevents TUI restarts from silently losing launch-time tool restrictions when those restrictions cannot be carried over.
signals.summary_zh: 该版本修复了回答后台子 Agent 工具权限提示时丢失会话级权限答案（包括拒绝）的情况，并在 TUI 无法继承启动时工具限制时拒绝静默重启，避免权限状态被跨界丢失。

signals.title: Codex turns the shared agents overview into a background task control surface
signals.title_zh: Codex 将共享 Agents Overview 升级为后台任务控制面
signals.summary: Codex's shared agents overview can start, open, rename and stop root tasks while preserving draft input and pending server requests as users switch sessions, allowing running roots and their subagents to continue in the background.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 的共享 Agents Overview 现在可直接启动、打开、重命名和停止根任务，并在切换会话时保存草稿输入和待处理服务器请求，使运行中的根任务及其子 Agent 能继续后台执行。

signals.title: Codex durable thread queues wake idle sessions after cross-process writes
signals.title_zh: Codex 持久线程队列可在跨进程写入后唤醒空闲会话
signals.summary: Codex adds durable queue revisions and SQLite data-version checks so loaded idle threads can discover messages inserted or edited by another process, wake pending external work, and retry queues independently instead of letting one blocked queue stall others.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 为线程队列增加持久 Revision 与 SQLite data-version 检查，使已加载的空闲线程能够发现其他进程插入或编辑的消息、唤醒外部待办，并按线程独立重试，避免单个阻塞队列拖住其他任务。

signals.title: Codex surfaces approval and input requests into realtime conversations
signals.title_zh: Codex 将审批与输入请求显式映射到实时会话
signals.summary: Execution, permission and patch approvals plus user-input and elicitation requests are mirrored into active realtime conversations with serialized request details, making pending human decisions visible without silently consuming them.
signals.summary_zh: 执行、权限、补丁审批以及用户输入和 Elicitation 请求会携带序列化请求详情映射到活跃实时会话中，使待处理的人类决策显式可见，而不是被静默消费。

signals.title: Codex drops all Linux capabilities before sandboxed command execution
signals.title_zh: Codex 在 Linux 沙箱命令执行前清空全部 Capability
signals.summary: Both bubblewrap launch modes now pass --cap-drop ALL, and the inner sandbox stage verifies effective and permitted Linux capability sets are empty before executing the requested command, aborting otherwise.
signals.summary_zh: 两种 bubblewrap 启动模式现在都会传入 --cap-drop ALL，并在真正执行请求命令前由沙箱内部阶段核验 Linux Effective/Permitted Capability 集为空，否则直接中止。

signals.title: Codex confines MCP HTTP redirects to the configured origin
signals.title_zh: Codex 将 MCP HTTP 重定向限制在配置源站内
signals.summary: MCP HTTP redirect handling now validates every hop against the configured server origin, requires HTTPS for non-loopback hostname redirects, shares the original timeout, enforces a hop limit and avoids replaying plaintext proxy credentials across redirects.
signals.summary_zh: MCP HTTP 重定向现在逐跳核验目标是否仍属于配置服务器源站；非 Loopback 主机名的重定向必须使用 HTTPS，同时共享原始超时、限制跳数，并避免跨重定向重放明文代理凭证。

signals.title: Codex traces exec-server requests from receipt through terminal outcome
signals.title_zh: Codex 对 Exec Server 请求从接收到终态进行全链路追踪
signals.summary: Inbound exec-server request spans now begin when messages enter the connection queue and continue through dispatch and response handling, with bounded-route queue-duration telemetry and outcome recording for completed, rejected, cancelled, error and disconnect paths.
signals.summary_zh: Exec Server 入站请求在进入连接队列时即开始 Span，并贯穿调度和响应处理；同时增加按有界 Route 标记的队列时长指标，并记录完成、拒绝、取消、错误与断连等终态。

signals.title: Google ADK blocks remote A2A peers from self-approving dangerous tool calls
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 阻止远程 A2A 对端自批危险工具调用
signals.summary: ADK now marks every A2A-originated invocation even when the peer sends no metadata and ignores tool-confirmation responses arriving over A2A, closing a path where a remote peer could satisfy a human-in-the-loop confirmation for a pending dangerous tool call.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 现在即使远程对端不携带 Metadata，也会标记调用来自 A2A，并忽略经 A2A 到达的工具确认响应，从而封堵远程对端替代真人完成危险工具调用 HITL 审批的路径。

signals.title: Google ADK correctly resumes live sessions from caller-supplied handles
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 使用调用方 Handle 正确恢复 Live Session
signals.summary: ADK seeds the live invocation with a caller-provided session-resumption handle before the first connect loop, so an existing server-side conversation is not replayed and an early socket drop can reconnect before the server has issued a new handle.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 在首次连接循环前将调用方提供的 Session Resumption Handle 注入 Live Invocation，使服务器已有的会话历史不被重复回放，并允许首次连接在服务器尚未下发新 Handle 时发生断连后继续恢复。

signals.title: Gemini CLI enforces the agents feature gate before loading built-in subagents
signals.title_zh: Gemini CLI 在加载内置子 Agent 前强制执行 Agents Feature Gate
signals.summary: Gemini CLI moves built-in-agent loading behind the enableAgents check and prevents refresh from reloading agents while the feature is disabled, so disabling agents now actually yields an empty registry unless explicitly overridden by supported policy.
signals.summary_zh: Gemini CLI 将内置 Agent 加载移到 enableAgents 检查之后，并禁止在 Agents 功能关闭时通过 Refresh 重新加载，从而使“禁用 Agents”真正落实为空 Registry，而不是仅停用部分路径。

signals.title: Gemini CLI bounds IDE process discovery with execution timeouts
signals.title_zh: Gemini CLI 为 IDE 进程探测增加有界执行超时
signals.summary: Gemini CLI now bounds process-table discovery commands with 3-second Unix and 5-second Windows timeouts and handles timeout failures, removing an indefinite-hang path in IDE integration startup and diagnostics.
signals.summary_zh: Gemini CLI 现在为进程表探测设置 Unix 3 秒、Windows 5 秒超时并处理超时失败，消除 IDE 集成启动和诊断中的一个无限挂起路径。

signals.title: Codex restores Guardian risk state when threads resume or fork
signals.title_zh: Codex 在线程恢复或分叉时恢复 Guardian 风险状态
signals.summary: Resumed and forked Codex threads now initialize SecurityRiskScore from the latest persisted rollout history when no explicit score is supplied, preserving approval-routing state instead of silently resetting governance context across thread lifecycles.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 的恢复线程与分叉线程在未显式提供分数时，会从最近的持久化 Rollout 历史恢复 SecurityRiskScore，避免跨线程生命周期静默重置审批路由所依赖的治理状态。

signals.title: Codex applies effective user MCP policy to executor plugins
signals.title_zh: Codex 将有效用户 MCP 策略落实到 Executor Plugin
signals.summary: Executor-plugin MCP roots now inherit effective user server enablement, tool allow/deny lists and default/per-tool approval modes while preserving stricter plugin-declared restrictions, aligning selected execution plugins with the same governed MCP policy surface.
signals.summary_zh: Executor Plugin 的 MCP Root 现在继承有效用户配置中的服务器启用状态、工具 Allow/Deny 列表以及默认/逐工具审批模式，同时保留 Plugin 自身更严格的限制，使选定执行插件进入统一 MCP 治理策略面。

signals.title: Claude Code aligns permission UI with the exact grant scope
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 将权限界面与实际授权范围对齐
signals.summary: Claude Code v2.1.235 fixes a permission-comment keyboard path that could approve an edit and grant session-wide edit permission, and changes permission dialogs so displayed scope and 'don't ask again' choices match what a grant would actually cover; persistent approval is withheld when contents cannot be fully displayed.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code v2.1.235 修复了权限评论框中的键盘路径会误批准编辑并授予会话级编辑权限的问题，同时要求权限对话框显示的范围与“don't ask again”选项严格对应实际授权范围；当内容无法完整展示时不再提供持久授权。

signals.title: Claude Code rejects oversized cross-session messages before delivery
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 在跨会话交付前拒绝超大消息
signals.summary: Claude Code changes SendMessage to reject payloads that exceed cross-session delivery limits before accepting them, replacing silent downstream drops with explicit admission failure at the sender boundary.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code 将 SendMessage 改为在接受消息前检查跨会话交付上限，超限即显式拒绝，用发送端的准入失败替代下游静默丢弃。

signals.title: Codex binds header authentication to allowed ChatGPT workspaces
signals.title_zh: Codex 将 Header 身份认证绑定到允许的 ChatGPT 工作区
signals.summary: Codex validates externally supplied header credentials against managed workspace restrictions using the credential-bound chatgpt-account-id, rejects missing or disallowed account IDs including on refresh, and does not replace previously cached authentication with a disallowed refreshed credential.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 使用与凭据绑定的 chatgpt-account-id 将外部 Header 凭据校验到受管工作区限制；缺失或不允许的 Account ID（包括刷新后的凭据）都会被拒绝，并且不会用不允许的新凭据覆盖此前缓存的合法认证。

signals.title: Codex constrains child-agent roles to authority-preserving overrides
signals.title_zh: Codex 将子 Agent 角色限制为不扩权的配置覆盖
signals.summary: Codex limits agent-role customization to supported behavior fields and capability reductions while preserving parent-owned permissions, providers, endpoints, MCP servers and managed requirements; resumed agents use the same bounded role path and symlinked user role files are rejected.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 将 Agent Role 自定义限制在受支持的行为字段和能力收缩范围内，同时保留父会话拥有的权限、Provider、Endpoint、MCP Server 与受管要求；恢复后的 Agent 也使用同一受限路径，并拒绝符号链接形式的用户角色文件。

signals.title: Codex Guardian fails closed when risk scoring cannot complete
signals.title_zh: Codex Guardian 在风险评分失败时执行 Fail-closed
signals.summary: Guardian V2 now treats configuration, serialization, thread-lookup and classification failures as elevated risk, tracks asynchronous scoring failures separately, and falls back to strict approval review instead of retaining a stale low-risk decision when the latest action cannot be scored.
signals.summary_zh: Guardian V2 现在把配置、动作序列化、线程查询和分类错误视为高风险，并单独记录异步评分失败；当最新动作无法评分时回退到严格审批，而不是沿用陈旧的低风险结果。

signals.title: Codex MCP hooks execute only against ready policy-admitted tools
signals.title_zh: Codex MCP Hook 仅对已就绪且通过策略准入的工具执行
signals.summary: Codex routes mcp_tool hooks through the session MCP runtime but restricts them to already-connected, cataloged and policy-allowed tools; unavailable servers fail immediately without startup or reconnect, hook timeouts are capped by server timeout, and recursive hook dispatch is suppressed.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 通过会话共享 MCP Runtime 执行 mcp_tool Hook，但仅允许已连接、已进入 Catalog 且通过策略的工具；不可用服务器直接失败，不触发启动或重连，Hook 超时受 Server Timeout 上限约束，并禁止递归 Hook 调度。

signals.title: Codex separates asynchronous user-visible messages from model context
signals.title_zh: Codex 将异步用户可见消息与模型上下文分离
signals.summary: Codex adds an async root-agent user-message path that emits user-visible text and immediately returns accepted so the turn can continue while keeping that update out of model input context; companion delivery metadata is preserved through event conversion, history and replay.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 新增 Root Agent 的异步用户消息路径：消息向用户可见并立即返回 Accepted，使当前 Turn 可继续运行，同时不把该更新重新注入模型输入上下文；配套 Delivery Metadata 会贯穿事件转换、历史物化与回放。

signals.title: Codex binds reusable execution approval to the actual shell executable
signals.title_zh: Codex 将可复用执行审批绑定到真实 Shell 执行器
signals.summary: Codex evaluates unfamiliar shell executables alongside parsed inner commands and includes the executable in reusable approval keys, so trust in an inner command cannot implicitly authorize an arbitrary shell binary; custom shells require their own approval identity.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 在统一执行审批中同时评估陌生 Shell 执行器与解析后的内部命令，并把执行器纳入可复用审批 Key；因此对内部命令的信任不能隐式授权任意 Shell 二进制，自定义 Shell 必须拥有自己的审批身份。

signals.title: Google ADK fences relayed agent output as untrusted data
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 将 Agent 间转发输出围栏化为不可信数据
signals.summary: ADK now wraps relayed text, thoughts, tool arguments and tool results between explicit markers with a preamble that identifies them as data rather than instructions; marker strings inside payloads are elided first so relayed content cannot structurally close its own quoted block, while maintainers explicitly note this raises the barrier rather than guaranteeing model obedience.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 现在把 Agent 间转发的文本、思考、工具参数和工具结果放入显式 Marker，并在前言中声明其为数据而非指令；载荷中的 Marker 会先被清除，避免转发内容自行闭合引用块。维护者同时明确说明，这只是提高结构隔离强度，并不保证模型一定服从该边界。

signals.title: MCP TypeScript SDK surfaces token-persistence failure after OAuth refresh
signals.title_zh: MCP TypeScript SDK 在 OAuth 刷新后显式暴露 Token 持久化失败
signals.summary: The MCP TypeScript SDK moves saveTokens outside the refresh-error catch so persistence failures propagate instead of being silently converted into a fresh authorization redirect; this prevents rotating-refresh-token flows from losing the newly issued credentials while the old token has already been invalidated server-side.
signals.summary_zh: MCP TypeScript SDK 将 saveTokens 移出刷新错误的 Catch 范围，使持久化失败直接向调用方暴露，而不再静默转成新的授权重定向；这避免旋转 Refresh Token 场景中服务器已使旧 Token 失效、客户端却又丢失新凭据的破坏性状态。

signals.title: Codex stops treating Git commands as inherently safe
signals.title_zh: Codex 不再把 Git 命令默认视为安全操作
signals.summary: Codex removed Git commands from its known-safe classification because repository configuration can make even read-only Git commands execute helpers. Under the unless-trusted policy, commands such as git status now require approval unless an explicit execution-policy rule allows them.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 将 Git 命令移出默认安全分类，因为仓库配置可能让看似只读的 Git 命令执行 helper。在 unless-trusted 策略下，git status 等命令现在也需要审批，除非有明确执行策略放行。

signals.title: Codex isolates automatic plugin Git operations from project Git configuration
signals.title_zh: Codex 将自动插件 Git 操作与项目 Git 配置隔离
signals.summary: Automatic marketplace upgrades, plugin cache refreshes and curated lookups now strip repository-scoped Git environment variables and run from a temporary trusted repository, preventing project-local Git configuration from redirecting remotes or invoking helpers during background operations.
signals.summary_zh: 自动 Marketplace 升级、插件缓存刷新与精选来源查询现在会移除仓库级 Git 环境变量，并在临时可信仓库中运行，避免后台操作继承项目本地 Git 配置后重定向远端或执行 helper。

signals.title: Codex persists thread section moves before the first turn
signals.title_zh: Codex 在首轮对话前持久化线程分区移动
signals.summary: A newly created non-ephemeral thread is now materialized and flushed before an explicit section move, so a thread with no first turn or preview is still represented in section-filtered queries instead of disappearing from durable navigation state.
signals.summary_zh: 新建的非临时线程现在会在显式移动分区前先物化并落盘，因此即使尚无首轮消息或预览，也能在按分区筛选的查询中保持可见，不再从持久导航状态中消失。

signals.title: Claude Code adds one-shot idle notifications for cross-session messaging
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 为跨会话消息增加一次性空闲通知
signals.summary: Claude Code v2.1.236 adds notify_when_idle to cross-session SendMessage, allowing another local session to send one notice when it next becomes idle. The mechanism is opt-in, one-shot and explicitly avoids polling.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code v2.1.236 在跨会话 SendMessage 中加入 notify_when_idle，可让另一会话在下一次进入空闲时发送一次通知；该机制需显式启用、只触发一次，并明确避免轮询。

signals.title: Claude Code makes wildcard read-deny rules dominate allowed read regions
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 让通配读拒绝规则优先于允许读取区域
signals.summary: On macOS, wildcard read-deny rules now take precedence even inside allowed read regions, cover the contents of matched directories, and cannot be bypassed by renaming a denied file.
signals.summary_zh: 在 macOS 上，通配读拒绝规则现在即使位于允许读取区域内也具有更高优先级，同时覆盖匹配目录的内容，并阻止通过重命名被拒文件来绕过限制。

signals.title: Claude Code serializes runner reuse behind post-session hooks
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 将 Runner 复用串行化到会话后置 Hook 完成之后
signals.summary: Claude Code v2.1.236 fixes self-hosted runner sessions released on idle, retirement or startup timeout from occasionally resuming on another runner before the previous post-session hook had completed.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code v2.1.236 修复了自托管 Runner 会话在空闲释放、退役或启动超时后，偶尔会在上一轮 post-session Hook 尚未完成时就在另一 Runner 上恢复的问题。

signals.title: Claude Code performs inbox-capacity admission before cross-session SendMessage
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 在跨会话 SendMessage 前执行收件箱容量准入
signals.summary: SendMessage now rejects additional messages up front when a rapid burst would exceed the target session inbox capacity, instead of acknowledging them as sent and then dropping them.
signals.summary_zh: 当快速突发消息将超过目标会话收件箱容量时，SendMessage 现在会在发送前直接拒绝，而不是先报告发送成功再静默丢弃。

signals.title: Gemini CLI preserves tool or media turns even when their text is empty
signals.title_zh: Gemini CLI 在文本为空时仍保留包含工具或媒体的轮次
signals.summary: Gemini CLI fixes history handling so turns with empty text are not discarded when they still contain tool or media content, preserving non-text execution evidence in conversation state.
signals.summary_zh: Gemini CLI 修复历史记录处理：当轮次文本为空但仍包含工具调用或媒体内容时不再丢弃，从而在会话状态中保留非文本执行证据。

signals.title: Google ADK stops RemoteA2aAgent from replaying credential requests to peers
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 阻止 RemoteA2aAgent 向远端 Peer 重放凭据请求
signals.summary: ADK found that session-history reconstruction could forward adk_request_credential function calls containing serialized AuthConfig, including OAuth client secrets or service-account keys, to a remote A2A peer. Credential-bearing function calls are now stripped before the message is rendered or forwarded.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 发现会话历史重建可能把包含序列化 AuthConfig 的 adk_request_credential 函数调用转发给远端 A2A Peer，其中可能包含 OAuth 客户端密钥或服务账号密钥。现在会在渲染或转发前剔除携带凭据的函数调用。

signals.title: Google ADK keys MCP agent-server conversation state to the connection
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 将 MCP Agent Server 会话状态绑定到连接
signals.summary: ADK changed its MCP agent-server session map to key conversation state by connection. With MCP SDK 2.x, a fresh ServerSession can be created per request; keying by that object silently restarted the conversation on every tool call. The new connection key preserves one conversation per connection while avoiding cross-client state sharing.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 将 MCP Agent Server 的会话映射改为按连接绑定对话状态。MCP SDK 2.x 可能为每个请求创建新的 ServerSession，原先按该对象索引会让每次工具调用都静默开启新对话；新的连接键既保持同一连接上的对话连续性，又避免不同客户端共享状态。

signals.title: Google ADK publishes file artifact versions atomically
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 以原子方式发布文件 Artifact 版本
signals.summary: FileArtifactService now reserves a hidden pending directory, writes payload and metadata there, and exposes the version with one atomic rename. Concurrent or interrupted saves no longer make a partial directory appear as the latest valid artifact; the change explicitly documents remaining power-loss durability limits.
signals.summary_zh: FileArtifactService 现在先保留隐藏 pending 目录，在其中写入 payload 与 metadata，再通过一次原子重命名发布版本。并发或中断保存不再让半成品目录成为“最新有效 Artifact”，同时实现明确记录了断电场景仍存在的持久性边界。

signals.title: Google ADK removes an indefinite-wait failure mode from local code execution
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 消除本地代码执行的一类无限等待故障
signals.summary: UnsafeLocalCodeExecutor now runs code in a plain child interpreter and derives the result from exit status and pipes instead of waiting on a multiprocessing result queue. A child that dies without reporting no longer leaves the agent waiting forever, while trivial execution latency is reported to drop from about 2.3 seconds to about 35 milliseconds.
signals.summary_zh: UnsafeLocalCodeExecutor 改为在普通子解释器中运行代码，并从退出状态与管道得到结果，而不是等待 multiprocessing 结果队列。子进程即使异常退出且未写回结果，也不再让 Agent 永久等待；提交同时报告简单程序延迟约从 2.3 秒降至 35 毫秒。

signals.title: Google ADK resumes workflow-node authentication from the node's own auth configuration
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 从节点自身认证配置恢复 Workflow Node 认证
signals.summary: ADK fixes workflow resume so a node recovers authentication from that node's own auth configuration rather than relying on a mismatched surrounding authentication state.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 修复 Workflow 恢复逻辑，使节点从自身的认证配置恢复认证，而不是依赖可能不匹配的外围认证状态。

signals.title: Google ADK bounds MCP session-pool growth without closing in-flight calls
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 在不关闭进行中调用的前提下限制 MCP Session Pool 增长
signals.summary: ADK adds a 15-minute idle TTL to pooled MCP sessions and evicts stale sessions on pool access, addressing unbounded growth as per-user credentials rotate. Sessions with calls in flight are pinned out of the sweep, stale-use pins are surfaced by warnings, and teardown runs asynchronously so unrelated callers are not parked behind dead sessions.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 为池化 MCP 会话加入 15 分钟空闲 TTL，并在访问 Session Pool 时淘汰过期会话，以解决用户凭据轮换导致的无界增长。进行中的调用会被固定并排除在清理之外，异常长的固定状态会产生告警，清理则异步进行，避免无关调用被死会话阻塞。

signals.title: Codex keeps Guardian classifier policy instructions uncapped unless a limit is explicit
signals.title_zh: Codex 仅在显式配置上限时才截断 Guardian 分类器策略指令
signals.summary: Guardian v2 no longer applies an implicit token cap to classifier instructions when no cap was configured, avoiding silent truncation of rendered policy while still honoring explicit local or model limits.
signals.summary_zh: Guardian v2 在未配置上限时不再隐式限制分类器指令 Token，避免已渲染策略被静默截断；若本地或模型显式配置上限仍会遵守。

signals.title: Codex restricts macOS preference reads to full-disk sandbox policies
signals.title_zh: Codex 将 macOS 偏好设置读取权限限制在全盘读取沙箱策略
signals.summary: Seatbelt preference and cfprefsd grants are now included only when filesystem reads are unrestricted, preventing macOS preferences from exposing data outside restricted read roots.
signals.summary_zh: Seatbelt 偏好设置与 cfprefsd 授权现在仅在文件系统读取不受限时启用，防止 macOS 偏好服务越过受限读取根暴露数据。

signals.title: Codex routes Amazon Bedrock compaction through Responses compaction triggers
signals.title_zh: Codex 将 Amazon Bedrock 压缩统一到 Responses compaction trigger
signals.summary: Amazon Bedrock remote compaction now uses compaction_trigger items sent through /v1/responses and provider capabilities explicitly opt in to remote compaction, with manual and automatic history tests.
signals.summary_zh: Amazon Bedrock 远程压缩改为通过 /v1/responses 发送 compaction_trigger，并由 Provider Capability 显式声明支持；同时覆盖手动与自动压缩历史测试。

signals.title: Codex pins Amazon Bedrock models to Multi-Agent V1 capability
signals.title_zh: Codex 将 Amazon Bedrock 模型能力固定到 Multi-Agent V1
signals.summary: Bedrock model catalogs now advertise MultiAgentVersion V1 because Bedrock lacks response items required by V2, making multi-agent protocol capability a provider-specific compatibility decision.
signals.summary_zh: 由于 Bedrock 不支持 Multi-Agent V2 所需的 response items，其模型目录现在显式声明 MultiAgentVersion V1，把多 Agent 协议能力作为 Provider 级兼容性决策。

signals.title: Codex serializes host-supplied exec-server WebSocket replacement and session recovery
signals.title_zh: Codex 串行化宿主提供的 Exec Server WebSocket 替换与会话恢复
signals.summary: Embedding hosts can supply already accepted authenticated WebSockets and replace them while resuming the same exec-server session; overlapping replacements are rejected and failed or cancelled handoff claims are released.
signals.summary_zh: 宿主可提供已接受且认证的 WebSocket，并在保持同一 Exec Server 会话的前提下替换连接；重叠替换会被拒绝，失败或取消的 Handoff Claim 会被释放。

signals.title: Codex bounds retry of transient environment-registry failures during initial exec connection
signals.title_zh: Codex 对首次 Exec 连接中的临时环境注册表失败实施有界重试
signals.summary: Initial Noise rendezvous now retries only transient registry failures with per-request and overall deadlines, backoff and retry limits, while permanent and malformed responses terminate immediately.
signals.summary_zh: 首次 Noise Rendezvous 仅对临时 Registry 失败执行带单次/总体截止时间、退避与次数上限的重试；永久错误和完整但畸形的响应立即终止。

signals.title: Codex adds ownership-scoped MCP event streaming to app-server
signals.title_zh: Codex 为 App Server 增加受所有权约束的 MCP 事件流
signals.summary: Experimental MCP event streams are scoped to the owning app-server connection and thread, enforce unique IDs and per-connection limits, clean up on unsubscribe/close, wait for active notification, and stop when authentication or runtime ownership changes.
signals.summary_zh: 实验性 MCP 事件流按 App Server 连接与 Thread 所有权隔离，实施唯一 ID 与单连接上限，在退订/关闭时清理，等待 Active 通知，并在认证或 Runtime 所有权变化时终止。

signals.title: Codex preserves managed developer instructions across compaction, resume and forks
signals.title_zh: Codex 在压缩、恢复与 Agent Fork 中保持托管开发者指令
signals.summary: Managed additional developer instructions are now a separate requirements layer, emit replacement/removal context updates, survive compaction, resume and agent forks without duplication, and are rejected above a 10,000-token estimate.
signals.summary_zh: 托管 additional developer instructions 成为独立 Requirements 层；变化时显式发出替换/移除上下文，跨 Compaction、Resume 与 Agent Fork 保持且不重复，并对超过约 10,000 Token 的内容拒收。

signals.title: Codex marks standalone tool outputs as external context that can disable memory
signals.title_zh: Codex 将独立 Tool Output 标记为可禁用记忆的外部上下文
signals.summary: Standalone function outputs without call IDs are treated as external context in injected, new and forked threads; when configured, this marks memory mode polluted and disables memory, and Guardian transcripts retain namespaced tool identity.
signals.summary_zh: 没有 call_id 的独立 Function Output 在注入、新建与 Fork Thread 中被视为外部上下文；启用相关策略时会把 Memory Mode 标记为污染并禁用记忆，Guardian Transcript 仍保留命名空间化工具身份。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK fails closed on empty tool arguments
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 对空 Tool Arguments 采用 Fail-Closed
signals.summary: The Agents SDK core now rejects empty tool arguments rather than allowing an ambiguous empty invocation to proceed, tightening tool-call admission semantics.
signals.summary_zh: Agents SDK Core 现在拒绝空 Tool Arguments，而不是让语义不明确的空调用继续执行，从而收紧工具调用准入语义。

signals.title: Google ADK isolates invalid skill catalog entries instead of failing the entire search
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 隔离无效 Skill Catalog 条目而不是让整次搜索失败
signals.summary: Skill search now skips and warns on catalog hits with invalid frontmatter, non-string names or empty descriptions, preventing one malformed external entry from collapsing discovery for all results.
signals.summary_zh: Skill Search 遇到 Frontmatter 不合法、名称非字符串或描述为空的 Catalog Hit 时改为跳过并告警，避免一个外部畸形条目导致整次 Discovery 失败。

signals.title: Google ADK makes Workflow runs honor before-run early exit
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 让 Workflow Run 正确遵守 Before-Run 提前退出
signals.summary: Workflow execution now captures before_run_callback results and terminates when it returns Content, matching the non-workflow path and restoring a control hook that can veto further execution.
signals.summary_zh: Workflow 执行现在会获取 before_run_callback 的返回值，并在其返回 Content 时提前结束，与非 Workflow 路径一致，恢复可阻止后续执行的控制 Hook。

signals.title: Google ADK allows distinct injected LLM clients per agent
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 支持为不同 Agent 注入独立 LLM Client
signals.summary: Gemini and AnthropicLlm can receive preconfigured custom clients, explicitly supporting multi-agent systems in which different agents use distinct client configuration and provider behavior.
signals.summary_zh: Gemini 与 AnthropicLlm 可注入预配置的自定义 Client，显式支持多 Agent 系统为不同 Agent 使用不同 Client 配置与 Provider 行为。

signals.title: Google ADK exposes a runtime cap for maximum LLM calls
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 增加最大 LLM 调用次数的运行时上限
signals.summary: ADK adds ADK_MAX_LLM_CALLS as an environment-configurable limit for maximum LLM calls, turning an execution-cost and runaway-loop boundary into explicit runtime configuration.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 新增 ADK_MAX_LLM_CALLS 环境变量配置最大 LLM 调用次数，把执行成本与失控循环边界变成显式 Runtime 配置。

signals.title: Google ADK reverts a transport-based A2A HITL guard that blocked legitimate confirmations
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 回退会误阻合法确认的 A2A 传输层 HITL 门禁
signals.summary: ADK reverted a guard that discarded every A2A human tool confirmation because the transport carried A2A metadata; the maintainer notes the control was both overbroad and insufficient because approval trust must bind to the approving principal rather than transport alone.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 回退了一个因请求带 A2A Metadata 而丢弃全部 A2A 人工工具确认的门禁；维护者明确指出该控制既过宽又不足，因为审批可信性应绑定批准主体，而不能只绑定传输通道。

signals.title: Google ADK scopes RemoteA2A authentication credentials per agent
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 将 RemoteA2A 认证凭据按 Agent 隔离
signals.summary: RemoteA2aAgent now accepts auth schemes and credentials resolved once per invocation; interceptors and derived credential keys are per agent so one agent's token cannot reach another agent's host, and tokenless OAuth no longer sends Bearer None.
signals.summary_zh: RemoteA2aAgent 现在支持每次调用解析一次的 Auth Scheme 与 Credential；Interceptor 与派生 Credential Key 按 Agent 隔离，避免一个 Agent 的 Token 泄露到另一 Agent Host，同时不再为无 Token OAuth 发送 Bearer None。

signals.title: Claude Code adds bounded graceful shutdown for self-hosted runners
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 为自托管 Runner 增加有界优雅关闭
signals.summary: Claude Code 2.1.238 adds a deferred-shutdown maximum: on SIGTERM a runner keeps serving attached sessions, parks remaining work after a configured number of minutes, then exits.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.238 新增 Deferred Shutdown 最大时长：Runner 收到 SIGTERM 后继续服务已附着会话，达到配置分钟数后将剩余工作 Park，再退出。

signals.title: Claude Code prevents healthy runner handoff after one slow or lost poll
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 防止一次慢轮询或丢失轮询触发健康 Runner 错误交接
signals.summary: Self-hosted runners are no longer removed by the server after a single slow or lost poll request, avoiding transfer of a still-healthy session to another runner.
signals.summary_zh: 自托管 Runner 不再因为一次慢轮询或轮询丢失就被服务端移除，从而避免仍健康的 Session 被错误转交到另一个 Runner。

signals.title: Claude Code makes cross-session refusal and queue loss visible to senders
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 将跨会话拒收与队列丢弃显式反馈给发送方
signals.summary: Cross-session SendMessage now reports explicit refusal and inbox drops caused by rate limits or full queues instead of acknowledging silent loss, strengthening delivery outcome semantics.
signals.summary_zh: 跨会话 SendMessage 现在会明确报告接收方拒绝以及因限流/队列满造成的 Inbox 丢弃，而不是把消息静默丢失后仍表现为成功，从而强化交付终态语义。

signals.title: Claude Code gates project MCP header helpers on folder trust and strips inherited credentials
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 以 Folder Trust 门禁项目 MCP Header Helper 并剥离继承凭据
signals.summary: Project MCP headersHelper and inline MCP servers now require accepted folder trust, while helpers from project, plugin or agent files run without inherited credential environment variables; higher-scope helpers run from the Claude config directory.
signals.summary_zh: 项目 MCP headersHelper 与 Inline MCP Server 现在要求先接受 Folder Trust；来自项目、Plugin 或 Agent File 的 Helper 运行时不继承 Credential 环境变量，高层级 Helper 则从 Claude Config 目录执行。

signals.title: Claude Code hides pre-warmed idle workers until a task claims them
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 在任务 Claim 前隐藏预热空闲 Worker
signals.summary: ListAgents and SendMessage no longer expose the idle worker pre-warmed for the next background session; that worker becomes visible only after a task actually claims it.
signals.summary_zh: ListAgents 与 SendMessage 不再暴露为下一后台 Session 预热的空闲 Worker；只有任务真正 Claim 后，该 Worker 才进入可见状态。

signals.title: Claude Code makes crashed Remote Control sessions reusable and tolerates brief reconnect refusals
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 让崩溃的 Remote Control Session 可复用并容忍短暂重连拒绝
signals.summary: A Remote Control session whose process crashes can now be reused on the next message, and brief 403 refusals from network edges, VPNs or proxies are tolerated for up to three minutes before a persistent block is reported.
signals.summary_zh: Remote Control Session 的进程崩溃后，现在可在下一条消息到来时复用；网络边缘、VPN 或代理造成的短暂 403 最多容忍 3 分钟，持续阻塞才被明确报告。

signals.title: Gemini CLI makes ignore-path symlink evaluation consistent
signals.title_zh: Gemini CLI 统一 Ignore Path 的符号链接求值语义
signals.summary: Gemini CLI fixes inconsistent symlink evaluation in ignore-path handling, tightening the correspondence between configured ignored paths and filesystem objects reached through links.
signals.summary_zh: Gemini CLI 修复 Ignore Path 处理中符号链接求值不一致的问题，使已配置忽略路径与通过 Link 实际访问到的文件系统对象保持一致语义。

signals.title: Claude Code releases old subagent tool results from long interactive sessions
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 在长交互 Session 中释放已离开显示窗口的 Subagent Tool Result
signals.summary: Subagent tool results are now released after leaving the recent display window, fixing unbounded memory growth in long interactive sessions without changing the current visible result window.
signals.summary_zh: Subagent Tool Result 离开最近显示窗口后会被释放，修复长交互 Session 的无界内存增长，同时不改变当前可见结果窗口。
