signals.title: Codex can suspend an unfinished root turn without terminalizing it
signals.title_zh: Codex 可挂起未完成 Root Turn 而不写入终态
signals.summary: A root turn can be suspended after history flush and task shutdown without recording completion or abort, preserving unfinished history so another runtime can recover the same turn ID after descendant guards clear.
signals.summary_zh: Root Turn 可在刷新历史并停止任务后挂起，而不记录 Completed 或 Aborted；未完成历史被保留，待 Descendant Guard 清除后可由另一 Runtime 以同一 Turn ID 恢复。

signals.title: Codex preserves canonical strict MCP auto-review denial, timeout and abort outcomes
signals.title_zh: Codex 保留 Strict MCP Auto-Review 的规范拒绝、超时与中止结果
signals.summary: Strict MCP auto-review now propagates canonical denial, timeout and abort responses with reviewer action, metadata and rationale instead of collapsing them into a generic decline, while still failing closed without a canonical decision.
signals.summary_zh: Strict MCP Auto-Review 现在保留规范 Denial、Timeout 与 Abort 回应及 Reviewer Action、Metadata、Rationale，不再统一压成 Generic Decline；缺少规范 Decision 时仍 Fail-Closed。

signals.title: Codex emits structured Guardian V2 classification audit events
signals.title_zh: Codex 为 Guardian V2 分类结果输出结构化审计事件
signals.summary: Every completed Guardian V2 classification now logs thread, turn, tool call, risk score, threshold, sample time and whether the score was accepted or superseded, with integration coverage through log export.
signals.summary_zh: 每次完成的 Guardian V2 分类都会记录 Thread、Turn、Tool Call、Risk Score、Threshold、Sample Time 以及结果被接受或替代的状态，并通过日志导出集成测试核验。

signals.title: Codex aligns unified-exec sandbox escalation with granular approval policy
signals.title_zh: Codex 将 Unified Exec 沙箱升级与细粒度审批策略统一
signals.summary: Unified exec now uses the shared approval-policy check for sandbox escalation: require_escalated commands may prompt only when granular sandbox approval is enabled and remain rejected when it is disabled.
signals.summary_zh: Unified Exec 的 Sandbox Escalation 现在使用共享 Approval Policy：仅在启用 Granular Sandbox Approval 时，require_escalated 命令才能请求审批；禁用时仍保持拒绝。

signals.title: Codex couples Guardian approval cancellation to the underlying tool call
signals.title_zh: Codex 将 Guardian 审批取消与底层 Tool Call 生命周期绑定
signals.summary: Tool cancellation tokens now propagate into Guardian approval reviews and server-initiated MCP approval elicitation, so interrupting a tool aborts its pending review instead of leaving detached approval work alive.
signals.summary_zh: Tool Cancellation Token 现在传播到 Guardian Approval Review 和服务端发起的 MCP Approval Elicitation；中断工具会同步终止其待处理 Review，避免形成脱离原任务的审批工作。

signals.title: Codex makes browser and computer-use permissions typed, layered policy
signals.title_zh: Codex 将 Browser / Computer Use 权限升级为类型化、分层策略
signals.summary: Same-day Codex changes add typed browser history, per-origin access/download/upload/CDP controls and typed computer-use app identities, preserve layered requirement sources, and expose the merged controls through app-server schemas.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 同日变更加入类型化 Browser History、按 Origin 的访问/下载/上传/CDP 控制，以及 Computer Use 应用身份规则；同时保留分层 Requirement 来源并通过 App Server Schema 暴露合并后的控制。

signals.title: Codex serializes remote plugin cache reconciliation and scopes it to the active account
signals.title_zh: Codex 串行化远程 Plugin Cache 对账并绑定 Active Account
signals.summary: Installed-plugin snapshots are account-scoped, in-flight loads are discarded on account changes, reconciliation is serialized with installs/uninstalls, generations prevent stale overwrite, and the full snapshot is validated before destructive cache changes.
signals.summary_zh: Installed Plugin Snapshot 现在按账号隔离；账号变化会丢弃 In-Flight Load；Reconciliation 与安装/卸载串行化；Generation 防止旧刷新覆盖新状态，并在破坏性 Cache 变更前验证完整 Snapshot。

signals.title: Codex reuses bounded Guardian review evidence with explicit invalidation boundaries
signals.title_zh: Codex 复用有界 Guardian Review Evidence，并设置明确失效边界
signals.summary: Completed synchronous Guardian allow/deny evidence can seed later async risk scoring as isolated trusted developer context, but is bounded, escaped and invalidated after history rewrites or new root-user messages including authorization changes.
signals.summary_zh: 已完成的同步 Guardian Allow/Deny Evidence 可作为隔离的 Trusted Developer Context 供后续异步 Risk Scoring 使用，但会被有界截断与转义，并在 History Rewrite 或新的 Root User Message（含授权变化）后失效。

signals.title: Codex forces escalated commands through synchronous Guardian review
signals.title_zh: Codex 强制 Escalated Command 经过同步 Guardian Review
signals.summary: Commands requesting require_escalated are now routed through full synchronous Guardian review regardless of retry state, bypassing extension approvals and Guardian V2 shortcuts so escalation cannot skip the strict review path.
signals.summary_zh: 请求 require_escalated 的命令无论是否 Retry 都必须进入完整同步 Guardian Review，并绕过 Extension Approval 与 Guardian V2 Shortcut，防止权限升级跳过严格 Review 路径。

signals.title: Codex prevents runtime permission updates from weakening managed deny-read rules
signals.title_zh: Codex 防止 Runtime Permission Update 削弱 Managed Deny-Read 规则
signals.summary: Managed deny-read requirements are retained separately and merged into updated profiles; conflicting permission profiles, legacy sandbox policies and request-specific command/exec sandbox policies are rejected.
signals.summary_zh: Managed Deny-Read Requirement 被独立保留并合并进更新后的 Permission Profile；与之冲突的 Permission Profile、Legacy Sandbox Policy 和 Command/Exec Request-Specific Sandbox Policy 都会被拒绝。

signals.title: Codex redacts provider and authentication credentials from app-server diagnostics
signals.title_zh: Codex 从 App Server 日志与诊断中隐藏 Provider 与认证凭据
signals.summary: RedactedString and safer logging paths now keep bearer tokens, header/query values, auth command arguments and attestation tokens out of persisted and submitted diagnostics while retaining safe error categories.
signals.summary_zh: 新增 RedactedString 与安全日志路径，确保 Bearer Token、Header/Query Value、认证命令参数和 Attestation Token 不进入持久化或上报诊断，同时保留安全的错误类别信息。

signals.title: Codex preserves event ordering while bounding active-thread draining
signals.title_zh: Codex 在限制 Active Thread Drain 时保持事件顺序
signals.summary: Active-thread notification draining is bounded to a frame interval and queued app events take priority, ensuring replay/startup state is applied before buffered closures while excess notifications remain queued for later frames.
signals.summary_zh: Active Thread Notification Drain 被限制在单个 Frame Interval 内，并优先处理排队的 App Event，使 Replay/Startup State 在 Buffered Closure 前生效；超额通知留待后续 Frame。

signals.title: Codex bypasses cached risk scores for models requiring automatic review
signals.title_zh: Codex 对必须 Auto-Review 的模型绕过缓存 Risk Score
signals.summary: Models configured as requiring automatic review now always take the full review path, cached SecurityRiskScore is cleared, and failed thread lookups advance score lag so stale risk evidence cannot approve later tool calls.
signals.summary_zh: 配置为必须 Auto-Review 的模型现在始终走完整 Review 路径，并清除缓存 SecurityRiskScore；Thread Lookup 失败会推进 Score Lag，防止旧 Risk Evidence 批准后续 Tool Call。

signals.title: Codex enforces attachment-owned network policy during remote execution
signals.title_zh: Codex 在 Remote Execution 中强制执行 Attachment-Owned Network Policy
signals.summary: Remote environment network policy is resolved per command and composed with controller constraints and saved decisions; inherited domain/socket denies remain, strict allowlists cannot expand, and escalation that bypasses owner policy is rejected.
signals.summary_zh: Remote Environment Network Policy 现在按命令解析，并与 Controller Constraint 和已保存 Decision 组合；继承的 Domain/Socket Deny 保持有效，Strict Allowlist 不可扩张，绕过 Owner Policy 的 Escalation 会被拒绝。

signals.title: Codex negotiates MCP bearer-token handling against executor capabilities
signals.title_zh: Codex 根据 Executor Capability 协商 MCP Bearer Token 处理方式
signals.summary: Executors advertise httpHeaderEnvVars support; bearer-token resolution is delegated only when supported, otherwise host resolution is used, and incompatible executor-owned MCP servers are excluded without breaking compatible servers.
signals.summary_zh: Executor 通过 httpHeaderEnvVars 声明能力；仅支持时才委托其解析 Bearer Token，否则由 Host 解析；不兼容的 Executor-Owned MCP Server 会被排除，同时保留兼容 Server。

signals.title: Codex carries genuine root-user authorization into subagent Guardian review
signals.title_zh: Codex 将真实 Root User 授权带入 Subagent Guardian Review
signals.summary: MultiAgent V2 worker reviews now receive bounded root-conversation context while treating only root user messages as authorization; summaries, review artifacts, assistant commentary and forwarded claims cannot establish authority.
signals.summary_zh: MultiAgent V2 Worker Review 现在接收有界 Root Conversation Context，但只有 Root User Message 可作为授权证据；Summary、Review Artifact、Assistant Commentary 与转发的 Agent Claim 都不能建立 Authority。

signals.title: Claude Code 2.1.239 hardens resumability, MCP recovery and cross-session coordination
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.239 强化恢复、MCP 重连与跨会话协作
signals.summary: The 2.1.239 release fixes idle-worker plan-mode recovery, transient remote MCP reconnect recovery, trace continuity after deferred PreToolUse hooks, request re-send after organization-policy rejection, long-hook keep-alives, and adds Windows cross-session SendMessage/ListAgents.
signals.summary_zh: 2.1.239 修复 Idle Worker Restart 后 Plan Mode 恢复、Remote MCP 临时 5xx 重连、Deferred PreToolUse Hook 后 Trace Continuity、组织策略拒绝后的重复请求与 Long Hook Keep-Alive，并为 Windows 增加跨会话 SendMessage/ListAgents。

signals.title: Gemini CLI isolates container runtime control surfaces inside macOS Seatbelt
signals.title_zh: Gemini CLI 在 macOS Seatbelt 中隔离容器运行时控制面
signals.summary: Gemini CLI tightened its macOS Seatbelt sandbox so Docker and other container runtime sockets and binaries are isolated, reducing the risk that a sandboxed coding agent reaches host-level container control surfaces.
signals.summary_zh: Gemini CLI 收紧 macOS Seatbelt 沙箱，对 Docker 等 Container Runtime Socket 与 Binary 进行隔离，降低沙箱内 Coding Agent 触达宿主级容器控制面的风险。

signals.title: Google ADK makes MCP session liveness resilient to SDK private-field movement
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 让 MCP Session Liveness 不再依赖 SDK 私有字段稳定性
signals.summary: ADK now reads MCP SDK private stream-closed fields defensively and falls back to its own task-liveness signal, preventing SDK field movement from crashing session health checks while still detecting dead transport tasks.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 现在防御式读取 MCP SDK 私有 Stream Closed 字段，并回退到自身 Task Liveness Signal，避免 SDK 字段变化导致 Session Health Check 崩溃，同时仍可识别已死亡的 Transport Task。

signals.title: Google ADK exposes private Cloud Build worker pools for Agent Engine deployment
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 为 Agent Engine 部署暴露 Private Cloud Build Worker Pool
signals.summary: Agent Engine deployment now accepts validated private Cloud Build worker pools through CLI or config with explicit precedence, enabling VPC-SC/private-network builds without falling back to the public build pool.
signals.summary_zh: Agent Engine 部署现在可通过 CLI 或 Config 使用经过验证的 Private Cloud Build Worker Pool，并明确优先级，使 VPC-SC / Private Network 构建无需回退到 Public Build Pool。

signals.title: Google ADK preserves event actions during PostgreSQL session migration
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 在 PostgreSQL Session Migration 中保留 Event Actions
signals.summary: The v0 PostgreSQL session migration no longer drops event actions, preserving behavioral state carried by events across persistence-schema migration.
signals.summary_zh: v0 PostgreSQL Session Migration 不再丢失 Event Actions，使事件携带的行为状态能够跨持久化 Schema Migration 保留。

signals.title: Google ADK records context-cache state on LLM call spans
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 在 LLM Call Span 中记录 Context Cache 状态
signals.summary: ADK adds context-cache state to LLM call tracing, making cache behavior part of the observable execution record rather than an implicit runtime condition.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 将 Context Cache 状态加入 LLM Call Trace，使 Cache 行为成为可观测执行记录的一部分，而不再只是隐含 Runtime 条件。

signals.title: Google ADK preserves MCP tool-error and schema semantics across SDK 1.x and 2.x
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 跨 MCP SDK 1.x / 2.x 保持 Tool Error 与 Schema 语义
signals.summary: ADK now reads both camelCase and snake_case MCP result/schema fields so 2.x renames do not silently hide tool errors or crash declaration extraction, while avoiding alias changes to returned payloads.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 现在同时读取 MCP Result/Schema 的 camelCase 与 snake_case 字段，避免 2.x 重命名静默隐藏 Tool Error 或导致 Declaration Extraction 崩溃，同时不改变返回 Payload 的 Alias 形态。

signals.title: Google ADK separates streaming-tool user messages from model context
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 将 Streaming Tool 的用户消息与 Model Context 分离
signals.summary: Streaming tools can now emit Event messages directly to the user through the invocation event queue while ordinary yielded values remain FunctionResponses for the model, separating delivery traffic from model-context effects.
signals.summary_zh: Streaming Tool 现在可通过 Invocation Event Queue 直接向用户发送 Event Message，而普通 Yield Value 仍作为 FunctionResponse 进入模型，从而把交付流量与 Model Context 影响分离。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK adds labels to Docker sandbox containers
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 为 Docker Sandbox Container 增加 Label
signals.summary: Docker sandbox containers can now carry labels, adding explicit deployment metadata that can support ownership, lifecycle management, cleanup and runtime inspection around sandboxed agent execution.
signals.summary_zh: Docker Sandbox Container 现在可携带 Label，为沙箱 Agent 执行增加显式 Deployment Metadata，可用于 Ownership、Lifecycle Management、Cleanup 与 Runtime Inspection。

signals.title: Codex persists caller-declared thread-source classification for new and forked executions
signals.title_zh: Codex 为新建与 Fork 执行持久化调用方声明的 Thread Source 分类
signals.summary: Codex exec callers can classify newly created and forked threads with --thread-source; the value is persisted into thread metadata and exposed through the TypeScript SDK, while resume preserves the existing thread source instead of overwriting it.
signals.summary_zh: Codex Exec 调用方现在可通过 --thread-source 为新建与 Fork Thread 分类；该值进入持久 Thread Metadata 并由 TypeScript SDK 暴露，而 Resume 会保留既有 Thread Source，不会覆盖。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK makes output-guardrail blocked placeholders customizable without exposing rejected data
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 在不暴露被拒绝数据的前提下支持自定义 Output Guardrail 阻断占位消息
signals.summary: RunConfig can now supply a synchronous blocked-message string or formatter for terminal output-guardrail rejection. The formatter receives safe metadata rather than rejected output or output_info, and invalid, async or failing formatters fall back to the SDK's data-free default while replay/persistence owners are rebuilt with the sanitized placeholder.
signals.summary_zh: RunConfig 现在可为 Terminal Output Guardrail Reject 配置同步阻断消息或 Formatter。Formatter 只接收安全元数据，不接触被拒绝输出或 output_info；无效、异步或异常 Formatter 会回退到 SDK 的 Data-Free 默认值，同时 Replay / Persistence Owner 使用净化后的占位内容重建。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK strips output-only created_by metadata when replaying RunItems as model input
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 在将 RunItem 重放为模型输入时移除仅属于输出侧的 created_by 元数据
signals.summary: RunItem replay now routes tool calls and outputs through the shared output-to-input conversion path so output-only created_by metadata, including nested shell output metadata, is stripped from replayed model input without mutating the original stored item.
signals.summary_zh: RunItem Replay 现在统一通过 Output-to-Input 转换路径处理 Tool Call 与 Tool Output，从重放给模型的输入中移除仅属于输出侧的 created_by 元数据（包括嵌套 Shell Output），同时不修改原始持久 Item。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK deduplicates repeated MCP server instances before lifecycle ownership
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 在接管 MCP Server 生命周期前去重重复 Server 实例
signals.summary: MCPServerManager now normalizes its owned server list through the existing uniqueness helper, so the same server object supplied repeatedly is connected and cleaned up exactly once rather than receiving duplicate lifecycle operations.
signals.summary_zh: MCPServerManager 现在先通过既有唯一性 Helper 规范化所持有的 Server 列表，因此同一个 Server Object 即使被重复传入，也只会 Connect 与 Cleanup 一次，避免重复生命周期操作。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK advances realtime guardrail state across every threshold crossed by a large transcript delta
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 在大块 Realtime Transcript Delta 跨越多个阈值时同步推进 Guardrail 状态
signals.summary: Realtime output guardrail bookkeeping now advances to the highest debounce threshold already crossed by a large transcript delta, preventing a small following delta from immediately retriggering a guardrail for thresholds that were already passed.
signals.summary_zh: Realtime Output Guardrail 的计数状态现在会直接推进到大块 Transcript Delta 已跨越的最高 Debounce Threshold，避免随后的小 Delta 对已经跨过的阈值再次立即触发 Guardrail。

signals.title: Google ADK preserves HITL function responses when resuming single-turn agent nodes
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 在恢复 Single-Turn Agent Node 时保留 HITL Function Response
signals.summary: When a single-turn workflow node resumes from an HITL tool-confirmation pause with resume_inputs, ADK no longer appends a duplicate synthetic user event that could shadow the operator's FunctionResponse and loop confirmation indefinitely; the original turn input remains in session history.
signals.summary_zh: Single-Turn Workflow Node 从 HITL Tool Confirmation 暂停恢复且带有 resume_inputs 时，ADK 不再追加会遮蔽操作员 FunctionResponse 的重复 Synthetic User Event，从而避免无限确认循环；原始 Turn Input 仍保留在 Session History 中。

signals.title: Codex hardens the bubblewrap synthetic-mount registry against writable overlap and symlink redirection
signals.title_zh: Codex 强化 Bubblewrap Synthetic-Mount Registry，防止可写重叠与 Symlink 重定向
signals.summary: Codex now protects its Linux bubblewrap synthetic-mount registry with a read-only bind when a writable filesystem bind would expose it, applies that protection before deny masks, and rejects a pre-existing registry symlink before registration or command execution. Regression coverage exercises symlink rejection and denied temporary directories under both full-root and minimal policies.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 现在会在可写 Filesystem Bind 可能暴露 Linux Bubblewrap Synthetic-Mount Registry 时为该 Registry 加入只读 Bind，并在 Deny Mask 之前实施保护；同时在注册或命令执行前拒绝预先存在的 Registry Symlink。回归测试覆盖 Symlink 拒绝，以及 Full-Root / Minimal Policy 下被拒绝的临时目录。

signals.title: Codex preserves child-only developer-instruction provenance across full-history subagent forks
signals.title_zh: Codex 在 Full-History Subagent Fork 中保留仅属于子 Agent 的 Developer Instruction 来源分类
signals.summary: Codex adds a dedicated contextual fragment for developer instructions and uses it in full-history subagent forks so child-specific guidance retains the generic.developer_instructions classification, reaches the child exactly once, and does not appear in the parent request.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 为 Developer Instructions 增加专用 Contextual Fragment，并在 Full-History Subagent Fork 中使用它，使仅属于子 Agent 的指导保留 generic.developer_instructions 分类、恰好一次到达子 Agent，同时不进入父请求。

signals.title: Codex extends Guardian computer-use evidence and policy handling to cua_repl-backed MCP execution
signals.title_zh: Codex 将 Guardian 的 Computer-Use 证据与策略处理扩展到 cua_repl 支撑的 MCP 执行
signals.summary: Codex now recognizes cua_repl alongside node_repl when collecting bounded Guardian review evidence, applying computer-use policy, capturing transcript images and rendering REPL history. The change also preserves failed MCP call status and result content when app-server history is replayed.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 现在在收集有界 Guardian Review Evidence、应用 Computer-Use Policy、捕获 Transcript Image 与渲染 REPL History 时，将 cua_repl 与 node_repl 同等识别；同时在 App-Server History Replay 时保留失败 MCP Call 的状态与结果内容。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK completes owned sandbox dependency cleanup before propagating cancellation
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 在传播 Cancellation 前完成所拥有 Sandbox Dependency 的清理
signals.summary: The sandbox dependency owner now records cancellation raised by one owned result, continues closing the remaining owned results exactly once, clears internal dependency state, and only then re-raises the first cancellation. Regression coverage verifies repeated close calls do not duplicate cleanup.
signals.summary_zh: Sandbox Dependency Owner 现在会记录某个 Owned Result 抛出的 Cancellation，继续恰好一次关闭其余 Owned Results，清理内部依赖状态后才重新抛出第一次 Cancellation；回归测试验证重复 Close 不会造成重复清理。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK preserves a tripped streaming input-guardrail exception when max-turns is also exceeded
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 在同时超过 Max Turns 时仍保留已触发的 Streaming Input Guardrail 异常
signals.summary: RunResultStreaming now marks the default MaxTurnsExceeded path as handled so a later error check cannot overwrite an already captured InputGuardrailTripwireTriggered exception. The regression test deterministically orders the max-turn condition and guardrail completion rather than relying on timing sleeps.
signals.summary_zh: RunResultStreaming 现在会把默认 MaxTurnsExceeded 路径标记为已处理，从而避免后续 Error Check 覆盖已经捕获的 InputGuardrailTripwireTriggered 异常；回归测试通过确定性同步 Max-Turn 条件与 Guardrail 完成顺序，而不是依赖 Sleep 猜测时序。

signals.title: Claude Code restores dropped remote MCP connections in non-interactive and SDK sessions
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 为非交互与 SDK 会话恢复掉线的远程 MCP 连接
signals.summary: Claude Code v2.1.243 reports that remote MCP servers in non-interactive and SDK sessions now reconnect automatically after dropped connections or surface an explicit failure instead of remaining permanently unavailable.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code v2.1.243 明确说明：非交互与 SDK 会话中的远程 MCP Server 在连接中断后会自动重连，或者明确报告失败，不再永久停留在不可用状态。

signals.title: Claude Code fixes mid-turn cloud-session resume so pending notifications do not become the resumed prompt
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 修复云会话中途恢复，避免 Pending Notification 被误当作恢复 Prompt
signals.summary: Claude Code v2.1.243 fixes cloud sessions resumed after a mid-turn restart so a pending hook or background-task notification is not resent as the user prompt and the session resumes with the normal continuation message.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code v2.1.243 修复了云会话在 Turn 中途重启后的恢复语义：Pending Hook 或后台任务通知不再被重新发送成用户 Prompt，而是按正常 Continuation Message 继续。

signals.title: Claude Code wakes background subagents when their final background Bash task completes
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 在最后一个后台 Bash 任务完成时唤醒后台 Subagent
signals.summary: Claude Code v2.1.243 fixes a liveness gap where background subagents could remain asleep after their last background Bash task completed; completion now provides a wake transition.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code v2.1.243 修复了后台 Subagent 在最后一个后台 Bash 任务完成后仍可能沉睡的活性缺口；任务完成现在会形成明确的唤醒转换。

signals.title: Codex adds typed persisted thread artifacts with per-thread identity and ordered reads
signals.title_zh: Codex 增加带线程内身份与有序读取的 Typed Persisted Thread Artifacts
signals.summary: Codex adds a thread_artifacts SQLite table with typed identities scoped to a thread, JSON payloads, cascade deletion, uniqueness enforcement and an index for ordered per-thread reads, plus exported attach/remove/pagination models.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 新增 thread_artifacts SQLite 表：Artifact 具有线程内 Typed Identity、JSON Payload、Cascade Delete、唯一性约束和线程内有序读取索引，并导出 Attach/Remove/Pagination 模型。

signals.title: Codex persists realtime conversation events in a canonical paginated thread timeline
signals.title_zh: Codex 将实时会话事件持久化进规范化、可分页的 Thread Timeline
signals.summary: Codex persists realtime session boundaries, transcript segments, promoted agent items and turn lifecycle events into paginated rollouts, adds thread/timeline/list and emits typed realtime item lifecycle notifications while preserving legacy history APIs.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 将 Realtime Session Boundary、Transcript Segment、Promoted Agent Item 与 Turn Lifecycle Event 持久化到分页 Rollout，新增 thread/timeline/list 与 Typed Realtime Item 生命周期通知，同时保持旧 History API 不变。

signals.title: Codex makes startup rollout migration recover from concurrent writes, archive moves and maintenance contention
signals.title_zh: Codex 让启动期 Rollout Migration 可从并发写入、归档移动与维护竞争中恢复
signals.summary: Codex waits for rollout maintenance, re-reads newly empty rollouts under their writer lock, retries busy rollouts on later startups and rediscovers archived or compressed paths that move after discovery, while terminal failures do not block the startup cursor.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 在迁移前等待 Rollout Maintenance，针对刚变为空的 Rollout 在 Writer Lock 下重读，把 Busy Rollout 留到后续启动重试，并重新发现 Discovery 后被归档或压缩而移动的路径，同时让永久失败不阻塞 Startup Cursor。

signals.title: Codex isolates internal Guardian reviews from parent-session customization while retaining managed restrictions
signals.title_zh: Codex 隔离内部 Guardian Review 与父会话自定义状态，同时保留 Managed Restriction
signals.summary: Codex starts internal and subagent Guardian reviews without inherited user instructions, extensions, MCP servers or multi-agent behavior while preserving managed execution policy, selected environment constraints and only the allowed review tools.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 的内部与 Subagent Guardian Review 不再继承用户 Instructions、Extensions、MCP Servers 或多 Agent 行为，但继续保留 Managed Execution Policy、选定环境限制，并仅暴露允许的 Review Tools。

signals.title: Codex prevents project configuration from influencing credential-provider and shell startup state during brokering
signals.title_zh: Codex 在 Credential Brokering 启用时阻止项目配置影响凭据 Provider 与 Shell 启动状态
signals.summary: When credential brokering is active, Codex ignores project-layer settings that could affect shell snapshots, profile loading, ZDOTDIR, BASH_ENV or credential-provider environment variables, while preserving those settings when brokering is effectively disabled.
signals.summary_zh: Credential Brokering 生效时，Codex 忽略可能影响 Shell Snapshot、Profile Loading、ZDOTDIR、BASH_ENV 或凭据 Provider 环境变量的项目层设置；当 Brokering 实际关闭时则保留这些项目设置。

signals.title: Codex propagates root turn IDs through turn and tool analytics for subagent attribution
signals.title_zh: Codex 在 Turn 与 Tool Analytics 中传播 Root Turn ID 以归因 Subagent 活动
signals.summary: Codex adds root_turn_id to turn and tool-item analytics, reads it from live turn metadata and propagates it through control-tool and code-mode completion facts so subagent and background activity can be correlated to the originating top-level turn; ambiguous roots are reported as null.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 为 Turn 与 Tool-Item Analytics 增加 root_turn_id，并从实时 Turn Metadata 读取、经 Control Tool 与 Code Mode Completion Fact 传播，使 Subagent 与后台活动可关联至顶层发起 Turn；来源歧义时明确记录为 null。

signals.title: Codex bounds skills.read pages to each tool-call response budget and snapshots cursor continuations
signals.title_zh: Codex 按每次 Tool Call 的响应预算约束 skills.read 分页并快照 Cursor Continuation
signals.summary: Codex sizes each serialized skills.read page to the active response budget with JSON escaping and UTF-8 boundaries accounted for, and caches one bounded resource snapshot per thread so cursor continuations remain consistent without rereading mutable files.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 按当前 Response Budget 计算每个 skills.read 序列化页面，同时考虑 JSON Escaping 与 UTF-8 边界；并为每个 Thread 缓存一个有界 Resource Snapshot，使 Cursor Continuation 在不重新读取可变文件的情况下保持一致。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK adds trusted, configurable host-environment isolation for Unix-local sandboxes
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 为 Unix-Local Sandbox 增加受信任、可配置的 Host Environment 隔离
signals.summary: UnixLocalSandboxClient can disable full host-environment inheritance and use a default or custom allowlist. The inheritance policy remains under trusted runtime-client control across resume and is deliberately not serialized into untrusted session state.
signals.summary_zh: UnixLocalSandboxClient 现在可以关闭完整 Host Environment 继承，并使用默认或自定义 Allowlist。该继承策略在 Resume 前后始终由受信任 Runtime Client 控制，并刻意不序列化进可恢复 Session State。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK reconciles uncertain resumed Session writes before any new model call
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 在新 Model Call 前对不确定的 Resumed Session Write 进行对账
signals.summary: The Agents SDK persists a pending resumed Session append in RunState, fingerprints authoritative history and settles whether the batch committed before the next model call. Changed or ambiguous history fails closed and requires repair instead of rerunning already completed tool work.
signals.summary_zh: Agents SDK 将待确认的 Resumed Session Append 持久化进 RunState，通过权威 History 指纹判断该批次是否已经提交，并在下一次 Model Call 前完成对账；History 已变化或存在歧义时 Fail Closed，要求修复而不是重跑已经完成的 Tool Work。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK applies server-wide input and output guardrails to every MCP tool
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 将 Server-Wide Input/Output Guardrail 应用于每个 MCP Tool
signals.summary: MCP server constructors can now define server-wide tool input and output guardrails; each converted FunctionTool receives isolated copies of those guardrail lists across stdio, SSE and Streamable HTTP, with regression coverage for approval and serialized-resume ordering.
signals.summary_zh: MCP Server Constructor 现在可定义 Server-Wide Tool Input/Output Guardrail；通过 stdio、SSE 与 Streamable HTTP 转换出的每个 FunctionTool 都获得独立 Guardrail List 副本，并新增 Approval 与 Serialized Resume 顺序回归测试。

signals.title: Gemini CLI rolls back cancelled tool turns and bounds automatic recovery from empty post-tool responses
signals.title_zh: Gemini CLI 回滚被取消的 Tool Turn，并对 Tool 后空响应的自动恢复设置有界次数
signals.summary: Gemini CLI now rolls model-issued tool-call history back to the post-user-prompt boundary when all tool calls are cancelled rather than appending synthetic cancellation responses. When a successful tool continuation returns no visible model text, it auto-nudges the model with a bounded maximum of two attempts.
signals.summary_zh: 当一个 Turn 的 Tool Call 全部被取消时，Gemini CLI 现在把 Model-issued Tool Call History 回滚到 User Prompt 之后的边界，而不是追加合成 Cancellation Response；成功 Tool Continuation 若没有可见模型文本，则最多自动 Nudge 两次。

signals.title: Gemini CLI declares allowed-path safety checkers as top-level write-policy controls
signals.title_zh: Gemini CLI 将 Allowed-Path Safety Checker 声明为顶层 Write Policy 控制
signals.summary: Gemini CLI moves allowed-path safety checkers for replace and write_file into explicit top-level safety_checker declarations with tool name, priority and mode, and adds tests proving both controls load from the default write policy.
signals.summary_zh: Gemini CLI 将 replace 与 write_file 的 Allowed-Path Safety Checker 改为显式顶层 safety_checker 声明，包含 Tool Name、Priority 与 Mode，并新增测试确认默认 Write Policy 中两项控制均能被加载。

signals.title: Gemini CLI clears stale A2A cancellation errors before new message turns
signals.title_zh: Gemini CLI 在新的 A2A Message Turn 前清理陈旧 Cancellation Error
signals.summary: Gemini CLI's A2A server clears a stale cancellation error when beginning a new message turn so a prior cancelled turn cannot poison the state of the next independent turn.
signals.summary_zh: Gemini CLI 的 A2A Server 在开始新的 Message Turn 时清理上一 Turn 遗留的 Cancellation Error，避免前一个取消状态污染下一次独立 Turn。

signals.title: MCP Python SDK gives recursive tool return types an object-rooted output schema
signals.title_zh: MCP Python SDK 为递归 Tool Return Type 生成 Object-Rooted Output Schema
signals.summary: The MCP Python SDK changes schema generation so recursive tool return types retain an object-rooted output schema, tightening the machine-readable contract exposed for recursive structured results.
signals.summary_zh: MCP Python SDK 调整 Schema 生成，使递归 Tool Return Type 仍保持 Object-Rooted Output Schema，从而收紧递归结构化结果对外暴露的机器可读契约。

signals.title: Google ADK preserves required parameters in CrewAI and LangChain function declarations
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 在 CrewAI 与 LangChain Function Declaration 中保留 Required Parameter
signals.summary: Google ADK fixes CrewAI and LangChain function declaration conversion to include the required list, preserving mandatory-argument semantics when tool schemas cross framework boundaries.
signals.summary_zh: Google ADK 修复 CrewAI 与 LangChain 的 Function Declaration 转换，使其携带 required 列表，在 Tool Schema 跨框架边界时保留必填参数语义。

signals.title: Claude Code reports interrupted MCP calls explicitly instead of treating them as successful empty output
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 将被中断的 MCP 调用显式标记为中断，不再当作成功空输出
signals.summary: Claude Code 2.1.246 fixes headless and remote MCP calls interrupted by an incoming message so the model receives an explicit interrupted error instead of a misleading completed-with-no-output result.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.246 修复 Headless 与 Remote 会话中因新消息而被中断的 MCP 调用：模型现在收到明确的 Interrupted Error，而不是误导性的“已完成但无输出”。

signals.title: Claude Code stops strict MCP sessions from requesting approval for servers they will never load
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 阻止 Strict MCP 会话为永不加载的 Server 请求审批
signals.summary: Claude Code 2.1.246 fixes --strict-mcp-config sessions prompting to approve .mcp.json servers that the strict configuration would never load, eliminating an unnecessary startup wait for background sessions.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.246 修复 --strict-mcp-config 会话仍要求审批实际不会加载的 .mcp.json Server 的问题，避免后台会话因虚假审批而在启动阶段等待。

signals.title: Claude Code binds third-party gateway API credentials to their configured host
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 将第三方 Gateway API 凭据绑定到其配置 Host
signals.summary: Claude Code 2.1.246 prevents telemetry and metrics sent to Anthropic from carrying an API key configured for a third-party ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL; a credential is sent only to its own host.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.246 阻止发往 Anthropic 的 Telemetry 与 Metrics 携带为第三方 ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL 配置的 API Key；凭据只会发送给其所属 Host。

signals.title: Claude Code makes requiresUserInteraction MCP tools non-bypassable by persistent allow rules
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 让 requiresUserInteraction MCP Tool 无法被持久 Allow Rule 绕过
signals.summary: Claude Code 2.1.246 removes the 'Yes, and don’t ask again' option for MCP tools marked requiresUserInteraction, preventing creation of an allow rule that the tool's mandatory interaction contract would ignore.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.246 对标记 requiresUserInteraction 的 MCP Tool 移除“以后不再询问”选项，避免生成与工具强制人工交互合同冲突的持久 Allow Rule。

signals.title: Claude Code automatically continues non-interactive responses interrupted by transport failures
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 自动续接因传输故障中断的非交互响应
signals.summary: Claude Code 2.1.246 makes -p, SDK and cloud sessions automatically continue a response cut off mid-stream by a server error, connection loss or stall rather than ending the run immediately with an error.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.246 让 -p、SDK 与 Cloud Session 在响应因 Server Error、连接丢失或 Stall 中途截断时自动继续，而不是立即以错误结束运行。

signals.title: Claude Code marks max-turn subagent results as partial instead of finished
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 将达到 MaxTurns 的 Subagent 结果标记为 Partial 而非 Finished
signals.summary: Claude Code 2.1.246 changes a subagent that stops at maxTurns to return its output explicitly marked partial with a continuation hint, instead of presenting truncated work as completed.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.246 让因 maxTurns 停止的 Subagent 将输出明确标记为 Partial，并给出继续提示，不再把被截断的工作呈现为已完成。

signals.title: Claude Code isolates concurrent review and cloud launches from another worktree's uncommitted state
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 隔离并发 Review 与 Cloud Launch，避免混入其他 Worktree 的未提交状态
signals.summary: Claude Code 2.1.246 fixes simultaneous /ultrareview and cloud launches from one repository, including multiple worktrees, occasionally starting with another launch's uncommitted changes.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.246 修复同一仓库（包括多个 Worktree）同时启动 /ultrareview 与 Cloud Session 时，某次 Launch 偶尔携带另一 Launch 未提交改动的问题。

signals.title: Claude Code keeps self-hosted runners alive across malformed work-poll responses
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 让 Self-hosted Runner 在异常 Work-poll Response 下保持存活
signals.summary: Claude Code 2.1.246 changes the self-hosted runner to retry when a work-poll response is malformed, such as an intercepting proxy returning HTML, instead of ending live sessions or exiting.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.246 让 Self-hosted Runner 在 Work-poll Response 异常（例如代理返回 HTML）时重试，不再因此结束 Live Session 或直接退出。

signals.title: Claude Code hardens Bash permission matching against wildcard overreach and malformed command tails
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 加固 Bash Permission Matching，防止 Wildcard 过度匹配与畸形命令尾部绕过
signals.summary: Claude Code 2.1.246 adds a startup warning for Bash allow rules whose wildcard precedes the subcommand because they also match inserted options, and forces approval for malformed commands ending in dangling && or || operators.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.246 对 Wildcard 位于 Subcommand 前的 Bash Allow Rule 增加启动警告，因为它也会匹配插入的 Option；同时对以悬空 && 或 || 结尾的畸形命令强制要求审批。

signals.title: Codex binds enterprise IdP sessions, identity claims and MCP resource indicators to OAuth issuer and server identity
signals.title_zh: Codex 将企业 IdP Session、Identity Claim 与 MCP Resource Indicator 绑定到 OAuth Issuer 与 Server Identity
signals.summary: Codex resolves stored enterprise IdP sessions against authorization metadata, binds OIDC claims and MCP resource indicators to issuer/client/server identity, requires reauthentication after pinned credential replacement, and isolates enterprise credentials by namespace and Codex home.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 依据 Authorization Metadata 解析已存企业 IdP Session，将 OIDC Claim 与 MCP Resource Indicator 绑定到 Issuer、Client 和 Server Identity，在固定凭据被替换后要求重新认证，并按 Namespace 与 Codex Home 隔离企业凭据。

signals.title: Codex preserves unstructured MCP tool results as typed content items
signals.title_zh: Codex 将非结构化 MCP Tool Result 保留为 Typed Content Item
signals.summary: Codex converts unstructured MCP results into typed function-call output items instead of serializing the entire content array into text, while preserving media, encrypted and unknown content through existing conversions and dropping empty text items during truncation.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 将非结构化 MCP Result 转为 Typed Function-call Output Item，而不是把整个 Content Array 序列化成文本；同时通过既有转换保留 Media、Encrypted 与 Unknown Content，并在 Truncation 时丢弃空文本项。

signals.title: Codex preserves attachment-owned permission profiles for MCP servers across runtime refreshes
signals.title_zh: Codex 在 Runtime Refresh 后仍保留 MCP Server 的 Attachment-owned Permission Profile
signals.summary: Codex resolves and captures a permission profile for each enabled MCP server when publishing the runtime, rejects calls when authority is unavailable, and reuses that server profile for approvals, elicitation and sandbox metadata even after runtime refreshes.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 在发布 Runtime 时为每个启用的 MCP Server 解析并捕获 Permission Profile，在权限不可用时拒绝调用，并在 Runtime Refresh 后继续用该 Server Profile 处理审批、Elicitation 与 Sandbox Metadata。

signals.title: Codex continuously tests exec-server compatibility against current, stable and minimum supported releases
signals.title_zh: Codex 持续测试 Exec-server 对当前、稳定版与最低支持版本的兼容性
signals.summary: Codex adds Bazel tests that run a shared Noise relay compatibility suite in both app-server/exec-server directions against the current build, stable release 0.149.1 and minimum supported 0.145.0 on Linux x86-64.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 新增 Bazel 测试，在 App-server/Exec-server 双向运行共享 Noise Relay 兼容性套件，覆盖当前构建、稳定版 0.149.1 与最低支持版 0.145.0（Linux x86-64）。

signals.title: Google ADK makes detached dynamic-node failure or interruption fail the enclosing workflow
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 让 Detached Dynamic Node 的失败或中断使所属 Workflow 失败
signals.summary: ADK now awaits detached dynamic-node runs that remain in flight after static graph work completes and propagates their failures or interruptions instead of allowing the workflow to report success while detached work failed.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 现在会在 Static Graph 工作完成后等待仍在运行的 Detached Dynamic Node，并传播其 Failure 或 Interruption，不再允许 Detached Work 已失败而 Workflow 仍报告成功。

signals.title: Google ADK resolves function responses against the invocation that actually issued each tool call
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 按实际发起 Tool Call 的 Invocation 解析 Function Response
signals.summary: ADK's node path now resolves each function response against the invocation that issued its call, preventing a caller-supplied invocation id from silently discarding tool results and detecting responses that straddle multiple invocations.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 的 Node Path 现在将每个 Function Response 解析到实际发起该调用的 Invocation，避免 Caller-supplied Invocation ID 导致 Tool Result 被静默丢弃，并能检测跨多个 Invocation 的 Response。

signals.title: Google ADK prevents RunConfig HTTP option copies from crashing or leaking mutable state across invocations
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 防止复制 RunConfig HTTP Option 时崩溃或跨 Invocation 泄漏可变状态
signals.summary: ADK replaces unsafe deep copies of RunConfig.http_options with mutation-specific copies, sharing live clients by reference but copying mutable containers so callbacks cannot mutate the caller's RunConfig and leak state into later runs.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 用面向实际修改项的 Copy 替代对 RunConfig.http_options 的不安全 Deep Copy：Live Client 保持引用共享，但可变容器独立复制，避免 Callback 修改 Caller RunConfig 并把状态泄漏到后续运行。

signals.title: Google ADK redacts credentials from DebugLoggingPlugin output files
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 从 DebugLoggingPlugin 输出文件中脱敏凭据
signals.summary: ADK changes DebugLoggingPlugin output-file handling to redact credentials, tightening the boundary between observability artifacts and secret material.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 修改 DebugLoggingPlugin 的输出文件处理，对凭据进行脱敏，收紧可观测性 Artifact 与 Secret Material 之间的边界。

signals.title: Google ADK forces nested AgentTool runs into unary mode so tool results cannot end on a partial stream chunk
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 强制嵌套 AgentTool 使用 Unary Mode，避免 Tool Result 以 Partial Stream Chunk 结束
signals.summary: ADK makes AgentTool nested agents run with StreamingMode.NONE because nested events are not forwarded; the tool response now uses a complete final content value rather than risking a partial last streaming chunk.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 让 AgentTool 的嵌套 Agent 使用 StreamingMode.NONE，因为嵌套事件本就不会向调用方转发；Tool Response 因此使用完整最终内容，不再可能只拿到最后一个 Partial Streaming Chunk。

signals.title: Claude Code sub-agents now use the session fallback model chain after a first-call model 404
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 子 Agent 首次模型调用 404 后改用会话回退模型链
signals.summary: A sub-agent no longer dies immediately on a first-call model 404; it follows the session fallback chain and returns structured error identity to the parent.
signals.summary_zh: 子 Agent 不再因首次模型调用 404 立即终止，而是沿用会话回退模型链，并向父 Agent 返回结构化错误身份。

signals.title: Claude Code background sessions detect dead terminal hosts and expose restartable failure state
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 后台会话可识别终端宿主死亡并暴露可重启失败状态
signals.summary: Background sessions that lose their terminal host now fail within seconds with a reason and can be restarted instead of remaining indefinitely in an opening state.
signals.summary_zh: 后台会话失去终端宿主后会在数秒内以明确原因失败，并允许重启，不再长期停留在 opening 状态。

signals.title: Claude Code resumed cloud sessions now report work lost across container restarts
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 云会话在容器重启后恢复时会报告丢失工作
signals.summary: When a cloud-session container restarts between turns while background work is active, the resumed session reports the lost work instead of silently continuing.
signals.summary_zh: 云会话在后台任务运行期间发生跨轮次容器重启后，恢复会话会明确报告丢失的工作，而不是静默继续。

signals.title: Claude Code self-hosted runners no longer report running before the agent process starts
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 自托管 Runner 不再在 Agent 进程启动前提前报告 running
signals.summary: Runner state now waits for Claude Code startup, preventing downstream clients from acting on a false running state and issuing premature waiting-for-input notifications.
signals.summary_zh: Runner 状态现在等待 Claude Code 真正启动，避免下游客户端基于虚假的 running 状态提前发出等待输入通知。

signals.title: Claude Code tells the model when configured MCP servers fail to connect
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 会向模型显式告知已配置 MCP Server 连接失败
signals.summary: For Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and telemetry-disabled sessions, configured MCP connection failures are surfaced to Claude rather than being misinterpreted as missing tools.
signals.summary_zh: 在 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 以及关闭遥测的会话中，已配置 MCP 的连接失败会显式暴露给 Claude，避免被误判为工具不存在。

signals.title: Claude Code organization sign-in enforcement now fails closed when managed settings are unreadable
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 组织登录强制策略在托管设置不可读时改为 fail-closed
signals.summary: Organization sign-in enforcement exits at startup when administrator-managed settings cannot be read, even if less-authoritative host or user registry settings exist.
signals.summary_zh: 当管理员托管设置不可读取时，组织登录强制策略会在启动阶段退出，即使存在权限较低的宿主或用户注册表设置也不继续运行。

signals.title: Codex Guardian accepts invoked user skills as authorization evidence only from verified trusted roots
signals.title_zh: Codex Guardian 仅对经验证可信根目录中的已调用用户 Skill 接受授权证据
signals.summary: Guardian records explicit and implicit user-skill invocation, passes only canonical verified paths under trusted user roots, and keeps repository skills or escaping symlinks untrusted.
signals.summary_zh: Guardian 记录显式与隐式用户 Skill 调用，只传递可信用户根目录下经验证的规范路径，并继续把仓库 Skill 和逃逸符号链接视为不可信。

signals.title: Codex attaches verified account access context only to eligible plugin MCP calls
signals.title_zh: Codex 仅向符合条件的插件 MCP 调用附加经验证的账户访问上下文
signals.summary: Account-bound entitlement context is host-owned, timeout-bounded and attached only to narrowly eligible local read-only plugin MCP calls; caller-supplied context is rejected.
signals.summary_zh: 账户绑定的 entitlement 上下文由宿主拥有、受超时约束，并只附加到严格符合条件的本地只读插件 MCP 调用；调用方自带上下文会被拒绝。

signals.title: Codex filesystem policy matching moves to URI-native semantics and fails closed on ambiguous boundaries
signals.title_zh: Codex 文件系统策略匹配改用 URI 原生语义，并在边界歧义时 fail-closed
signals.summary: Filesystem policy entries and special roots are resolved as PathUri values using executor path conventions, with validated components and fail-closed handling for ambiguous containment boundaries.
signals.summary_zh: 文件系统策略条目与特殊根目录改为按执行器路径约定解析为 PathUri，并使用经验证的组件判断包含关系；边界歧义时直接 fail-closed。

signals.title: Codex managed proxy listener handoff removes filesystem socket exposure and binds bridge lifetime to the sandbox
signals.title_zh: Codex 托管代理 Listener 交接移除文件系统 Socket 暴露，并将桥接生命周期绑定到 Sandbox
signals.summary: Linux managed networking transfers loopback listeners over anonymous socket pairs, validates descriptors, isolates bootstrap channels per sandbox and closes active upstream connections on cancellation.
signals.summary_zh: Linux 托管网络通过匿名 Socket Pair 转移回环 Listener，校验描述符、按 Sandbox 隔离启动通道，并在取消时关闭活跃上游连接。

signals.title: Codex standalone tool outputs become durable turn inputs and survive thread resume
signals.title_zh: Codex 独立 Tool Output 成为持久 Turn 输入并可跨 Thread Resume 保留
signals.summary: turn/start can accept named function-call outputs without user input, persist them as functionCallOutput items and include them in resumed thread history with validation limits.
signals.summary_zh: turn/start 可在没有用户输入时接收具名函数输出，将其持久化为 functionCallOutput，并在恢复线程历史时保留，同时执行输入校验与大小限制。

signals.title: Codex introduces fresh approval before writing input to escalated terminals
signals.title_zh: Codex 为向提权终端写入输入引入新的逐次审批
signals.summary: A feature-gated writeStdin approval path requires fresh approval before nonempty input is sent to an escalated terminal and revalidates process identity after approval.
signals.summary_zh: 新的 writeStdin 审批路径可要求在向提权终端发送非空输入前获得新审批，并在审批后重新核验进程身份。

signals.title: Codex exposes MCP call provenance to tool lifecycle extensions
signals.title_zh: Codex 向 Tool Lifecycle Extension 暴露 MCP 调用来源身份
signals.summary: Tool lifecycle callbacks receive model-visible MCP identity and source classification for connectors, configured servers and plugins, while the executable client remains hidden.
signals.summary_zh: Tool Lifecycle 回调可获得模型可见的 MCP 工具身份与来源分类，区分 Connector、配置 Server 与 Plugin，同时不暴露可执行客户端。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK rejects unpaired function outputs in Chat Completions
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 在 Chat Completions 中拒绝未配对的函数输出
signals.summary: The Agents SDK now rejects function outputs that have no matching function call in the Chat Completions path, tightening conversation/tool state integrity.
signals.summary_zh: Agents SDK 在 Chat Completions 路径中拒绝没有对应函数调用的函数输出，从而收紧对话与工具状态完整性。

signals.title: Gemini CLI hardens MCP OAuth metadata discovery against SSRF
signals.title_zh: Gemini CLI 加固 MCP OAuth 元数据发现以防止 SSRF
signals.summary: Gemini CLI merged a security fix preventing SSRF during MCP OAuth metadata discovery and authentication.
signals.summary_zh: Gemini CLI 合并了针对 MCP OAuth 元数据发现与认证阶段 SSRF 的安全修复。

signals.title: Google ADK reports unknown tool names to the model instead of raising out of the runtime
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 将未知工具名反馈给模型，而不是从运行时直接抛出异常
signals.summary: An unknown tool name is converted into model-visible feedback rather than escaping as a runtime exception, preserving the agent loop's ability to recover.
signals.summary_zh: 未知工具名会转换为模型可见反馈，而不是作为运行时异常逸出，从而保留 Agent 循环自我恢复的机会。

signals.title: Google ADK fixes hot reload of changed agents
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 修复变更后 Agent 的热重载
signals.summary: ADK corrected agent reload behavior after an agent definition changes, reducing stale execution state during iterative development.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 修复 Agent 定义变化后的重载行为，减少迭代开发中的陈旧执行状态。

signals.title: Google ADK normalizes session identifiers before duplicate checks
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 在重复检查前规范化 Session ID
signals.summary: The in-memory session service now normalizes session_id before detecting duplicates, strengthening identity consistency in session state.
signals.summary_zh: 内存 Session Service 现在会在重复检测前规范化 session_id，从而加强会话状态中的身份一致性。

signals.title: Google ADK workflow retry policy now includes subclasses of configured retry exceptions
signals.title_zh: Google ADK Workflow Retry 策略现覆盖已配置重试异常的子类
signals.summary: Workflow retry classification now treats subclasses of configured retry exceptions as retryable, aligning runtime behavior with exception inheritance.
signals.summary_zh: Workflow 重试分类现在会把已配置重试异常的子类也视为可重试，使运行行为与异常继承关系一致。

signals.title: Google ADK ParallelAgent stops early only on escalation from a direct sub-agent
signals.title_zh: Google ADK ParallelAgent 仅在直接子 Agent 升级时提前结束
signals.summary: ParallelAgent early termination is now scoped to escalation by a direct sub-agent, tightening propagation boundaries in multi-agent control flow.
signals.summary_zh: ParallelAgent 的提前终止现在仅由直接子 Agent 的升级触发，收紧多 Agent 控制流中的升级传播边界。

signals.title: Google ADK prevents temporary-file cleanup failures from masking primary upload errors
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 防止临时文件清理失败掩盖主要上传错误
signals.summary: Cleanup of a temporary memory-upload file no longer replaces the original upload failure, preserving causal failure identity.
signals.summary_zh: Memory 上传临时文件的清理失败不再覆盖原始上传失败，从而保留真实的因果失败身份。

signals.title: Codex enables retained-image context budgeting by default during remote compaction
signals.title_zh: Codex 在远程 Compaction 中默认启用保留图片的上下文预算
signals.summary: Retained images are now charged against the remote compaction context budget by default and older images are trimmed as required.
signals.summary_zh: 远程 Compaction 现在默认把保留图片计入上下文预算，并在需要时裁剪较旧图片。

2026-08-28.reason: All three Discovery pipelines resolved their due P0 coverage. Twenty-six material same-day signals were normalized without topic selection: ten AI-platform signals and sixteen GitHub-engineering signals; no same-day published-research object met the retention threshold.
2026-08-28.reason_zh: 三条 Discovery 管线均完成 P0 到期来源覆盖。本日规范化保留 26 个实质性同日信号，未执行选题：AI 平台 10 个、GitHub 工程 16 个；论文与研究成果管线没有发现达到保留阈值的同日研究对象。

pipelines.label_zh: AI 平台变更情报发现
pipelines.reason: All 45 due public P0 platform channels were checked. Claude Code v2.1.248, published during the run date, supplied the retained same-day platform mechanisms; v2.1.250 contained only generic bug-fix wording and produced no additional retained mechanism.
pipelines.reason_zh: 45 个到期 P0 公共平台通道全部完成检查。运行日发布的 Claude Code v2.1.248 提供了本次保留的平台机制；v2.1.250 仅给出通用 Bug Fix 描述，没有形成额外可保留机制。

pipelines.label: GitHub Engineering Intelligence
pipelines.label_zh: GitHub 工程情报发现
pipelines.reason: All nine P0 daily repositories were checked incrementally from the prior-day checkpoint. Retained mechanisms came from OpenAI Codex, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK and GitHub Copilot CLI; Claude Code changes were deduplicated into the AI-platform release object, while Gemini CLI and both MCP SDKs plus A2A had no retained same-day change.
pipelines.reason_zh: 9 个 P0 Daily 仓库均从前一日检查点完成增量检查。保留机制来自 OpenAI Codex、OpenAI Agents SDK、Google ADK 与 GitHub Copilot CLI；Claude Code 变化已去重并归入 AI Platform Release 对象，Gemini CLI、两个 MCP SDK 与 A2A 本日没有保留的同日变化。

pipelines.reason_zh: 9 个 P0 研究来源全部收口：8 个已检查，1 个明确记录抓取失败；未发现发表于运行日且达到保留阈值的实质研究对象。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.reason: Discovery recorded five primary Industry Architecture signals; Queue owns scoring and selection.
columns.reason_zh: Discovery 记录了 5 个以行业架构为主栏目的信号；评分与选题由 Queue 独立负责。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.reason: Discovery recorded ten primary Open-source Engineering signals; Queue owns scoring and selection.
columns.reason_zh: Discovery 记录了 10 个以开源工程为主栏目的信号；评分与选题由 Queue 独立负责。

signals.title: Claude Code restricted mode removes execution tools and ignores lower-authority settings
signals.title_zh: Claude Code Restricted Mode 移除执行工具并忽略低权限设置
signals.summary: The new restricted mode removes built-in command/code tools and WebFetch unless explicitly named, keeps file tools inside the working directory, refuses bypassPermissions, and ignores user/project/local settings files.
signals.summary_zh: 新的 Restricted Mode 默认移除命令/代码执行工具与 WebFetch（除非显式允许），把文件工具限制在工作目录内，拒绝 bypassPermissions，并忽略用户、项目与本地设置文件。

signals.title: Claude Code adds cross-session messaging across local sessions
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 新增本机跨会话消息传递
signals.summary: SendMessage and ListAgents now support communication between sessions on the same machine on Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry and when telemetry is disabled, creating an explicit cross-session coordination surface.
signals.summary_zh: SendMessage 与 ListAgents 现在可在 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 以及关闭遥测的环境中支持同机不同会话之间通信，形成显式跨会话协作面。

signals.title: Claude Code preserves prompt-cache and extended-thinking continuity across OAuth refresh
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 在 OAuth 刷新后保持 Prompt Cache 与 Extended-thinking 连续性
signals.summary: Tool definitions are no longer re-rendered after OAuth token refresh in a way that periodically caused a prompt-cache miss and loss of extended-thinking context in long sessions.
signals.summary_zh: OAuth Token Refresh 后不再因工具定义重新渲染而周期性触发 Prompt Cache Miss 与 Extended-thinking 上下文丢失，改善长会话连续性。

signals.title: Claude Code stabilizes ScheduleWakeup identity across resume and usage-overage state
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 在 Resume 与用量超额状态间稳定 ScheduleWakeup 身份
signals.summary: The ScheduleWakeup tool definition no longer changes between a session and its resume solely because the account entered usage overage, preventing a full first-turn prompt-cache miss after resume.
signals.summary_zh: 账户进入用量超额后，ScheduleWakeup 工具定义不再在原会话与 Resume 之间发生无关变化，避免恢复后的首轮完整 Prompt Cache Miss。

signals.title: Claude Code stops resurrecting stale background sessions after host downtime
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 不再在宿主长时间离线后复活陈旧后台会话
signals.summary: Agent view now preserves a stale background session's real end state after the machine was off and asks before resuming its saved conversation instead of implicitly resurrecting it.
signals.summary_zh: 机器长时间离线后，Agent View 会保留陈旧后台会话的真实结束状态，并在恢复已保存对话前询问，而不是隐式复活旧会话。

signals.title: Claude Code surfaces invalid hook answers instead of leaving background sessions silently waiting
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 对无效 Hook 回答显式报错，不再让后台会话静默等待
signals.summary: When PermissionRequest or PreToolUse hooks return an invalid answer, background sessions now name the failing hook and schema error instead of remaining silently waiting.
signals.summary_zh: PermissionRequest 或 PreToolUse Hook 返回无效回答时，后台会话会显示具体 Hook 与 Schema Error，不再静默停在等待状态。

signals.title: Claude Code retries headersHelper authentication before falling into OAuth discovery
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 在进入 OAuth Discovery 前先重试 headersHelper 认证
signals.summary: An MCP server whose headersHelper supplies Authorization now re-runs the helper and retries after a 401 instead of incorrectly entering OAuth discovery.
signals.summary_zh: 当 MCP Server 的 headersHelper 提供 Authorization Header 时，401 后会重新运行 Helper 并重试，而不是错误进入 OAuth Discovery。

signals.title: Claude Code background sessions now hold worktree locks while running
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 后台会话运行期间持有 Worktree Lock
signals.summary: A backgrounded worktree session retains the worktree lock for its lifetime so cleanup and git worktree remove cannot detach its active checkout.
signals.summary_zh: 后台 Worktree 会话在运行期间持续持有 Worktree Lock，使清理流程与 git worktree remove 不会移除其正在使用的 Checkout。

signals.title: Claude Code treats invalid cross-session inbound policy as a governed hold or refusal
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 将无效跨会话入站策略处理为受治理的 Hold 或 Refusal
signals.summary: Invalid crossSessionInbound values are no longer silently ignored: user settings warn and hold messages, while managed settings refuse inbound messages until corrected.
signals.summary_zh: 无效 crossSessionInbound 值不再被静默忽略：用户设置会告警并暂存消息，Managed Settings 则在修复前拒绝入站消息。

signals.title: Claude Code Remote Control restores permission and message visibility after silent reconnect
signals.title_zh: Claude Code Remote Control 在静默重连后恢复权限提示与消息可见性
signals.summary: Remote Control sessions no longer intermittently lose permission prompts or the latest messages on the connected device after the CLI silently reconnects.
signals.summary_zh: CLI 静默重连后，Remote Control Session 不再偶发丢失已连接设备上的权限提示或最新消息，改善远程协作状态连续性。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK recovers resumed handoffs after session append failures
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 在 Session Append 失败后恢复已 Resume 的 Handoff
signals.summary: The session path now recovers resumed agent handoffs when appending session state fails, strengthening recovery across a handoff persistence boundary.
signals.summary_zh: Session Path 现在能在追加 Session State 失败时恢复已 Resume 的 Agent Handoff，强化 Handoff 持久化边界上的恢复能力。

signals.title: Codex applies plugin app/MCP routing policy to unauthenticated reads
signals.title_zh: Codex 对未认证 Plugin Read 同样应用 App/MCP Routing Policy
signals.summary: Unauthenticated plugin reads now still apply the app/MCP routing policy, omitting unavailable app declarations while retaining valid MCP alternatives instead of exposing a capability set disconnected from authentication state.
signals.summary_zh: 未认证 Plugin Read 现在也应用 App/MCP Routing Policy：不可用 App Declaration 会被移除，但有效 MCP Alternative 仍被保留，避免 Capability Set 与认证状态脱节。

signals.title: Codex retries only confirmed remote registration conflicts while preserving identity and session state
signals.title_zh: Codex 仅重试已确认的远端注册冲突，并保留身份与 Session State
signals.summary: Remote environment registration now retries only explicit registration_conflict responses with jittered backoff, keeps waits cancellable, and preserves Noise identity plus initialized session state across successful recovery.
signals.summary_zh: Remote Environment Registration 仅对明确 registration_conflict 响应执行带抖动退避的重试，等待过程可取消，并在成功恢复时保留 Noise Identity 与已初始化 Session State。

signals.title: Codex aligns deny-read policy matching with executor path semantics and fails closed on ambiguity
signals.title_zh: Codex 将 Deny-read Policy 与 Executor Path Semantics 对齐，并对歧义 Fail Closed
signals.summary: Read-deny roots and globs are now prepared using the target executor's path convention, with fail-closed behavior for malformed paths, incompatible conventions, unresolved home-relative patterns and invalid globs.
signals.summary_zh: Read-deny Root 与 Glob 现在按目标 Executor 的 Path Convention 解析；Malformed Path、Path Convention 不兼容、Home-relative Pattern 无法解析或 Glob 无效时均 Fail Closed。

signals.title: Codex lets extensions inspect or replace MCP results before completion publication
signals.title_zh: Codex 允许 Extension 在 MCP Completion 发布前检查或替换结果
signals.summary: A new MCP result lifecycle contributor runs before completion publication and model-input preparation, giving extensions bounded access to executed-tool context and mutable success/error results.
signals.summary_zh: 新的 MCP Result Lifecycle Contributor 在 Completion 发布与 Model Input 准备之前运行，使 Extension 可在有界上下文中检查并修改成功或错误结果。

signals.title: Codex makes optional MCP startup grace explicit and runtime-refreshable
signals.title_zh: Codex 将 Optional MCP Startup Grace 显式化并支持运行时刷新
signals.summary: Optional MCP server catalog capture now has a configurable shared startup grace with explicit disable semantics and refreshable deadlines, making waiting behavior a governed runtime parameter rather than a hidden fixed delay.
signals.summary_zh: Optional MCP Server 的 Catalog Capture 现在具有可配置共享 Startup Grace、显式禁用语义与可刷新 Deadline，使等待行为成为受治理 Runtime 参数，而不是隐藏固定延迟。

signals.title: Codex binds cached Guardian approvals to current authorization state
signals.title_zh: Codex 将缓存的 Guardian Approval 绑定到当前授权状态
signals.summary: Cached Guardian classifications are now tied to current local and root authorization state so a stale risk score cannot continue authorizing an action after its governing authority changes.
signals.summary_zh: 缓存的 Guardian Classification 现在绑定当前 Local 与 Root Authorization State，避免 Governing Authority 变化后旧 Risk Score 继续授权动作。

signals.title: Codex preserves restored permission profiles and rejects lossy sandbox projections
signals.title_zh: Codex 保留恢复后的 Permission Profile，并拒绝有损 Sandbox Projection
signals.summary: Restored app-server threads keep their original permission profiles instead of projecting them into potentially lossy legacy sandbox modes; directory changes are rejected when safe representation is impossible.
signals.summary_zh: 恢复的 App-server Thread 保留原始 Permission Profile，而不是投影为可能有损的 Legacy Sandbox Mode；无法安全表示时会拒绝目录切换。

signals.title: Codex accounts descendant subagent token use against the root goal budget
signals.title_zh: Codex 将后代 Subagent Token 使用计入 Root Goal Budget
signals.summary: Token use by children and nested subagents is now rolled into the active root goal during active and idle accounting, so delegation cannot escape the governing goal's token budget.
signals.summary_zh: Child 与 Nested Subagent 的 Token 使用现在会在 Active 与 Idle Accounting 中汇总到当前 Root Goal，使委派无法绕开根目标的 Token Budget。

signals.title: Google ADK prevents child-branch user events from moving the invocation root
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 阻止子分支 User Event 移动 Invocation Root
signals.summary: A user event stamped on a child branch can no longer move the invocation root, tightening ownership and lineage semantics across branched workflows.
signals.summary_zh: 标记在 Child Branch 上的 User Event 不再能够移动 Invocation Root，强化分支 Workflow 中的 Ownership 与 Lineage 语义。

signals.title: Google ADK preserves upstream HTTP status and details in workflow node failures
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 在 Workflow Node Failure 中保留上游 HTTP Status 与 Details
signals.summary: Workflow failures now propagate upstream canonical status and details such as PERMISSION_DENIED instead of replacing them with Python exception class names, preserving failure causality for downstream recovery.
signals.summary_zh: Workflow Failure 现在传播上游规范 Status 与 Details（如 PERMISSION_DENIED），而不是用 Python Exception Class Name 覆盖，从而为后续恢复保留 Failure Causality。

signals.title: Google ADK preserves Gemini thought signatures through interaction history
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 在 Interaction History 中保留 Gemini Thought Signature
signals.summary: Opaque Gemini 3 thought signatures returned with function calls are now stored and echoed back verbatim in follow-up history, preserving protocol continuity required by the model.
signals.summary_zh: Gemini 3 随 Function Call 返回的 Opaque Thought Signature 现在会写入历史并在后续请求中原样回传，保持模型要求的协议连续性。

signals.title: GitHub Copilot CLI offers restoration for sessions left open by a crashed or vanished CLI
signals.title_zh: GitHub Copilot CLI 可恢复因 CLI 崩溃或消失而遗留的开放会话
signals.summary: Startup now offers to restore sessions that remained open when their CLI disappeared, turning crash or machine-restart recovery into an explicit session lifecycle path.
signals.summary_zh: 启动时现在会主动提供恢复 CLI 消失时仍处于 Open 状态的 Session，把 Crash 或机器重启后的恢复变成显式 Session Lifecycle Path。

signals.title: GitHub Copilot CLI exposes enterprise-policy-blocked MCP servers as Blocked instead of Pending
signals.title_zh: GitHub Copilot CLI 将企业策略阻止的 MCP Server 显示为 Blocked 而非 Pending
signals.summary: An MCP server denied by enterprise policy is now surfaced as blocked rather than spinning indefinitely as pending, aligning visible state with the governing policy outcome.
signals.summary_zh: 被 Enterprise Policy 拒绝的 MCP Server 现在显示为 Blocked，不再无限显示 Pending，使外部状态与治理策略结果一致。

signals.title: GitHub Copilot CLI forceRemoteSettingsRefresh now fails closed instead of using stale managed policy
signals.title_zh: GitHub Copilot CLI forceRemoteSettingsRefresh 改为 Fail Closed，不再回退旧 Managed Policy
signals.summary: When forceRemoteSettingsRefresh is enabled, cached managed policy is no longer served as a fetch-failure fallback; until fresh policy is fetched, the session uses a restrictive undetermined-policy posture.
signals.summary_zh: 启用 forceRemoteSettingsRefresh 后，缓存 Managed Policy 不再作为 Fetch Failure Fallback；获取新 Policy 前，Session 采用受限的 Undetermined-policy Posture。

signals.title: GitHub Copilot CLI preserves subagent hook lifecycle events in child and parent sessions
signals.title_zh: GitHub Copilot CLI 在子会话与父会话中保留 Subagent Hook Lifecycle Event
signals.summary: Hook start/end events produced inside a subagent are now recorded on that subagent session and re-emitted on the parent instead of being dropped on an internal session boundary.
signals.summary_zh: Subagent 内产生的 Hook Start/End Event 现在会记录在该 Subagent Session，并重新发射到 Parent，不再在 Internal Session Boundary 上丢失。

signals.title: Claude Code adds governed model-switch hooks and resume staleness context
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 新增受治理的模型切换 Hook 与恢复陈旧度上下文
signals.summary: Model-switch hooks can block, confirm or annotate transitions, while resume hooks expose session staleness and re-cache cost as explicit control facts.
signals.summary_zh: 模型切换 Hook 可阻止、确认或标注转换；恢复 Hook 同时暴露会话陈旧度与重新缓存成本，使其成为显式控制事实。

signals.title: Claude Code closes symlink-swap TOCTOU gaps in file permissions
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 封堵文件权限检查后的 Symlink Swap TOCTOU 缺口
signals.summary: Read, Write and Edit no longer follow a symlink swapped after permission validation, preventing post-check path mutation from escaping the approved file boundary.
signals.summary_zh: Read、Write、Edit 不再跟随权限校验后被替换的符号链接，避免通过校验后的路径变更逃逸已批准文件边界。

signals.title: Claude Code rejects plugin command paths outside the plugin directory
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 拒绝逃逸插件目录的插件命令路径
signals.summary: Marketplace plugin commands are rejected when their path resolves outside the plugin directory, enforcing a concrete path boundary.
signals.summary_zh: Marketplace 插件命令如果路径解析到插件目录之外会被拒绝，从而强制实施明确路径边界。

signals.title: Claude Code prevents lower-scope tracing settings from bypassing managed telemetry policy
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 阻止低权限追踪设置绕过托管遥测策略
signals.summary: Project tracing and raw-body logging can no longer bypass higher-authority managed telemetry settings or a host-pinned OTLP collector.
signals.summary_zh: 项目级追踪与原始 Body Logging 不再能绕过更高权限的托管遥测设置或宿主固定的 OTLP Collector。

signals.title: Claude Code delivers teammate final answers as explicit team-lead completion messages
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 将队友最终答复作为显式完成消息送达 Team Lead
signals.summary: A teammate final answer now reaches the team lead instead of degrading to a content-free availability notice, separating worker availability from work completion.
signals.summary_zh: 队友最终答复现在会送达 Team Lead，不再退化成无内容的可用通知，从而区分 Worker 可用与工作完成。

signals.title: Claude Code bounds lost MCP handshake acknowledgments to one failed server
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 将丢失的 MCP Handshake ACK 限定为单 Server 有界失败
signals.summary: Lost SDK MCP handshake acknowledgments now time out after 70 seconds and fail only that server instead of hanging the whole session indefinitely.
signals.summary_zh: SDK MCP Handshake ACK 丢失时现在会在 70 秒后超时，并且只失败该 Server，不再让整个 Session 无限挂起。

signals.title: Claude Code routes Chrome browser actions through one permission boundary
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 将 Chrome 浏览器动作统一纳入同一权限边界
signals.summary: Chrome browser actions now always pass through Claude Code permission checks, removing a separate extension-local authorization path.
signals.summary_zh: Chrome 浏览器动作现在始终经过 Claude Code 权限检查，移除了独立的扩展本地授权路径。

signals.title: Claude Code approval-gates managed settings that weaken sandbox or inject sensitive headers
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 对削弱 Sandbox 或注入敏感 Header 的托管设置强制审批
signals.summary: Managed settings that weaken sandbox isolation, inject credentials or set sensitive routing headers now require explicit approval before taking effect.
signals.summary_zh: 削弱 Sandbox 隔离、注入凭据或设置敏感路由 Header 的托管设置现在必须经过显式审批后才能生效。

signals.title: Codex answers bounded terminal queries so PTY subprocesses cannot hang waiting for the TTY
signals.title_zh: Codex 对 Terminal Query 提供有界响应，避免 PTY 子进程等待终端而挂死
signals.summary: Codex intercepts common PTY terminal queries and writes bounded responses back to subprocess input, including queries split across chunks.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 拦截常见 PTY Terminal Query，并向子进程输入写回有界响应，也能处理跨 Chunk 的查询。

signals.title: Codex runs cleanup hooks for interrupted turns with turn-local context
signals.title_zh: Codex 在 Turn 被中断时运行 Cleanup Hook，并绑定本 Turn 上下文
signals.summary: Executor cleanup hooks now observe Interrupt as well as Stop and use the interrupted turn's own last-step discovery and metadata instead of stale prior-turn context.
signals.summary_zh: Executor Cleanup Hook 现在同时观察 Interrupt 与 Stop，并使用被中断 Turn 自己的最后 Step Discovery 与元数据，而不是陈旧的前一 Turn 上下文。

signals.title: Codex retains the selected StepContext across completion and interruption
signals.title_zh: Codex 在完成与中断后保留已选择的 StepContext
signals.summary: Active turns keep the most recently selected StepContext through completion or interruption while speculative fallback captures cannot overwrite it unless selected.
signals.summary_zh: Active Turn 在完成或中断后保留最近真正选中的 StepContext；推测性 Fallback Capture 除非被选用，否则不能覆盖它。

signals.title: Codex reconstructs nested-agent context from surviving full baselines
signals.title_zh: Codex 从保留的完整 Baseline 重建嵌套 Agent 上下文
signals.summary: A surviving full world-state snapshot can restore nested-agent settings and reference context, while partial or superseded snapshots are rejected.
signals.summary_zh: 保留的完整 World-state Snapshot 可恢复嵌套 Agent 的设置与 Reference Context，而 Partial 或已被替代的 Snapshot 会被拒绝。

signals.title: Codex builds a shared Guardian transcript with role and tool provenance
signals.title_zh: Codex 构建共享 Guardian Transcript，并保留角色与 Tool Provenance
signals.summary: Guardian review now uses a reusable transcript collector that preserves conversation order and role/tool attribution across synchronous and asynchronous review paths.
signals.summary_zh: Guardian Review 现在使用共享 Transcript Collector，在同步与异步 Review 路径之间保留对话顺序以及 Role/Tool Attribution。

signals.title: Codex persists the strictest per-tool MCP output budget across resume
signals.title_zh: Codex 将最严格的单 Tool MCP 输出预算持久贯穿 Resume
signals.summary: Overlapping MCP output policies resolve to the strictest per-tool token budget and persist the effective limit into history for hooks and resumed sessions.
signals.summary_zh: 重叠的 MCP 输出策略采用最严格的单 Tool Token Budget，并把有效限制写入历史，供 Hook 与 Resume Session 一致使用。

signals.title: Codex restricts cloud-task credentials to trusted origins with redirects disabled
signals.title_zh: Codex 将 Cloud-task 凭据限制在可信 Origin，并禁用重定向
signals.summary: Saved ChatGPT credentials are loaded only for validated HTTPS origins on port 443 with redirects disabled and ambiguous URL components rejected.
signals.summary_zh: 已保存 ChatGPT 凭据只会为通过验证的 443 HTTPS Origin 加载，同时禁用 Redirect，并拒绝含糊 URL 组件。

signals.title: Codex keeps managed one-shot execution without retained-process authority
signals.title_zh: Codex 在托管模式保留 One-shot Exec，但不暴露 Retained-process 权限
signals.summary: When managed policy disables resumable execution, exec_command remains completion-only with TTY/session/write-stdin removed and bounded timeout/cancellation termination.
signals.summary_zh: 托管策略禁用可恢复执行时，exec_command 只保留一次性完成模式，移除 TTY/Session/write-stdin，并由有界 Timeout/Cancel 负责终止。

signals.title: Codex gives Guardian classifications stable retry identity and explicit lineage
signals.title_zh: Codex 为 Guardian Classification 提供稳定重试身份与显式 Lineage
signals.summary: Guardian classifications now keep a UUIDv7 turn identity across retries, link known parent/root turns, and omit ambiguous root lineage instead of inventing it.
signals.summary_zh: Guardian Classification 现在跨重试保持 UUIDv7 Turn Identity，关联已知 Parent/Root Turn，并在 Root Lineage 不明确时省略而不是臆造。

signals.title: Google ADK terminates the full local process tree on command timeout
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 在本地命令超时时终止完整 Process Tree
signals.summary: ADK command timeout handling now terminates the entire local process tree so child processes cannot outlive the bounded command lifecycle.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 命令超时处理现在会终止整个本地 Process Tree，避免子进程越过有界命令生命周期继续存活。

signals.title: Google ADK resolves HITL interrupts by exact branch run identity
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 以精确 Branch Run Identity 解析 HITL Interrupt
signals.summary: Human-in-the-loop interrupt resolution now matches exact branch run IDs, tightening approval and resume binding to the intended branch execution.
signals.summary_zh: Human-in-the-loop Interrupt 解析现在精确匹配 Branch Run ID，把审批与 Resume 更严格地绑定到预期分支执行。

signals.title: Google ADK stops advertising run_skill_script when no executor exists
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 在无 Executor 时不再宣告 run_skill_script 能力
signals.summary: SkillToolset withholds run_skill_script and its prompt guidance unless an actual code executor is available, preventing false capability promises.
signals.summary_zh: 除非实际存在 Code Executor，SkillToolset 不再注册 run_skill_script 或提供其 Prompt 指导，避免虚假能力承诺。

signals.title: Gemini CLI makes workspace trust fail closed and filters MCP in restricted mode
signals.title_zh: Gemini CLI 将 Workspace Trust 改为 Fail-closed，并在 Restricted Mode 过滤 MCP
signals.summary: Gemini CLI now enforces fail-closed workspace trust and filters MCP servers in restricted mode, coupling admission to the effective tool surface.
signals.summary_zh: Gemini CLI 现在对 Workspace Trust 执行 Fail-closed，并在 Restricted Mode 过滤 MCP Server，把准入与实际工具面绑定。

signals.title: MCP TypeScript SDK propagates taskId into Mcp-Name for task requests
signals.title_zh: MCP TypeScript SDK 将 taskId 传播到 Task Request 的 Mcp-Name
signals.summary: MCP task requests now mirror params.taskId into Mcp-Name, strengthening task identity propagation across the protocol request boundary.
signals.summary_zh: MCP Task Request 现在把 params.taskId 镜像到 Mcp-Name，加强任务身份在协议请求边界上的传播。
