signals.title: Codex restores thread cwd only from settings snapshots owned by the resumed thread
signals.title_zh: Codex 恢复线程 cwd 时只信任归属于被恢复线程的设置快照
signals.summary: Resume now records the owning thread ID on settings snapshots, ignores copied snapshots owned by another forked thread, and checkpoints current settings after compaction so restored cwd comes from accepted current state.
signals.summary_zh: 恢复流程现在在设置快照上记录所属线程 ID，忽略来自其他 Fork 线程的复制快照，并在压缩后重新检查点当前设置，使 cwd 恢复只来自已接纳的当前状态。

researchValue.failure: Forked or compacted histories can expose stale or foreign settings snapshots during resume.
researchValue.mechanism: Bind persisted settings snapshots to an owning thread, reject foreign ownership on replay, and serialize post-compaction checkpoints with settings updates.
researchValue.implication: Durable agent resume needs provenance-bearing state ownership, not merely a latest-value lookup.

signals.title: Codex separates diagnostic core-event delivery from retryable attachment delivery
signals.title_zh: Codex 将诊断核心事件交付与可重试附件交付分离
signals.summary: Diagnostic reports now persist a stable report ID, send the core event before attachments, bound payload sizes, and retry transient attachment failures under a shared budget without replaying the core event.
signals.summary_zh: 诊断报告现在持久化稳定 Report ID，先发送核心事件再发送附件，对载荷大小设界，并在共享预算内仅重试瞬时失败的附件而不重放核心事件。

researchValue.failure: A response-loss or attachment failure can otherwise cause whole-report replay, duplication, or unbounded payload behavior.
researchValue.mechanism: Use a stable report identity and split durable core-event acceptance from independently retryable bounded attachments.
researchValue.implication: Idempotency should be defined at each durable result boundary rather than at the outer request alone.

signals.title: Google ADK supports multi-turn nested HITL pause and resumption across workflows and agent tools
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 支持跨工作流与 Agent Tool 的多轮嵌套 HITL 暂停与恢复
signals.summary: ADK fixes nested human-in-the-loop workflows so a tool or sub-workflow can pause for human input and resume across multiple turns without losing the surrounding workflow state.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 修复了嵌套人机协同工作流，使 Tool 或子工作流能够为人工输入暂停，并在多轮之后恢复而不丢失外围工作流状态。

researchValue.failure: Nested HITL boundaries can lose continuation state or resume the wrong workflow frame across multiple turns.
researchValue.mechanism: Preserve nested pause/resume state across workflow and agent-tool boundaries.
researchValue.implication: Digital-employee approval cannot be modeled as a one-shot prompt; it needs durable continuation semantics.

signals.title: Google ADK labels dynamic instructions so models do not misread them as user turns
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 为动态指令标注来源，避免模型把它误读成用户轮次
signals.summary: ADK explicitly labels dynamic instruction content so the model does not interpret it as a user turn and imitate it, preserving the distinction between control instructions and conversational evidence.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 对动态指令内容进行显式标注，避免模型将其解释为用户轮次并模仿，从而保持控制指令与会话证据之间的来源边界。

researchValue.failure: Unlabeled control text can be interpreted as user-authored content, collapsing instruction provenance and authority.
researchValue.mechanism: Carry explicit role/provenance labels for dynamically injected instructions.
researchValue.implication: Agent control planes need typed source identity for context, not just ordered text concatenation.

signals.title: GitHub Copilot CLI fixes a worktree-switch race caused by concurrent user input
signals.title_zh: GitHub Copilot CLI 修复 Worktree 切换期间并发用户输入导致的状态竞争
signals.summary: Copilot CLI v1.0.82 reports that a message typed while /worktree or /move is preparing a worktree no longer breaks the switch, exposing a concrete transition-race boundary between interactive input and workspace state mutation.
signals.summary_zh: Copilot CLI v1.0.82 明确修复：在 /worktree 或 /move 准备 Worktree 时输入消息不再破坏切换，暴露了交互输入与工作区状态变更之间的真实转换竞争边界。

researchValue.failure: Concurrent user input during workspace preparation could corrupt or abort the intended worktree transition.
researchValue.mechanism: Serialize or otherwise guard interactive input against an in-flight workspace-state transition.
researchValue.implication: Agent runtime state transitions need explicit concurrency ownership even when the competing event is ordinary user input.

signals.title: ServiceNow can block deployment and tool visibility for unapproved MCP servers
signals.title_zh: ServiceNow 可阻止未审批 MCP Server 的部署与 Tool 可见性
signals.summary: AI Control Tower can require AI-steward approval before assets deploy and can block unapproved MCP servers from being used in AI Agent Studio, including preventing tool display until approval is granted.
signals.summary_zh: AI Control Tower 可要求 AI Steward 在资产部署前审批，并可阻止未审批 MCP Server 在 AI Agent Studio 中使用，包括在获批前不显示其 Tool。

researchValue.mechanism: Bind MCP server admission to an AI-steward-controlled approval state and enforce the decision before tool exposure/use.
researchValue.implication: Enterprise agent governance benefits from separating static tool discovery from governed admission into an execution environment.

signals.title: IBM turns agent evaluation metrics into continuous governance-enforcement evidence
signals.title_zh: IBM 将 Agent 评估指标转化为持续的治理执行证据
signals.summary: watsonx.governance Enforcement Tracking automatically imports agent evaluation metrics and records them as evidence that deployed agents are operating within defined policies.
signals.summary_zh: watsonx.governance Enforcement Tracking 会自动导入 Agent 评估指标，并把这些指标记录为已部署 Agent 是否在既定策略内运行的执行证据。

researchValue.finding: Governance policy can be linked to continuously collected operational evaluation evidence instead of remaining a static declaration.
researchValue.mechanism: Ingest agent evaluation metrics into the governance plane as enforcement-tracking evidence.
researchValue.implication: A digital-employee control plane can distinguish policy definition from independently inspectable proof of policy enforcement.

signals.title: LangGraph DeltaChannel bounds long-running checkpoint growth while preserving resume semantics
signals.title_zh: LangGraph DeltaChannel 在保持恢复语义的同时限制长运行 Checkpoint 增长
signals.summary: DeltaChannel stores per-step deltas with periodic full snapshots instead of repeatedly persisting full state, bounding resume latency while avoiding quadratic checkpoint growth for long-running agents.
signals.summary_zh: DeltaChannel 以逐步 Delta + 周期性完整快照替代每一步重复持久化完整状态，在避免长运行 Agent Checkpoint 二次方增长的同时限制恢复延迟。

researchValue.failure: Full-state checkpoints at every step can grow storage quadratically as long-running agent histories expand.
researchValue.mechanism: Persist incremental channel deltas and periodic full snapshots while retaining checkpoint-based resume and HITL semantics.
researchValue.implication: Durability design must scale storage cost independently from logical execution history length.

signals.title: AG2 places a human approval checkpoint between tool selection and sensitive tool execution
signals.title_zh: AG2 在 Tool 选择与敏感 Tool 执行之间设置人工审批检查点
signals.summary: AG2 approval_required middleware pauses a sensitive tool after the model selects it but before execution, asks the HITL hook for approval, and fails rather than silently proceeding when no human-input hook exists.
signals.summary_zh: AG2 的 approval_required Middleware 在模型选定敏感 Tool 后、实际执行前暂停，通过 HITL Hook 请求人工批准；缺少人工输入 Hook 时会失败而不是静默继续。

researchValue.mechanism: Insert an explicit human decision point after tool intent is known but before side effects execute; absence of the approval channel is fail-closed.
researchValue.implication: Call-time authorization should bind a concrete invocation and arguments, not merely a static tool permission.

signals.title: SARA separates action induction from runtime authorization and preserves action-origin provenance
signals.title_zh: SARA 分离 Action Induction 与运行时授权，并持久保存动作来源
signals.summary: SARA treats tool-output-induced actions and execution authorization as distinct runtime roles, persistently records action-origin provenance, authorizes calls only against user objectives plus audited successful execution evidence, and prevents history from laundering action origin into authority.
signals.summary_zh: SARA 将 Tool Output 诱导的动作与执行授权视为不同运行时角色，持久记录动作来源，只依据用户目标与经审计的成功执行证据授权调用，并阻止历史重复把动作来源“洗白”为执行权。

researchValue.failure: Untrusted tool observations can become implicit commands and induce side effects beyond the user's intent.
researchValue.finding: Across AgentDojo and AgentDyn, the proposed separation keeps reported attack success rate at or below 0.63% in four primary settings while maintaining competitive utility.
researchValue.mechanism: Separate induction from authorization, persist action-origin provenance, authorize against user intent and audited executions, and forbid history-based authority promotion.
researchValue.implication: Runtime evidence history should inform authorization without granting authority merely because an action has appeared before.

signals.title: Fabricated professional-looking evidence can raise agent commitment without changing belief
signals.title_zh: 伪造的专业外观证据可在几乎不改变信念的情况下显著提高 Agent 行动承诺
signals.summary: Across 12 frontier models, professional-looking evidence sharply raises commitment on provably unknowable questions even when every displayed number is fabricated; stated probabilities barely move, locating the failure in the act/don't-act gate rather than belief calibration.
signals.summary_zh: 在 12 个前沿模型上，专业外观证据会显著提高模型对本质不可预测问题的行动承诺，即使面板上的数字全部伪造；而模型陈述概率几乎不变，说明失败集中在“行动/不行动”门禁而非信念校准。

researchValue.failure: Authoritative-looking but non-informative evidence can push an agent to act on unknowable questions.
researchValue.finding: Commitment rises from 6.5% to 54.0% across the evidence gradient; fully fabricated displays still materially increase commitment while stated probabilities barely change.
researchValue.mechanism: The failure is localized to the action gate; supervised training can suppress it, but rigid output formats can break the learned abstention behavior.
researchValue.implication: Governance needs an explicit action-admission layer that evaluates evidence sufficiency independently from model confidence and presentation authority.

signals.title: Codex preserves Guardian authorization across history compaction by separating user-message revision from history generation
signals.title_zh: Codex 通过分离用户消息修订号与历史代际，使 Guardian 授权跨 History Compaction 保持有效
signals.summary: Codex now tracks a host-owned user-message revision separately from conversation-history generation, preserving an otherwise valid Guardian review across compaction and internal context injection while invalidating it for genuine user input and rollback.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 现在把 Host 拥有的用户消息修订号与会话历史代际分开跟踪：Compaction 与内部上下文注入不会无端使有效 Guardian Review 失效，而真实用户输入与 Rollback 会触发失效。

researchValue.failure: Treating any model-visible history rewrite as a new authorization event invalidates safe cached reviews and conflates host context maintenance with user intent changes.
researchValue.mechanism: Version genuine user authority separately from mutable conversation-history generation and bind review reuse to that user-owned revision.
researchValue.implication: Durable authorization needs its own provenance clock; context mutation alone should neither grant nor revoke authority.

signals.title: Codex makes planning-tool exposure opt-in and removes matching prompt guidance when the capability is absent
signals.title_zh: Codex 将 Planning Tool 暴露改为显式启用，并在能力不存在时同步移除对应 Prompt 指导
signals.summary: Codex defaults update_plan to disabled and removes bundled update_plan guidance across model, collaboration, multi-agent, compaction, prewarm and goal-continuation prompts unless the tool is explicitly enabled, while preserving unrelated custom instructions.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 默认关闭 update_plan；只有显式启用工具时，模型、协作、多 Agent、Compaction、Prewarm 与 Goal Continuation Prompt 才保留对应指导，同时保留无关的自定义指令。

researchValue.failure: Prompt text can promise a capability that the runtime does not actually expose, causing false plans and authority confusion.
researchValue.mechanism: Generate capability-specific instructions from actual enabled tool registration rather than maintaining an unconditional prompt copy.
researchValue.implication: Agent capability declarations and model instructions should be derived from the same admitted capability state.

signals.title: Google ADK skips rewound invocations when deciding what agent to resume
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 在决定恢复哪个 Agent 时跳过已经 Rewind 的 Invocation
signals.summary: ADK changes agent-resume selection so invocations already marked as rewound are not treated as current continuation candidates.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 修改 Agent Resume 选择逻辑，使已经被标记为 Rewound 的 Invocation 不再被当作当前 Continuation 候选。

researchValue.failure: A recovery search that ignores rewind state can resume an invalidated execution branch and re-authorize work that was intentionally rolled back.
researchValue.mechanism: Exclude rewound invocation identities from resume-candidate resolution.
researchValue.implication: Rollback must alter future admission, not merely edit historical presentation.

signals.title: Google ADK prevents duplicate durable user events when an invocation is retried
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 在 Invocation Retry 时阻止重复追加 Durable User Event
signals.summary: ADK now skips appending the same user event again when an invocation is retried, separating retry execution from durable input creation.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 现在在 Invocation Retry 时跳过重复追加同一个 User Event，把重试执行与 Durable Input 创建分离。

researchValue.failure: Invocation retry can duplicate durable user input, corrupting event order and making replay indistinguishable from a second user action.
researchValue.mechanism: Make input-event append idempotent across retries while allowing execution to retry independently.
researchValue.implication: Retry identity and durable-input identity must be separate if event logs are to remain authoritative.

signals.title: CrewAI propagates model-call policy denials through every execution path instead of degrading them into provider failures
signals.title_zh: CrewAI 让模型调用策略拒绝沿所有执行路径 Fail-closed 传播，而不是降级成 Provider Failure
signals.summary: CrewAI closes multiple paths where pre-model-call denials were swallowed, mislabeled as provider outages, retried, or allowed to continue without plans or knowledge; explicit policy aborts now propagate as deliberate stops across planning, guardrails, knowledge and retry boundaries.
signals.summary_zh: CrewAI 修复多个策略拒绝被吞掉、误标为 Provider Outage、被重试或在缺少 Plan/Knowledge 时继续执行的路径；显式 Policy Abort 现在会穿过 Planning、Guardrail、Knowledge 与 Retry 边界作为受控停止传播。

researchValue.failure: A deny that is caught as a generic exception can be retried or degraded, converting a policy decision into eventual execution.
researchValue.mechanism: Use a typed deliberate-stop exception and re-raise it across every broad error boundary that otherwise fails open.
researchValue.implication: Call-time authorization is only as strong as its end-to-end exception semantics; every caller must preserve deny identity.

signals.title: Microsoft Agent Governance Toolkit places deterministic policy interception directly on the runtime action path
signals.title_zh: Microsoft Agent Governance Toolkit 把确定性策略拦截直接放到 Runtime Action Path
signals.summary: Microsoft's toolkit describes a stateless policy engine that intercepts agent actions before execution, combines capability gating with identity and dynamic trust, and integrates through framework-native middleware rather than replacing the agent framework.
signals.summary_zh: Microsoft Toolkit 描述一个 Stateless Policy Engine：在 Agent Action 执行前拦截，结合 Capability Gating、Identity 与 Dynamic Trust，并通过 Framework Native Middleware 接入而不是替换原 Agent Framework。

researchValue.failure: Static agent capability lists do not decide whether a concrete action is permitted at execution time.
researchValue.mechanism: Insert deterministic, stateless policy mediation before execution and bind decisions to identity, trust and capability context.
researchValue.implication: Enterprise agent governance is converging on a runtime mediation layer between reasoning and side effects.

signals.title: UiPath Maestro Flow treats the governed business process as the durable production artifact around coding agents
signals.title_zh: UiPath Maestro Flow 把 Coding Agent 外围的受治理业务流程本身作为 Durable Production Artifact
signals.summary: UiPath Maestro Flow lets supported coding agents design, run, observe and govern an end-to-end business process as a single durable artifact intended to move from prototype to production without rebuilding the process boundary.
signals.summary_zh: UiPath Maestro Flow 让受支持的 Coding Agent 围绕同一个端到端业务流程 Artifact 进行设计、运行、观测与治理，目标是从 Prototype 到 Production 不重建流程边界。

researchValue.failure: Agent-generated automation can remain a prototype if the production process model, observability and governance are separate artifacts that must be rebuilt later.
researchValue.mechanism: Use one governed process artifact across design, execution, observation and production transition while agents remain replaceable builders or workers inside it.
researchValue.implication: Digital-employee products may compete on durable process ownership more than on the agent model itself.

signals.title: SymTrace shows that unguided multi-agent reruns often resample failures rather than causally repair them
signals.title_zh: SymTrace 表明无引导的多 Agent 重跑常常只是在重新采样失败，而不是因果修复
signals.summary: SymTrace replays a recorded prefix up to an intervention anchor and regenerates only downstream execution. On 536 human-annotated failures across three MAS frameworks, unguided reruns reproduced failures 67.97% of the time but repaired only 6.90%; symptom-driven intervention repaired 20.15%.
signals.summary_zh: SymTrace 将记录过的执行前缀重放到 Intervention Anchor，只重新生成下游轨迹。在 3 个 MAS Framework 的 536 条人工标注失败轨迹上，无引导重跑的失败复现率为 67.97%，修复率仅 6.90%；症状驱动干预修复率达到 20.15%。

researchValue.failure: Full reruns change upstream stochastic decisions, so a later success cannot prove that the intended repair fixed the original failure.
researchValue.finding: Controlled replay exposes a large gap between stochastic rerun success and causal repair effectiveness.
researchValue.mechanism: Freeze the execution prefix, anchor the intervention point, and regenerate only downstream behavior so repair effects are attributable.
researchValue.implication: Agent recovery evaluation should preserve the failed execution as evidence and distinguish replay, resampling and repair.

signals.title: Harness context construction can elevate low-privilege content into user-level instructions
signals.title_zh: Harness Context Construction 会把低权限内容提升成 User-level Instruction
signals.summary: The study defines instruction privilege escalation in agent harnesses: low-level attacker-controlled content is re-encoded by context construction as higher-privilege instructions. Attacks achieved all 13 objectives on six harnesses with unrestricted execution and all 13 on the three harnesses offering automatic permission review.
signals.summary_zh: 研究定义了 Agent Harness 中的 Instruction Privilege Escalation：低权限攻击者内容被 Context Construction 重新编码成更高权限指令。在无限制执行下，6 个 Harness 的 13/13 攻击目标全部成功；在提供自动权限审查的 3 个 Harness 上同样是 13/13。

researchValue.failure: A model-side instruction hierarchy can be defeated before inference if the harness drops source provenance while rebuilding context or handing work to a subagent.
researchValue.finding: Automatic permission review can also authorize the escalated request because it receives a transcript where attacker content already appears user-authored.
researchValue.mechanism: Preserve instruction-origin provenance and privilege across context construction, handoff, persistence and review rather than inferring authority from the final message role.
researchValue.implication: The security boundary is partly in the harness serializer and handoff layer, not only in the model or permission reviewer.

signals.title: User-authored standing permission policies reduced prompts but blocked less agent overreach than per-action review
signals.title_zh: 用户自定义 Standing Permission Policy 虽减少 Prompt，却比逐动作审查更难阻止 Agent Overreach
signals.summary: In a study of 113 non-professional users supervising an 18-action simulated day with seven overreach actions, reusable user-authored consequence policies blocked 20.1 percentage points less overreach than per-action HITL and 14.5 points less than automated per-action review. Users chose ask for 114 of 140 rules, returning many decisions to runtime.
signals.summary_zh: 在 113 名非专业用户监督包含 7 个 Overreach Action 的 18 动作模拟日实验中，可复用的用户自定义 Consequence Policy 比逐动作 HITL 少阻止 20.1 个百分点的越界，比自动逐动作审查少 14.5 个百分点。140 条规则中有 114 条选择 Ask，使大量决定重新回到 Runtime。

researchValue.failure: A reusable preference policy can look like durable authorization while users still want runtime judgment on most consequential actions.
researchValue.finding: Standing rules reduced runtime prompts but did not provide stronger overreach protection than per-action approval in this experiment.
researchValue.mechanism: Separate reusable preference defaults from runtime commitment authority, preserving an explicit ask path where consequence-specific approval is still required.
researchValue.implication: Enterprise approval design should not collapse preference, policy and final action authorization into one configuration layer.

signals.title: ChatGPT Work and Codex can discover website-provided WebMCP tools while keeping sensitive-action confirmations in force
signals.title_zh: ChatGPT Work 与 Codex 可发现网站提供的 WebMCP 工具，同时保留敏感动作确认
signals.summary: OpenAI says ChatGPT Work and Codex can discover tools exposed by supported websites in the desktop built-in browser through WebMCP, while existing website-access and sensitive-action confirmations still apply.
signals.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示，ChatGPT Work 与 Codex 可在桌面端内置浏览器中通过 WebMCP 发现受支持网站暴露的工具，同时既有的网站访问确认与敏感动作确认仍然生效。

researchValue.failure: Discovering a website tool can be mistaken for permission to execute sensitive operations exposed by that tool.
researchValue.mechanism: Separate tool discovery from action authorization and preserve sensitive-action confirmation after capability discovery.
researchValue.implication: Dynamic tool acquisition needs a second call-time authority boundary; capability visibility is not execution authority.

signals.title: ServiceNow AI Control Tower couples agent identity with runtime containment and reversible deactivation
signals.title_zh: ServiceNow AI Control Tower 将 Agent Identity 与 Runtime Containment、可逆停用结合
signals.summary: ServiceNow documents a kill-switch protocol that connects governance to the hyperscaler hosting an agent and can deactivate or reinstate governed agents; related Control Tower governance tracks identity, access, dependencies and retained permissions.
signals.summary_zh: ServiceNow 文档给出 Kill Switch Protocol：治理面通过连接器对接 Agent 所在 Hyperscaler，可停用或重新启用受治理 Agent；相关 Control Tower 治理还跟踪 Identity、Access、依赖关系与残留权限。

researchValue.failure: A governance dashboard that only records risk cannot reliably stop an already-running agent or prove that revocation reached the execution host.
researchValue.mechanism: Bind governed agent identity to host connectors and provide an explicit deactivate/reinstate control path.
researchValue.implication: Enterprise agent revocation is moving from metadata into an execution-side containment protocol with a governed recovery path.

signals.title: IBM Agentic Control Plane joins runtime policy, credential health and agent-access visibility in one operating layer
signals.title_zh: IBM Agentic Control Plane 将 Runtime Policy、Credential Health 与 Agent Access Visibility 放进同一运行层
signals.summary: IBM describes a control plane that enforces runtime policies, monitors credential health, exposes which agents can access which integrations and data sources, and keeps operations, audit and optimization in the same enterprise layer.
signals.summary_zh: IBM 描述的 Agentic Control Plane 在同一企业运行层中执行 Runtime Policy、监控 Credential Health、展示 Agent 对 Integration 与 Data Source 的访问关系，并统一 Operations、Audit 与 Optimization。

researchValue.failure: Policy, credentials and access graphs managed in separate systems leave operators unable to tell whether a failing or risky agent is still authorized to act.
researchValue.mechanism: Co-locate runtime policy enforcement, credential-health monitoring and agent-to-resource access visibility in the operational control plane.
researchValue.implication: Production agent governance increasingly treats credential condition and resource reachability as live runtime state rather than static configuration.

signals.title: Codex rebinds extension permissions every turn and rechecks filesystem authority while skill references are being read
signals.title_zh: Codex 每轮重新绑定 Extension Permission，并在 Skill Reference 读取过程中持续重查文件系统权限
signals.summary: Codex adds regression coverage requiring extension permissions to rebind on every turn, preserving session grants but expiring turn-only grants, and verifies skill-reference reads under current filesystem permissions even across paginated reads and intervening permission or content changes.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 新增回归覆盖，要求 Extension Permission 每轮重新绑定：Session Grant 可保留、Turn-only Grant 必须过期；Skill Reference 即使跨分页读取且中途权限或文件发生变化，也必须按当前文件系统权限重新验证。

researchValue.failure: A permission decision cached for the wrong lifetime can survive into a later turn or continue authorizing reads after the underlying resource or policy changes.
researchValue.mechanism: Give grants explicit lifetimes and re-evaluate authority at turn and resource-read boundaries rather than only when a tool is first attached.
researchValue.implication: Durable digital workers need permission state that ages independently from session state and is revalidated against current resource facts.

signals.title: Codex preserves trace parentage across nested tool callbacks and records each exec process as its own lifecycle span
signals.title_zh: Codex 在 Nested Tool Callback 中保持 Trace Parentage，并把每个 Exec Process 记录为独立生命周期 Span
signals.summary: Codex now preserves execution context for callbacks that outlive the original request, parents streamed callbacks to the concrete tool-invocation span, and records process lifetime and completion separately from the request span.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 现在会为可能晚于原始请求结束的 Callback 保留 Execution Context，把流式 Callback 绑定到具体 Tool Invocation Span，并让进程生命周期与完成结果独立于 Request Span 记录。

researchValue.failure: Asynchronous callbacks and child processes can outlive their initiating request, breaking causal trace chains and obscuring which tool invocation produced a later side effect.
researchValue.mechanism: Carry explicit execution context across task boundaries and model tool/process lifetimes as distinct spans with stable parentage.
researchValue.implication: Runtime auditability requires causality to survive process and callback lifetime boundaries, not just request logging.

signals.title: Claude Code hardens permission checks against resource substitution and routes browser actions through the same authority path
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 防止 Permission Check 后资源替换，并让 Browser Action 统一经过同一权限路径
signals.summary: Claude Code 2.1.251 fixes file tools following symlinks swapped after permission checks, applies deny rules through symlinked search paths, rejects plugin path traversal, moves Workflow scriptPath reads behind permission checks, and routes Chrome actions through Claude Code permission checks.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.251 修复 Permission Check 后 Symlink 被替换导致越界读写、Symlink Search Path 绕过 Deny Rule、Plugin Path Traversal、Workflow 在权限检查前读取 scriptPath 等问题，并把 Chrome Browser Action 统一送入 Claude Code Permission Check。

researchValue.failure: Checking a pathname or tool route once does not bind the later side effect to the same resource or authorization path; a symlink swap or alternate action surface can invalidate the decision.
researchValue.mechanism: Recheck the effective resource/action path at use time and converge alternate surfaces on one permission mediator.
researchValue.implication: Authorization receipts should bind concrete resource identity and execution route, not merely the request text seen before a TOCTOU window.

signals.title: Google ADK makes concurrent session creation fail explicitly instead of silently racing to ambiguous ownership
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 让并发 Create Session 显式失败，而不是把竞争写入变成模糊所有权
signals.summary: Google ADK changes concurrent create_session races to raise an AlreadyExistsError, giving competing creators a typed conflict instead of an ambiguous or backend-specific result.
signals.summary_zh: Google ADK 将并发 create_session 竞争改为抛出 AlreadyExistsError，让竞争创建者得到明确的 Typed Conflict，而不是模糊或依赖后端实现的结果。

researchValue.failure: Two workers racing to materialize the same session can create duplicate ownership or make later recovery unable to tell which session is authoritative.
researchValue.mechanism: Turn duplicate creation into an explicit conflict with a stable error identity that callers can reconcile idempotently.
researchValue.implication: Session creation is an ownership claim and should have compare-and-claim semantics rather than best-effort persistence.

signals.title: MCP TypeScript SDK adds DPoP sender-constrained tokens to bind authorization material to the client key
signals.title_zh: MCP TypeScript SDK 增加 DPoP Sender-constrained Token，把授权材料绑定到 Client Key
signals.summary: The MCP TypeScript SDK adds RFC 9449 DPoP support so OAuth access tokens can be sender-constrained rather than reusable bearer credentials detached from the presenting client.
signals.summary_zh: MCP TypeScript SDK 新增 RFC 9449 DPoP，使 OAuth Access Token 可成为 Sender-constrained Credential，而不是与实际提交客户端脱钩、可被复制重放的 Bearer Token。

researchValue.failure: A stolen bearer token can authorize MCP calls from a different process or host even when the original connector identity was trusted.
researchValue.mechanism: Cryptographically bind token presentation to a client-controlled key and proof rather than accepting possession alone.
researchValue.implication: Connector authorization can move from secret possession toward proof-of-possession identity, reducing credential replay across workers or hosts.

signals.title: A2A distinguishes lightweight negotiation messages from the durable Task created only when work is committed
signals.title_zh: A2A 区分轻量 Negotiation Message 与承诺执行后才创建的 Durable Task
signals.summary: A2A's clarified Hybrid Agent lifecycle says messages carry scope negotiation and a Task is created once there is committed work to execute and observe, making commitment a distinct protocol boundary from conversation.
signals.summary_zh: A2A 对 Hybrid Agent Lifecycle 的澄清指出：Message 用于 Scope Negotiation；只有形成需要执行与观测的 Committed Work 后才创建 Task，从协议上把工作承诺与对话分开。

researchValue.failure: Treating every inter-agent message as durable work can create phantom tasks, duplicate ownership and audit records that do not distinguish negotiation from commitment.
researchValue.mechanism: Use messages for negotiation and materialize a Task only at the protocol point where executable, observable work is committed.
researchValue.implication: Multi-agent runtimes benefit from an explicit commitment boundary between communication and owned work.

signals.title: Logos isolates agent plugins into peer processes and resumes killed sessions from an append-only transcript without repeating effects
signals.title_zh: Logos 将 Agent Plugin 隔离到 Peer Process，并从 Append-only Transcript 恢复且不重复副作用
signals.summary: Logos moves each plugin into a separate process with only an append-only transcript shared across the harness. The paper reports 80 sessions resuming with no repeated effect after kills at four tool-call boundaries, while peer-process isolation confines a process fault to one node.
signals.summary_zh: Logos 将每个 Plugin 放入独立 Process，Harness 之间只共享 Append-only Transcript。论文报告在 Tool-call Cycle 的 4 个边界注入 Kill 后，80 个 Session 均可恢复且不重复副作用；Peer-process 隔离还能把进程故障限制在单个 Node。

researchValue.failure: A single-process harness makes every plugin and co-resident session share one failure domain, so one crash can suspend unrelated work and blur recovery boundaries.
researchValue.finding: The reported fault-injection study resumes 80 sessions without repeating effects and confines peer-process failures to one node.
researchValue.mechanism: Separate plugin execution into processes while externalizing cross-step state into an append-only transcript used for recovery.
researchValue.implication: Agent isolation can be a runtime topology property, and durable transcript state can support recovery without forcing all workers into one process failure domain.

signals.title: EvoUndo finds that capability-improving self-modifications can still be unrecoverable and must be independently verified across counterfactual states
signals.title_zh: EvoUndo 发现能力提升型自修改仍可能不可恢复，必须跨 Counterfactual State 独立验证
signals.summary: EvoUndo studies model-generated changes to prompts, tools, middleware and harness resources. Among 600 unseen tasks it identifies 197 capability-improving mutations that fail recoverability verification; richer recovery representations plus exact state grounding recover most oracle-recoverable failures, but results also expose model-dependent interactions.
signals.summary_zh: EvoUndo 研究模型对 Prompt、Tool、Middleware 与 Harness Resource 的自修改。在 600 个未见任务中识别出 197 个虽然提升能力却无法通过 Recoverability Verification 的 Mutation；更丰富的 Recovery Representation 与精确 State Grounding 可恢复大部分 Oracle 可恢复失败，同时仍出现模型依赖的交互。

researchValue.failure: A self-change can improve the immediate task and still leave persistent state that cannot be safely reversed later.
researchValue.finding: Recoverability failures remain common even among capability-improving mutations, and ordinary iterative repair does not demonstrate reversibility.
researchValue.mechanism: Make recoverability an independently verified property over counterfactual states with explicit state addressing, witness semantics and a sufficiently expressive recovery language.
researchValue.implication: Self-improving digital employees need an adoption gate that tests rollback semantics independently from the worker that proposed the improvement.

signals.title: DoCtOR attributes multi-agent failure to the decisive error agent before reflection to avoid contaminating unaffected agents
signals.title_zh: DoCtOR 先定位 Decisive Error Agent 再反思，避免污染未出错 Agent 的记忆
signals.summary: DoCtOR first identifies the decisive error step and agent, counterfactually corrects that step, and asks only the responsible agent to reflect. The paper reports 22%, 26% and 27% improvements over initial success rates on three benchmarks and argues that forcing all agents to reflect can contaminate otherwise-correct memories.
signals.summary_zh: DoCtOR 先识别 Decisive Error Step 与责任 Agent，再对该步骤做 Counterfactual Correction，只让责任 Agent 反思。论文在三个 Benchmark 上报告相对初始成功率提升 22%、26%、27%，并指出让所有 Agent 一起反思会污染原本正确的 Agent Memory。

researchValue.failure: System-wide reflection after a localized failure can overwrite correct agent behavior with lessons derived from another agent's mistake.
researchValue.finding: Targeting the decisive error agent and step improved benchmark outcomes relative to broad reflection baselines in the reported experiments.
researchValue.mechanism: Attribute failure before remediation, preserve unaffected agents, and scope reflection to the responsible execution branch.
researchValue.implication: Multi-agent recovery should separate root-cause ownership from team-wide state and avoid propagating unverified corrections across healthy workers.

signals.title: OpenAI healthcare plugins separate plugin availability, app access, user sign-in, and underlying record permissions
signals.title_zh: OpenAI 医疗插件把插件可用性、App Access、用户登录与底层记录权限分层
signals.summary: OpenAI's healthcare plugins are read-only. Epic access requires an administrator-configured EHR app, an individual Epic sign-in, and existing patient-chart permissions, while workspace admins manage plugin availability and app access separately.
signals.summary_zh: OpenAI 医疗插件为只读；Epic 访问同时要求管理员配置的 EHR App、个人 Epic 登录和既有 Patient Chart 权限，而 Workspace Admin 还分别管理 Plugin Availability 与 App Access。

researchValue.failure: A plugin being visible or installed can be mistaken for authority to read sensitive application data.
researchValue.mechanism: Layer plugin availability, app access, individual application sign-in, existing record permissions, and a read-only action boundary.
researchValue.implication: Connector discovery and installation should not collapse into data authority; each runtime data access still needs its own identity and resource-permission boundary.

signals.title: Copilot Studio exposes connector scopes on Agent ID but revalidates them against runtime policy
signals.title_zh: Copilot Studio 将 Connector Scope 暴露到 Agent ID，同时在 Runtime 重新校验治理策略
signals.summary: Copilot Studio attaches connector API permissions to an agent's Entra Agent ID at publish time for administrative visibility, but the connector runtime revalidates those scopes against Advanced Connector Policies and DLP; Conditional Access can also gate token issuance.
signals.summary_zh: Copilot Studio 在发布时把 Connector API Permission 附到 Agent 的 Entra Agent ID 上供管理员查看，但 Connector Runtime 仍会依据 Advanced Connector Policies 与 DLP 重新校验这些 Scope；Conditional Access 还可控制 Token 签发。

researchValue.failure: Persisted identity metadata can be mistaken for permanent authority and used to bypass changed runtime governance.
researchValue.mechanism: Expose connector capability on a durable agent identity while independently revalidating the call against current runtime policies.
researchValue.implication: Agent identity should describe reachable capability, while call-time policy remains a separate live admission boundary.

signals.title: Missing Microsoft Entra agent registration can make a Teams agent unresponsive and recovery re-provisions identity
signals.title_zh: Microsoft Entra Agent Registration 丢失会让 Teams Agent 失联，恢复需要重新 Provision Identity
signals.summary: Microsoft documents that a Teams-deployed Copilot Studio agent can become unresponsive when its Entra app registration—the agent identity—is missing. Disconnecting and reconnecting the Teams channel and republishing should trigger identity provisioning; recreating the agent is the fallback.
signals.summary_zh: Microsoft 记录了一个明确故障：部署到 Teams 的 Copilot Studio Agent 若其 Entra App Registration（Agent Identity）从 Tenant Directory 中缺失，会变得无响应。断开并重连 Teams Channel 后重新发布，可触发 Identity Provisioning；仍失败时需重建 Agent。

researchValue.failure: The runtime surface can exist while its underlying agent identity artifact has disappeared, producing an apparently deployed but nonfunctional worker.
researchValue.finding: Microsoft treats the missing identity registration as an execution dependency rather than a cosmetic directory inconsistency.
researchValue.mechanism: Recovery re-enters identity provisioning by republishing the channel, with full agent recreation as the fallback.
researchValue.implication: Recovery of a digital employee may require re-admission and re-provisioning of identity, not merely restarting the conversation or runtime.

signals.title: Codex scopes remembered MCP approvals to the selected app account link
signals.title_zh: Codex 将记忆的 MCP Approval 绑定到具体 App Account Link
signals.summary: Codex now includes the selected app link_id in MCP tool approval keys, so a remembered session approval applies only to the approved account link; another link or a call without a selector requires its own approval.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 现在把所选 App 的 link_id 纳入 MCP Tool Approval Key，使 Session Approval 只对当时批准的 Account Link 生效；换另一个 Link 或不带 Selector 的调用都必须重新取得 Approval。

researchValue.failure: Remembering approval only by connector and tool can silently authorize the same action against a different account.
researchValue.mechanism: Bind reusable approval state to connector, tool, and selected account-link identity.
researchValue.implication: Authorization memory must preserve target identity; 'same tool' is not the same authorization object when the account changes.

signals.title: Codex evaluates permission paths in the originating executor environment
signals.title_zh: Codex 在原始 Executor Environment 中解析 Permission Path
signals.summary: Codex resolves relative and home-relative permission paths using the selected executor's path convention, home, workspace roots, temporary directories, and sandbox context. Pending permission requests retain the originating environment so delayed grants are normalized against the same context.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 使用所选 Executor 的路径规则、Home、Workspace Root、临时目录与 Sandbox Context 来解析相对路径和 Home-relative Permission；Pending Permission Request 会保留原始 Environment，使延迟返回的 Grant 仍在同一个执行上下文中归一化。

researchValue.failure: A permission request interpreted using host or response-time path semantics can authorize a different resource than the one originally requested.
researchValue.mechanism: Persist the originating executor environment and intersect requested/granted paths inside that environment's sandbox semantics.
researchValue.implication: Authority over files and commands must be bound to execution location and namespace, not only to textual path strings.

signals.title: Codex classifies dangerous commands using the remote executor platform rather than the host platform
signals.title_zh: Codex 按远端 Executor Platform 而不是 Host Platform 判断危险命令
signals.summary: Codex threads the executor platform through command parsing and dangerous-command classification so remote Windows/PowerShell execution is judged using remote semantics. Unknown reported platforms use Windows rules conservatively.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 将 Executor Platform 贯穿到命令解析和 Dangerous-command Classification，使远端 Windows/PowerShell 命令按远端语义而不是 Host 语义判断；未知平台则保守采用 Windows 规则。

researchValue.failure: Safety classification based on the host OS can miss dangerous commands executed on a different remote operating system.
researchValue.mechanism: Classify execution using the target executor's platform semantics and fail conservatively for unknown platforms.
researchValue.implication: Tool safety belongs to the actual execution boundary; remote workers require policy evaluation against remote facts.

signals.title: Google ADK adds transfer reason to inter-agent handoff to reduce transfer loops
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 在 Agent Handoff 中加入 Transfer Reason 以减少循环转交
signals.summary: Google ADK adds an opt-in transfer_reason argument to transfer_to_agent so the receiving agent gets explicit handoff context, with the stated purpose of preventing multi-agent transfer loops.
signals.summary_zh: Google ADK 为 transfer_to_agent 增加可选的 transfer_reason，让接收 Agent 获得明确的 Handoff Context，提交说明直接把防止 Multi-Agent Transfer Loop 作为目的。

researchValue.failure: Agents can bounce a task back and forth when a handoff carries destination but not the reason and responsibility context for the transfer.
researchValue.mechanism: Attach explicit transfer rationale to the delegation event and expose it to the receiving agent.
researchValue.implication: A governed handoff needs semantic provenance for why ownership moved, not only the identity of the next worker.

signals.title: Google ADK removes resume-only inputs from durable resumable-node checkpoints
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 将仅用于 Resume 的 Input 从 Durable Checkpoint 中移除
signals.summary: Google ADK changes resumable workflow checkpointing so resume inputs are not stored as durable node checkpoint state, separating one-time recovery input from the persisted execution state that later replays consume.
signals.summary_zh: Google ADK 修改 Resumable Workflow Checkpoint：Resume Input 不再作为 Durable Node Checkpoint State 持久化，从而把一次性的恢复输入与未来 Replay 会消费的持久执行状态分开。

researchValue.failure: One-time resume instructions can become stale authoritative state if copied into the durable checkpoint and replayed later.
researchValue.mechanism: Keep resume-only input ephemeral while persisting only the durable workflow state.
researchValue.implication: Recovery input and checkpoint truth should have different lifetimes; resumption should not silently rewrite the durable source of truth.

signals.title: Coding-agent working-memory evaluation needs four levels beyond nominal token budget
signals.title_zh: Coding Agent Working Memory 评估需要超越名义 Token Budget 的四层度量
signals.summary: Across 55 archived coding-agent trajectories, the paper finds semantically different working-memory objects have different retention and compression behavior; equal token budgets do not imply equal delivered context or management cost. It proposes evaluating stored state, delivered context, management work, and task/process outcome.
signals.summary_zh: 该研究分析 55 条归档 Coding Agent Trajectory，发现不同语义的 Working-memory Object 具有不同保留与压缩行为；相同 Token Budget 并不等于相同 Delivered Context 或 Management Cost，并提出 Stored State、Delivered Context、Management Work、Task/Process Outcome 四层评估。

researchValue.failure: A single token-budget metric can hide context loss, serving limits, and memory-management overhead.
researchValue.finding: Semantic object types behave differently under retention and compression, and calibration gains may not transfer to held-out tasks.
researchValue.mechanism: Evaluate memory management at four layers: stored state, delivered context, management work, and final task/process outcome.
researchValue.implication: Long-running digital employees need memory observability that separates what is stored from what is actually delivered and useful at execution time.

signals.title: TASPO keeps verified outcome direction while redistributing credit at executable-action granularity
signals.title_zh: TASPO 保留 Verified Outcome 的更新方向，同时在 Executable Action 粒度重新分配 Credit
signals.summary: TASPO addresses the gap between fine-grained process supervision and actual executable-action credit by keeping verified task outcome as the update direction and average scale while using privileged-information likelihood shifts only to redistribute credit across actions. The work reports a 10.6% improvement over GRPO across three agentic benchmarks and is marked work in progress.
signals.summary_zh: TASPO 针对“细粒度 Process Supervision 并不等于可执行 Action Credit”的缺口：Verified Task Outcome 决定更新方向与平均尺度，Privileged Information 的 Likelihood Shift 只负责在 Action 间重分配 Credit。论文在 3 个 Agentic Benchmark 上报告相对 GRPO 提升 10.6%，并明确标注为 Work in Progress。

researchValue.failure: Trajectory-level outcome credit is too coarse, while fine-grained supervision signals can be misaligned with the executable decisions that actually caused the outcome.
researchValue.finding: Outcome-grounded action-level credit reports better benchmark performance and unseen-task generalization than the compared GRPO baseline.
researchValue.mechanism: Use verified outcome for update direction and bounded mean scale, then redistribute credit across executable actions using decision-applicable privileged information.
researchValue.implication: Agent evaluation and failure attribution should distinguish evidence about process quality from evidence that assigns responsibility to concrete actions.

signals.title: SkillZip Pro compresses progressive skill bundles while preserving routing and public entry contracts
signals.title_zh: SkillZip Pro 在保持 Routing 与 Public Entry Contract 的同时压缩渐进加载 Skill Bundle
signals.summary: SkillZip Pro treats production skills as progressively loaded directory bundles rather than flat prompts. It preserves routing and callable entries while compressing across files; on one industrial multi-round harness it reports 38% fewer bundle tokens and 10.4% fewer per-run tokens with no quality loss, whereas an unprotected 71% compression setting lost up to 26 accuracy points.
signals.summary_zh: SkillZip Pro 把 Production Skill 视为渐进加载的 Directory Bundle 而不是扁平 Prompt，在跨文件压缩时保留 Routing 与可调用 Entry。其一个工业 Multi-round Harness 报告 Bundle Token 减少 38%、Per-run Token 减少 10.4% 且无质量损失；未受保护的 71% 压缩配置则最高损失 26 个准确率点。

researchValue.failure: Flattening or over-compressing a skill bundle can destroy progressive-loading routes and silently remove execution-critical public entries.
researchValue.finding: Routing-aware compression reduced context cost without quality loss in the reported harness, while aggressive unprotected compression materially reduced accuracy.
researchValue.mechanism: Preserve entry contracts and routing reachability while removing cross-file duplication; separate persistent bundle rewriting from transient task-specific views.
researchValue.implication: Agent skill optimization must preserve execution topology and public capability contracts, not merely minimize prompt tokens.

signals.title: Cursor self-hosted machines keep agent tool execution, code, build outputs, and secrets inside enterprise infrastructure
signals.title_zh: Cursor Self-hosted Machines 将 Agent Tool Execution、代码、构建产物与 Secrets 留在企业基础设施内
signals.summary: Cursor now supports self-hosted machines and team worker pools for Cloud Agents. Tool calls execute on customer-controlled infrastructure while codebase, build outputs, and secrets remain on internal machines; pools can dynamically claim work and restore hibernated workers within a reconnect window.
signals.summary_zh: Cursor 现支持 Cloud Agents 使用 Self-hosted Machines 与 Team Worker Pools。Tool Call 在客户控制的基础设施上执行，Codebase、Build Output 与 Secrets 留在内部机器；Pool 可动态认领工作，并在 Reconnect Window 内恢复休眠 Worker。

researchValue.failure: A cloud control plane can accidentally be treated as the execution and secret-trust boundary even when enterprise policy requires actions to stay on customer infrastructure.
researchValue.mechanism: Separate cloud orchestration from customer-hosted execution, keep sensitive artifacts local, and let named worker pools claim and recover work under an explicit reconnect lifecycle.
researchValue.implication: Digital-employee runtimes should model Host/Workspace/Secret authority separately from the cloud scheduler that assigns work.

signals.title: Copilot Studio makes the GitHub Copilot harness a governed execution choice with sandbox and environment telemetry
signals.title_zh: Copilot Studio 将 GitHub Copilot Harness 变成带 Sandbox 与环境 Telemetry 的受治理执行选择
signals.summary: Microsoft made the GitHub Copilot harness generally available in Copilot Studio alongside the standard harness. The harness mediates model calls, context, tools, MCP servers, and connected agents; tasks run in a secure sandbox governed by Copilot Studio, while environment-level telemetry can be exported for administration and audit.
signals.summary_zh: Microsoft 在 Copilot Studio 中将 GitHub Copilot Harness 与 Standard Harness 并列 GA。Harness 负责中介 Model Call、Context、Tools、MCP Server 与 Connected Agents；任务运行在由 Copilot Studio 治理的 Secure Sandbox 中，同时 Environment-level Telemetry 可导出用于管理与审计。

researchValue.failure: Treating the base model as the runtime obscures which layer actually selects tools, supplies context, isolates actions, and emits operational evidence.
researchValue.mechanism: Expose harness selection as a first-class runtime choice and bind recursive reasoning/action to a governed sandbox plus environment telemetry.
researchValue.implication: A digital employee should declare its harness/runtime profile independently from its model identity and make that profile auditable.

signals.title: GitHub is unifying chat, mobile, and cloud-agent policy while extending agent-session retention to account lifetime
signals.title_zh: GitHub 将 Chat、Mobile 与 Cloud Agent 统一到同一 Policy，并把 Agent Session 数据保留延长到 Account Lifetime
signals.summary: GitHub announced that Copilot Chat on github.com, GitHub Mobile, and the cloud agent will move to one unified Copilot policy no earlier than September 28. The experiences also converge on agent sessions, changing chat data retention from 28 days to the life of the account for the unified surface.
signals.summary_zh: GitHub 宣布最早自 9 月 28 日起，将 github.com Copilot Chat、GitHub Mobile 与 Cloud Agent 合并到统一 Copilot Policy，并统一到 Agent Sessions；统一 Surface 的 Chat Data Retention 将从 28 天变为 Account Lifetime。

researchValue.failure: Separate product surfaces can appear to have independent privacy and policy boundaries even after they share the same agent session and retention substrate.
researchValue.mechanism: Unify administrative policy and session substrate across surfaces, with one explicit retention lifecycle.
researchValue.implication: When agent surfaces converge, governance must be defined at the durable session/identity layer rather than copied per UI.

signals.title: Codex authorizes apply_patch using the selected executor's filesystem and path convention
signals.title_zh: Codex 按所选 Executor 的 Filesystem 与 Path Convention 授权 apply_patch
signals.summary: Codex now evaluates patch targets as PathUri values under the active filesystem policy and selected executor path convention, distinguishing executor-managed sandboxing from local platform sandboxing and honoring remote Windows/POSIX roots when normalizing write permissions.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 现在把 Patch Target 作为 PathUri，在 Active Filesystem Policy 与所选 Executor 的 Path Convention 下评估，并区分 Executor-managed Sandbox 与 Local Platform Sandbox；在规范化 Write Permission 时也遵循远端 Windows/POSIX Roots。

researchValue.failure: Authorizing a remote patch with host-native path semantics can misclassify writable roots and grant or deny the wrong filesystem capability.
researchValue.mechanism: Evaluate authorization in the originating executor's filesystem context rather than translating the request into host assumptions first.
researchValue.implication: Tool authorization should bind to execution context, not merely command name and textual path.

signals.title: Codex lets a Ready report supersede a stale deferred-environment provisioning failure without changing environment identity
signals.title_zh: Codex 允许 Ready Report 覆盖 Deferred Environment 的陈旧 Provisioning Failure，同时保持 Environment Identity
signals.summary: Codex changed deferred environments so a valid Ready report can replace a prior provisioning failure while preserving the same environment instance. Stale failures are retryable, and a late failure cannot overwrite a newer Ready state.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 调整 Deferred Environment：有效 Ready Report 可以覆盖此前的 Provisioning Failure，同时保持同一个 Environment Instance。陈旧 Failure 可重试，且迟到的 Failure 不能覆盖更新的 Ready State。

researchValue.failure: An earlier asynchronous provisioning failure can arrive after recovery and incorrectly regress an environment that is already healthy.
researchValue.mechanism: Treat provisioning failure as recoverable state, preserve environment identity, and order competing reports so later stale failure evidence cannot override a verified Ready state.
researchValue.implication: Recovery requires monotonic authority over state transitions, not simple last-write-wins event handling.

signals.title: Google ADK binds resumption of auth-gated tool calls to the original function-call author
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 将 Auth-gated Tool Call 的恢复绑定到原始 Function-call Author
signals.summary: ADK's authentication resume path previously found a tool call by ID in session history and could execute it without checking whether that call was authored by the current agent. The fix now requires original_fc_event.author to match agent.name before resuming, aligning it with the existing confirmation path.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 的 Authentication Resume Path 过去会按 ID 从 Session History 找到 Tool Call 并恢复执行，却未校验该 Call 是否由当前 Agent 发起。修复后要求 original_fc_event.author 与 agent.name 匹配，再允许 Resume，并与既有 Confirmation Path 对齐。

researchValue.failure: A resumed authorization flow can replay a valid historical tool-call ID under the wrong agent identity.
researchValue.mechanism: Bind resume admission to both historical call identity and original author identity before re-entering the gated action.
researchValue.implication: Resume is a fresh authorization boundary; durable history is evidence, not current authority by itself.

signals.title: MCP clients are converging on authorization-server issuer binding during OAuth discovery
signals.title_zh: MCP Clients 正在 OAuth Discovery 中收敛到 Authorization-server Issuer Binding
signals.summary: The MCP Python SDK now validates authorization-server metadata issuer on every discovery path. Independently, Gemini CLI added RFC 9207 issuer identification to its MCP OAuth flow the same day, showing cross-implementation convergence on binding discovered metadata to the expected issuer rather than accepting endpoint metadata by location alone.
signals.summary_zh: MCP Python SDK 现在在所有 Discovery Path 校验 Authorization-server Metadata Issuer；同日 Gemini CLI 也为 MCP OAuth Flow 加入 RFC 9207 Issuer Identification，显示不同实现正共同收敛到“把发现到的 Metadata 绑定到预期 Issuer”，而不是只按 Endpoint Location 信任。

researchValue.failure: OAuth discovery can accept metadata from the wrong authorization server even when the transport endpoint itself appears valid.
researchValue.finding: Independent clients adopted issuer binding in the same window.
researchValue.mechanism: Validate discovered authorization metadata against an expected issuer identity on every discovery route.
researchValue.implication: Protocol discovery must preserve authority identity across redirects and metadata indirection.

signals.title: A2A separates lightweight negotiation messages from the durable Task created only after work is committed
signals.title_zh: A2A 将轻量协商 Message 与“真正承诺工作后才创建”的 Durable Task 分离
signals.summary: A2A clarified its Hybrid Agents model: messages carry lightweight scope negotiation, while a Task is created only once there is committed work to execute and observe. The change is documentation, not new normative protocol semantics, but it makes the intended durable-work boundary explicit and self-contained.
signals.summary_zh: A2A 明确 Hybrid Agents 模型：Message 用于轻量 Scope Negotiation；只有在形成需要执行和观察的 Committed Work 后才创建 Task。该提交是文档澄清而非新的 Normative Semantics，但把 Durable Work Boundary 明确写成自包含规则。

researchValue.failure: Creating durable task state during tentative negotiation can turn discussion into execution state before responsibility and scope are actually committed.
researchValue.mechanism: Keep negotiation as messages and materialize durable Task identity only at the commitment-to-execute boundary.
researchValue.implication: Multi-agent protocols need an explicit transition from conversation to accountable work object.

signals.title: AgentRewind aligns agent-context and environment checkpoints so long-horizon execution can roll back and resume
signals.title_zh: AgentRewind 对齐 Agent Context 与 Environment Checkpoint，使 Long-horizon Execution 可以回滚后恢复
signals.summary: AgentRewind records aligned checkpoints of agent context and controlled environment, allowing a long-horizon agent to return to an earlier joint state and resume with information from prior attempts. MettleBench evaluates both task completion and partial progress on long engineering assignments, and the paper reports improved success and checklist progress across models and harnesses.
signals.summary_zh: AgentRewind 记录对齐的 Agent Context 与 Controlled Environment Checkpoint，使 Long-horizon Agent 能返回更早的联合状态，并携带前次尝试信息 Resume。MettleBench 同时评估长工程任务的 Task Completion 与 Partial Progress，论文报告其在多模型、多 Harness 下提升成功率与 Checklist Progress。

researchValue.failure: Rolling back only conversation state or only environment state can leave the two sides causally inconsistent after an early error.
researchValue.finding: Joint context-environment checkpoints improve recoverability and partial progress across long-horizon tasks.
researchValue.mechanism: Checkpoint causally aligned agent and environment state, then resume from the aligned pair with prior-attempt information.
researchValue.implication: Recoverable digital work needs a checkpoint contract that spans reasoning state and external effects.

signals.title: Bounded Agents treats delegation as a principal chain with cumulative scope and composition checks
signals.title_zh: Bounded Agents 将 Delegation 建模为带累计 Scope 与 Composition Check 的 Principal Chain
signals.summary: Bounded Agents proposes an Agentic Principal Chain that carries and restricts delegated scope and budgets from principal to sub-agent, evaluates each request against accumulated session state, and checks prohibited action compositions outside the model. Its compromised-model evaluation reports blocking all tested InjecAgent data-stealing cases and eliminating AgentDojo exfiltration in the evaluated domains, with stated utility costs and theorem assumptions.
signals.summary_zh: Bounded Agents 提出 Agentic Principal Chain：从 Principal 到 Sub-agent 逐级携带并收缩 Delegated Scope 与 Budget，每次请求都对累计 Session State 进行校验，并在模型外检查 Prohibited Action Composition。其 Compromised-model Evaluation 报告阻断全部被测 InjecAgent 数据窃取案例，并在被测 AgentDojo Domain 中消除 Exfiltration，同时明确给出 Utility Cost 与定理假设。

researchValue.failure: Static per-agent permissions do not prevent individually allowed actions from composing into a prohibited outcome or being over-delegated to sub-agents.
researchValue.finding: The evaluated principal-chain checks strongly reduced attack success under a compromised-model setting, while imposing measurable utility tradeoffs.
researchValue.mechanism: Track delegated authority as a narrowing principal chain and evaluate each action against cumulative state, scope, budget, and prohibited compositions outside the model.
researchValue.implication: Multi-agent authorization should be transitive but non-expansive, and policy must reason about action sequences rather than isolated calls.

signals.title: SkillTriage attributes agent failures by differential comparison instead of treating loaded skills as uniformly beneficial
signals.title_zh: SkillTriage 用差分比较归因 Agent Failure，而不是默认 Loaded Skill 一律有益
signals.summary: The paper compares a skill-guided run against a no-skill or semantically matched reference run to attribute functional failures and cost regressions to the loaded skill. Across SkillsBench and SWE-Skills-Bench it identifies 307 skill-induced failures, including 125 functional failures and 182 efficiency regressions; excessive verification and heavy implementation pipelines are major efficiency failure sources.
signals.summary_zh: 该研究把 Skill-guided Run 与 No-skill 或 Semantically Matched Reference Run 做差分比较，将 Functional Failure 与 Cost Regression 归因到具体 Loaded Skill。其在 SkillsBench 与 SWE-Skills-Bench 上识别 307 个 Skill-induced Failure，其中 125 个功能失败、182 个效率回退；Excessive Verification 与 Heavy Implementation Pipeline 是主要效率失败来源。

researchValue.failure: Reusable skills can silently convert guidance into mandatory procedure, causing both wrong implementation and unnecessary verification cost even when the skill appears relevant.
researchValue.finding: Differential paired-run evidence can isolate skill-induced functional and efficiency regressions more directly than aggregate task success alone.
researchValue.mechanism: Compare skill-guided trajectories with matched reference trajectories, extract differential evidence, and attribute regressions to specific procedural effects.
researchValue.implication: Skill libraries for digital employees need admission, attribution, and retirement evidence rather than assuming every installed skill is harmless reusable knowledge.

signals.title: Codex iOS turns queued prompts into a host-synchronized, background-capable operator queue
signals.title_zh: Codex iOS 将 Queued Prompts 变成跨 Host 同步、可后台发送的操作队列
signals.summary: OpenAI's September 1 Codex iOS update says queued prompts synchronize with the connected host, remain editable, and can send while the app is in the background; Priority view also surfaces running tasks and tasks awaiting a response.
signals.summary_zh: OpenAI 9 月 1 日的 Codex iOS 更新说明：Queued Prompt 会与 Connected Host 同步、保持可编辑，并可在 App 后台时发送；Priority View 还会优先显示 Running Task 与 Awaiting Response Task。

researchValue.failure: A mobile control surface can become a transient chat UI that loses operator intent or cannot safely hand work to the actual execution host.
researchValue.mechanism: Persist operator prompts as a host-synchronized queue whose state survives mobile backgrounding and remains editable until dispatch.
researchValue.implication: Digital-employee mobile control should model command admission, queue state, host binding, and response-required states independently from the phone UI.

signals.title: GitHub binds Copilot model access to the organization that pays for the request
signals.title_zh: GitHub 将 Copilot Model Access 绑定到实际承担用量费用的组织
signals.summary: For users holding Copilot seats in multiple organizations, GitHub now determines model access only from the organization paying for usage rather than allowing any organization with an enabled model to grant access.
signals.summary_zh: 对于同时持有多个组织 Copilot Seat 的用户，GitHub 现在只依据承担该次 Usage Billing 的组织决定 Model Access，不再由任一已启用该模型的组织放行。

researchValue.failure: A user can inherit conflicting model permissions from multiple organizations when policy authority is not bound to the principal that owns the request's cost and governance context.
researchValue.mechanism: Resolve model admission from the billing/governance principal for the current usage context instead of unioning permissions across memberships.
researchValue.implication: Enterprise agent runtimes should bind model/tool policy to the current owning organization or cost center at call time.

signals.title: Codex fails closed when Guardian cannot prove a compaction checkpoint is compatible
signals.title_zh: Codex 在 Guardian 无法证明 Compaction Checkpoint 兼容时 Fail Closed
signals.summary: Codex records the producing model's compatibility hash on compaction checkpoints and requires synchronous Guardian review when the latest checkpoint has unknown or incompatible provenance, preventing cached or asynchronous approval from omitting compacted context.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 在 Compaction Checkpoint 上记录 Producing Model Compatibility Hash；当最新 Checkpoint 的 Provenance 未知或不兼容时，强制同步 Guardian Review，避免 Cached/Async Approval 漏掉被压缩的上下文。

researchValue.failure: Authorization evidence can survive as a score while the context it was based on has been compacted by an incompatible producer, creating a stale approval.
researchValue.mechanism: Bind compacted authorization context to producer compatibility provenance and force fresh synchronous review when provenance cannot be proven compatible.
researchValue.implication: Long-running agents should treat context compaction as an authorization-boundary transition, not a transparent storage optimization.

signals.title: Codex preserves MCP authentication challenges but does not automatically replay the rejected tool call
signals.title_zh: Codex 保留 MCP Authentication Challenge，但不自动重放被拒绝的 Tool Call
signals.summary: Codex carries WWW-Authenticate challenges through MCP tool errors when silent OAuth refresh fails, including multiple challenges, while explicitly avoiding automatic replay of the rejected tool call.
signals.summary_zh: 当 Silent OAuth Refresh 失败时，Codex 会把 WWW-Authenticate Challenge（包括多个 Challenge）保留到 MCP Tool Error 中，同时明确不自动重放被拒绝的 Tool Call。

researchValue.failure: An authentication recovery path can erase the challenge needed for user recovery or replay a side-effecting tool call after credentials change.
researchValue.mechanism: Preserve the server's authentication challenge as durable recovery evidence, but require an explicit subsequent call rather than automatically replaying the failed action.
researchValue.implication: Auth recovery and side-effect retry should be separate state transitions with independent authorization and idempotency controls.

sourceIdentityCorrection.reason: Authoritative GitHub commit verification found that the declared SHA did not exist and confirmed the matching maintainer change under the corrected full SHA.

signals.title: Google ADK makes a human-confirmation pause non-summarizable to prevent tool reinvocation loops
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 将 Human Confirmation Pause 设为不可 Summarize，防止 Tool Reinvocation Loop
signals.summary: ADK marks paused MCP tool calls awaiting confirmation with skip_summarization so the model does not summarize the paused call and invoke it again, eliminating a confirmation loop.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 对等待确认而暂停的 MCP Tool Call 设置 skip_summarization，避免模型把暂停状态摘要后再次调用同一工具，从而消除 Confirmation Loop。

researchValue.failure: A pause awaiting human approval can be interpreted by the model as unfinished conversational work and cause the same side-effecting tool to be invoked again.
researchValue.mechanism: Make approval-pending tool calls terminal to model summarization for the current turn while keeping them resumable by the control plane.
researchValue.implication: HITL pause must be an explicit runtime state that suppresses autonomous replanning until the authorization event arrives.

signals.title: A reproducible artifact compares security benchmarks for agentic LLM systems rather than relying on benchmark claims alone
signals.title_zh: 一份可复现实验 Artifact 对比 Agentic LLM Security Benchmarks，而不是只接受 Benchmark 声明
signals.summary: The Zenodo reproduction artifact packages assessment results, scripts, and instructions for comparing several agentic-LLM security frameworks and benchmarks in a reproducible evaluation setting.
signals.summary_zh: 该 Zenodo Reproduction Artifact 提供多个 Agentic LLM Security Framework/Benchmark 的评估结果、脚本与复现实验说明，用于可重复的跨 Benchmark 比较。

researchValue.failure: Security benchmark names can be treated as interchangeable evidence even when their threat models, tasks, and reproducibility differ materially.
researchValue.finding: The artifact makes cross-benchmark assessment reproducible by packaging evaluation outputs with scripts and execution instructions.
researchValue.mechanism: Compare benchmark applicability through a shared reproducible assessment workflow rather than importing benchmark scores as equivalent evidence.
researchValue.implication: Agent-governance evaluation should record benchmark threat model, reproducibility evidence, and applicability boundaries before using a score for product claims.

signals.title: Codex makes browser and native-app authority a managed policy layer with approval lifetimes
signals.title_zh: Codex 将浏览器与原生应用权限提升为带 Approval Lifetime 的受管策略层
signals.summary: OpenAI's September 3 Codex update gives enterprise administrators browser website defaults and exceptions, upload/download/history/developer-access restrictions, controls for automatic review and saved approvals, explicit approval lifetimes, and native-app allow/block rules.
signals.summary_zh: OpenAI 9 月 3 日的 Codex 更新让企业管理员能够配置 Browser Website Default/Exception、Upload/Download/History/Developer Access 限制、Automatic Review 与 Saved Approval 控制、显式 Approval Lifetime，以及 Native App Allow/Block Rule。

researchValue.failure: Per-site or per-app approvals can silently become indefinite authority when duration, destination class, and managed policy are not first-class runtime facts.
researchValue.mechanism: Separate browser and native-app policy defaults/exceptions from individual approvals, and bind saved approvals to an explicit lifetime under administrator policy.
researchValue.implication: Enterprise digital-employee runtimes should model browser/app authority, destination exceptions, and approval TTL independently from the immediate tool prompt.

signals.title: GitHub separates Copilot's approval judgment from authority to sign off a pull request
signals.title_zh: GitHub 将 Copilot 的 Approval Judgment 与实际 PR Sign-off Authority 分离
signals.summary: GitHub now lets Copilot code review provide an approval assessment on every review while keeping actual pull-request sign-off disabled by default and subject to explicit enterprise, organization, or repository administrator authorization.
signals.summary_zh: GitHub 现在允许 Copilot Code Review 在每次 Review 中给出 Approval Assessment，但真正的 Pull Request Sign-off 默认关闭，只有 Enterprise、Organization 或 Repository 管理员显式授权后才可生效。

researchValue.failure: An AI reviewer can be treated as having merge-governance authority merely because it can produce an approval-like judgment.
researchValue.mechanism: Keep assessment generation always available while separately gating the authority to create an approval that participates in repository merge policy.
researchValue.implication: Digital employees should separate recommendation or judgment from the organizational authority that turns the judgment into an effective approval.

signals.title: Codex versions root authorization evidence so a cached Guardian allow cannot outlive changed authority
signals.title_zh: Codex 对 Root Authorization Evidence 版本化，防止 Cached Guardian Allow 越过权限变化继续生效
signals.summary: Codex retains root instructions and verified answers for delegated Guardian reviews, versions that authorization evidence so an allow result is cancelled when the evidence changes, recovers it across parent compaction, and strips parent-only Guardian approvals when worker history is forked.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 为 Delegated Guardian Review 保留 Root Instruction 与 Verified Answer，对这组授权证据进行版本化，使 Evidence 变化时既有 Allow Result 自动失效；同时支持 Parent Compaction 后恢复，并在 Worker Fork 时剥离 Parent-Only Guardian Approval。

researchValue.failure: A cached allow can remain effective after root instructions or verified answers change, or a parent-only approval can accidentally become child-local authority after a worker fork.
researchValue.mechanism: Version the root authorization evidence used by review, invalidate allows when its version changes, preserve required evidence across compaction, and remove parent-only approvals on fork.
researchValue.implication: Long-running multi-agent runtimes should version authorization evidence and treat compaction and fork as authority-sensitive transitions rather than transparent context operations.

signals.title: Claude Code treats remote permission, stop, and offline delivery as host-owned session state
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 将远程 Permission、Stop 与离线 Delivery 作为 Host-Owned Session State
signals.summary: Claude Code 2.1.261 fixes Remote Control so attached phone/browser clients reflect the terminal's current permission mode, remote Stop interrupts the actual turn, and messages to an offline remote session report queued delivery instead of falsely appearing delivered.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.261 修复 Remote Control：手机/浏览器接入后显示 Terminal 当前真实 Permission Mode；远程 Stop 会中断实际 Turn；向离线 Remote Session 发送消息时明确显示 Queued，而不是误报 Delivered。

researchValue.failure: A remote operator surface can project stale permission, completion, or delivery state and thereby mislead the human about what the execution host is actually doing.
researchValue.mechanism: Treat the execution host as the owner of permission, turn lifecycle, and delivery state, and project those facts to remote clients instead of letting the client infer success locally.
researchValue.implication: Mobile and web control surfaces for digital employees should be projections of host-owned runtime facts, not independent chat-state replicas.

signals.title: Gemini CLI requires consent before extensions mutate the runtime environment
signals.title_zh: Gemini CLI 在 Extension 改变 Runtime Environment 前要求显式 Consent
signals.summary: Gemini CLI now prompts for consent when extensions change environment variables and sanitizes runtime-altering environment variables, making extension installation or activation distinct from permission to alter the execution environment.
signals.summary_zh: Gemini CLI 现在会在 Extension 修改 Environment Variable 时请求 Consent，并清理会改变 Runtime 行为的环境变量，从而把 Extension 安装/启用与修改执行环境的权限明确分开。

researchValue.failure: An installed extension can acquire indirect execution power by mutating loader, proxy, path, or toolchain environment without a distinct authorization event.
researchValue.mechanism: Detect extension-driven environment changes, require explicit consent, and sanitize variables that can alter runtime execution semantics.
researchValue.implication: Agent plugin systems should treat environment mutation as a separate privileged capability rather than an incidental side effect of plugin configuration.

signals.title: MCP Python SDK restricts endpoint redirects to the original trust origin
signals.title_zh: MCP Python SDK 将 Endpoint Redirect 限定在原始 Trust Origin 内
signals.summary: The MCP Python SDK now follows redirects only within the MCP endpoint's origin, constraining discovery and transport redirects so endpoint trust does not silently expand to another origin.
signals.summary_zh: MCP Python SDK 现在只允许在 MCP Endpoint 原始 Origin 内跟随 Redirect，把 Discovery/Transport Redirect 限制在既有 Trust Boundary 内，避免端点信任静默扩展到其他 Origin。

researchValue.failure: An authenticated or trusted MCP endpoint can redirect a client across origins and thereby transfer endpoint trust, credentials, or session semantics to an unintended destination.
researchValue.mechanism: Permit redirect following only when the target remains inside the original MCP endpoint origin.
researchValue.implication: Protocol clients should bind redirect authority to the admitted endpoint trust scope instead of treating HTTP redirect as neutral transport behavior.

signals.title: A reproducible study evaluates agentic Julia code generation under parallel and scalable supercomputing constraints
signals.title_zh: 一份可复现研究在并行与可扩展超算约束下评估 Agentic Julia Code Generation
signals.summary: The Zenodo artifact studies agentic code generation in Julia on supercomputers using an agent extended with Julia documentation that autonomously plans, generates, and refines code through tool use, shifting evaluation beyond single-shot generation toward parallel and scalable execution constraints.
signals.summary_zh: 该 Zenodo Artifact 研究 Julia 在 Supercomputer 上的 Agentic Code Generation：Agent 接入 Julia Documentation 后通过 Tool Use 自主规划、生成并迭代代码，把评估从 Single-Shot Generation 扩展到并行与可扩展执行约束。

researchValue.failure: Code-generation benchmarks can overstate engineering readiness when they measure only one-shot correctness and omit the agent's iterative tool-use behavior and the generated program's scaling constraints.
researchValue.finding: The artifact evaluates an autonomous plan-generate-refine loop for Julia code in a supercomputing setting rather than limiting assessment to single-shot output.
researchValue.mechanism: Use a reproducible agent loop and HPC execution setting to evaluate generated code under parallel and scalability constraints.
researchValue.implication: Agentic software-engineering evaluation should record tool-mediated refinement and operational scaling evidence separately from code-generation accuracy.
