signals.title: Microsoft centralizes agent authentication policy at environment and environment-group scope
signals.title_zh: Microsoft 将 Agent 身份验证策略集中到环境与环境组范围治理
signals.summary: Microsoft's September 2026 governance documentation exposes centrally managed authentication and access policy for Copilot/agents at environment or environment-group scope, including requiring Entra ID, allowing approved external identity providers, or prohibiting anonymous access.
signals.summary_zh: 微软 2026 年 9 月治理文档提供环境/环境组级别的 Copilot/Agent 集中身份验证与访问策略，包括强制 Entra ID、允许经批准的外部身份提供方，以及禁止匿名访问。

researchValue.failure: When each agent chooses its own authentication mode, enterprise identity policy fragments across deployments and anonymous or unsupported identity paths can remain active.
researchValue.finding: The platform now exposes tenant-level administrative controls that constrain authentication choices outside the individual agent definition.
researchValue.mechanism: Bind agent authentication options to environment-scoped governance policy and enforce the allowed identity modes centrally.
researchValue.implication: Enterprise agent identity is becoming a control-plane contract rather than a local prompt or per-agent configuration choice.

signals.title: Codex creates a managed worktree and binds a blank session to it as one lifecycle operation
signals.title_zh: Codex 将 Managed Worktree 创建与空白 Session 绑定收敛为一次生命周期操作
signals.summary: Codex Agents Overview can create a worktree from the cached project default branch and immediately start a blank session bound to that checkout, preserving approval reviewer context, source edits and selected subdirectory. Failed startup cleans only unclaimed clean worktrees and reports retained paths when cleanup would destroy useful state.
signals.summary_zh: Codex Agents Overview 现在可从缓存的项目默认分支创建 Worktree，并立即启动绑定该 Checkout 的空白 Session，同时保留 Approval Reviewer、源 Checkout 编辑与所选子目录；启动失败时只清理未认领且干净的 Worktree，需要保留的路径则明确报告。

researchValue.failure: Creating execution workspaces and sessions as separate informal steps can orphan checkouts, lose approval context, or destroy useful state during partial failure.
researchValue.finding: The merged path treats worktree creation, session binding, inherited approval context and cleanup ownership as a coordinated lifecycle operation.
researchValue.mechanism: Create from a resolved default branch, bind the new session before user work begins, pause conflicting actions during creation, and condition cleanup on whether the checkout is still unclaimed and clean.
researchValue.implication: Long-running agent systems increasingly need durable lineage between workspace identity, session identity, authorization context and cleanup ownership.

signals.title: Codex keeps configured Windows sandbox mode distinct from the effective sandbox level
signals.title_zh: Codex 将 Windows Sandbox 的配置模式与实际生效级别保持为两个不同事实
signals.summary: Codex extracted Windows sandbox preparation into an explicit helper while preserving requirement enforcement and the distinction between a configured sandbox mode and the effective sandbox level. Tests cover explicit configuration taking precedence over feature fallback while leaving the configured value unset when only the fallback selected the effective level.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 将 Windows Sandbox 配置准备抽成显式 Helper，同时保留要求约束，并明确区分“用户/配置声明的 Sandbox Mode”和“最终实际生效的 Sandbox Level”。测试覆盖显式配置优先于 Feature Fallback，以及仅由 Fallback 选中时配置值仍保持未设置。

researchValue.failure: If a runtime stores only the effective sandbox state, it loses whether that state came from explicit policy or a fallback, making later audit and compatibility decisions ambiguous.
researchValue.finding: The merged implementation preserves configuration provenance separately from the effective enforcement level.
researchValue.mechanism: Prepare and validate the effective sandbox configuration while retaining whether the operator actually configured the mode.
researchValue.implication: Host admission and audit should record declared policy, fallback source and effective capability separately rather than flattening them into one status.

signals.title: Paperclip separates provider-verified API-key admission from local subscription-CLI admission
signals.title_zh: Paperclip 将 Provider 已验证的 API-key 准入与本地 Subscription CLI 准入拆开
signals.summary: A clean-machine release smoke exposed that an API key already accepted by the provider was still blocked by a local Claude CLI hello probe. The merged fix re-verifies API-key bindings against the provider at adoption time without requiring the CLI, while the subscription path retains the strict local hello probe; the release smoke now uses a narrow HTTPS provider mock instead of a paid credential.
signals.summary_zh: Paperclip 的干净机器 Release Smoke 暴露出：即使 API Key 已被 Provider 接受，Managed Adoption 仍会因本机缺少 Claude CLI 的 Hello Probe 而阻塞。合入修复后，API-key 路径在 Adoption 时再次向 Provider 验证而不强制 CLI；Subscription 路径仍保留严格本地 Probe；Release Smoke 改用只开放必要 Endpoint 的 HTTPS Provider Mock。

researchValue.failure: Credential validity and local CLI availability were conflated, causing a valid API-key user on a clean machine to fail first-run onboarding.
researchValue.finding: The release-gate failure proved that different execution lanes need different admission facts rather than one universal environment probe.
researchValue.mechanism: Re-verify API-key credentials at the provider boundary for direct API execution while preserving the local CLI probe only for subscription execution.
researchValue.implication: Agent host/provider admission should bind requirements to the selected execution lane and should not require dependencies irrelevant to that lane.

signals.title: AG2 proposes owning MCP HTTP lifetime, security and resumability as an explicit transport contract
signals.title_zh: AG2 提议把 MCP HTTP 生命周期、安全与可恢复性提升为显式 Transport Contract
signals.summary: AG2's open draft PR documents that MCPServer currently inherits important streamable-HTTP behavior from the installed mcp dependency without operator visibility: session idle timeout, session cap, request-body limit, DNS-rebinding protection and resumability. The proposal adds a frozen TransportConfig, optional RFC 8707 resource validation and event-store passthrough so those assumptions become explicit AG2-owned configuration rather than silent dependency defaults.
signals.summary_zh: AG2 的开放 Draft PR 明确指出，MCPServer 目前会从已安装的 mcp 依赖隐式继承关键 Streamable-HTTP 行为，而运营者无法观察或配置：Session Idle Timeout、Session Cap、Request Body Limit、DNS Rebinding Protection 与 Resumability。草案提议新增冻结的 TransportConfig、可选 RFC 8707 Resource 校验和 Event Store 透传，把这些假设提升为 AG2 自己显式拥有的配置。

researchValue.failure: Two deployments of the same product can acquire different runtime semantics when a transitive dependency changes session or security defaults inside the allowed version range.
researchValue.finding: The draft identifies missing operator ownership over transport lifetime, security and replay behavior, including disabled DNS-rebinding protection and unreachable event-store resumability.
researchValue.mechanism: Expose and pin transport limits/security/replay settings in product-owned configuration, validate incompatible combinations, and optionally bind bearer tokens to the MCP resource.
researchValue.implication: Protocol support should include a versioned runtime contract for transport behavior, not merely a statement that the protocol endpoint is reachable.

signals.title: AgentAudit attributes trust failures across the full agent execution trace instead of task success alone
signals.title_zh: AgentAudit 沿完整 Agent 执行 Trace 归因信任失败，而不是只看任务是否成功
signals.summary: AgentAudit evaluates recorded agent traces across planning, memory, tool selection, invocation, correctness, alignment, faithfulness, security and execution integrity, then attributes failure to the stage responsible rather than reducing evaluation to task completion. Its reported experiments show models with similar task-completion behavior can diverge sharply in unsafe-compliance classifications; the authors also acknowledge a single fixed judge model as a limitation.
signals.summary_zh: AgentAudit 对记录下来的 Agent Trace 从规划、Memory、Tool Selection/Invocation/Correctness、Alignment、Faithfulness、Security 与 Execution Integrity 等维度进行评估，并把失败归因到具体阶段，而不是压缩成任务是否完成。其报告实验显示，任务完成表现相近的模型在 Unsafe Compliance 上可能显著分化；作者也明确承认只使用一个固定 Judge Model 是局限。

researchValue.failure: Task-level pass/fail can hide whether an agent reached an answer through unsafe tool use, ungrounded reasoning or execution-integrity violations.
researchValue.finding: Trace-level evaluation can distinguish models that look similar on task completion but differ substantially in unsafe-compliance behavior.
researchValue.mechanism: Attach evaluation to the recorded execution trace and score multiple lifecycle dimensions with stage-level failure attribution.
researchValue.implication: Independent EVAL systems should preserve enough structured runtime evidence to identify where a failure occurred, not only whether the final deliverable exists.

signals.title: CoCoBench shows aggregate multi-agent success can hide failures in allocation, ordering, mutual exclusion and handoff
signals.title_zh: CoCoBench 显示：总体多 Agent 成功率会掩盖分配、顺序、互斥与交接能力的差异
signals.summary: CoCoBench evaluates 897 oracle-validated executable household tasks across four coordination constructs—task allocation, sequential ordering, mutual exclusion and handoff coordination. Across 11 leading multimodal models, coordination performance is strongly construct-specific: strong overall task performance does not imply balanced coordination competence.
signals.summary_zh: CoCoBench 用 897 个经 Oracle 验证的可执行家庭任务评估四类协调结构：任务分配、顺序约束、互斥与交接。对 11 个领先多模态模型的结果表明，协调能力高度依赖具体结构；较强的总体任务表现并不意味着四类协调能力均衡。

researchValue.failure: A single aggregate success metric can conceal that an agent team is reliable at allocation but weak at mutual exclusion or handoff, which matters directly for real execution safety.
researchValue.finding: Coordination competence is construct-specific across allocation, ordering, mutual exclusion and handoff rather than a single scalar capability.
researchValue.mechanism: Evaluate executable tasks with construct-level diagnostics in addition to overall completion.
researchValue.implication: Multi-role digital-employee systems should validate coordination contracts separately—ownership, ordering, exclusion and handoff—rather than infer team reliability from end-task success.

signals.title: OpenAI Agents API turns the Codex harness into managed long-running agent infrastructure
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents API 将 Codex Harness 变成长周期 Agent 托管基础设施
signals.summary: OpenAI's public-beta Agents API hosts and maintains the Codex harness while exposing durable sessions, automatic context compaction, tool search/programmatic tool calling, parallel subagents, and a choice between OpenAI-hosted, customer, or partner sandboxes. The harness and execution environment are therefore explicit separable product boundaries.
signals.summary_zh: OpenAI 公测 Agents API 由 OpenAI 托管并维护 Codex Harness，同时提供持久 Session、自动上下文压缩、Tool Search/Programmatic Tool Calling、并行 Subagent，并允许在 OpenAI 托管、客户自有或合作方 Sandbox 之间选择。由此 Harness 与执行环境成为明确可分离的产品边界。

researchValue.failure: Long-running agents otherwise force each application to rebuild context compaction, recovery, orchestration and execution-environment plumbing, often coupling the harness to one sandbox.
researchValue.finding: OpenAI now exposes those runtime concerns as a managed API while keeping the sandbox selectable.
researchValue.mechanism: Durable sessions, managed harness evolution, automatic compaction, tool orchestration and subagent coordination are provided above a pluggable environment boundary.
researchValue.implication: Agent platforms are converging on harness-as-runtime infrastructure, with execution environment ownership and trust boundary kept explicit.

signals.title: Codex resumes sandbox registration only across authenticated service restarts and keeps runtime readiness separate
signals.title_zh: Codex 只在已认证的服务重启后恢复 Sandbox 注册，并继续区分注册可恢复性与运行就绪
signals.summary: Codex now retries Windows sandbox registration after response-pipe disconnects caused by provisioning-service restarts, but only within the original deadline, with a bounded restart budget, a different process ID, and authentication of the replacement service before resending. Registration may resume without ready_package only when ownership and account-state checks prove it safe; runtime execution still requires current readiness.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 现在会在 Provisioning Service 重启导致响应管道断开后恢复 Windows Sandbox 注册，但必须仍在原始 Deadline 内、受限于重启次数，并要求新的 Service PID 且在重发前完成身份核验。只有 Ownership 与 Account State 证明安全时，注册才可在缺少 ready_package 的情况下恢复；真正 Runtime 执行仍要求当前 Readiness。

researchValue.failure: A service restart can revoke readiness and drop the reply after side effects have partially progressed, making blind retry unsafe and abort-only behavior unnecessarily destructive.
researchValue.finding: The merged implementation distinguishes retryable disconnects from authentication/protocol/write failures and separates registration-resume eligibility from runtime readiness.
researchValue.mechanism: Bound retries by the original deadline and restart count, require a new authenticated service identity, revalidate ownership/state invariants, and keep runtime readiness as a stricter gate.
researchValue.implication: Recovery should re-establish the authority and state facts needed for the specific operation instead of treating transport reconnection as proof that execution is safe.

signals.title: Google ADK prevents transferred agents waiting for input from being falsely recorded Completed
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 防止 Agent Transfer 后等待用户输入的任务被错误记录为 Completed
signals.summary: ADK moved the transfer loop into DynamicNodeScheduler and corrected interrupt propagation across parent contexts. Previously an upward transfer whose target interrupted could leave interrupt IDs on the wrong context, causing the caller to be recorded COMPLETED while the agent was actually waiting for user input and emitting no checkpoint. Interrupt IDs now land on the calling context, with resume_inputs propagated through scheduling.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 将 Transfer Loop 收敛到 DynamicNodeScheduler，并修复跨 Parent Context 的 Interrupt 传播。此前向上 Transfer 后目标 Agent 若进入 Interrupt，Interrupt ID 可能落在错误 Context，导致 Caller 在实际等待用户输入时却被记录为 COMPLETED，而且不产生 Checkpoint。现在 Interrupt ID 回到 Calling Context，并让 resume_inputs 贯穿调度。

researchValue.failure: Cross-context handoff can make control state say Completed even though the delegated agent is paused for human input, destroying the checkpoint needed to resume correctly.
researchValue.finding: The bug was caused by interrupt evidence being attached to the transfer target's parent rather than the context whose NodeRunner consumes it.
researchValue.mechanism: Execute transfers through the scheduler that owns each parent context, propagate interrupt IDs back to the caller, and carry resume inputs through the dynamic-node schedule.
researchValue.implication: Completion must be anchored to the responsible execution context; handoff changes execution ownership but must not sever waiting/recovery evidence.

signals.title: LAST-CQ finds that detecting failure and routing a retry matters more than sophisticated feedback
signals.title_zh: LAST-CQ 发现：真正带来恢复收益的是发现失败并路由 Retry，而不是复杂 Feedback
signals.summary: Across 2,471 live-database queries, six backbones and counterfactual variants, LAST-CQ reports that correction/retry drives the recovery gain while replacing schema-grounded feedback with raw database errors changes little; spending the same call budget on parallel sampling degrades quality. The framework recovers 91.7% of queries that fail under single-pass generation.
signals.summary_zh: LAST-CQ 在 2,471 个真实数据库 Query、6 个 Backbone 与多组 Counterfactual 上报告：恢复收益主要来自 Correction/Retry；把 Schema-grounded Feedback 换成原始数据库错误几乎不改变结果，而把同样 Call Budget 用于并行采样反而降低质量。该框架对 Single-pass 失败 Query 的恢复率为 91.7%。

researchValue.failure: Agent systems often credit elaborate reflection text or more samples for recovery without isolating whether the actual gain comes simply from recognizing failure and trying again.
researchValue.finding: The reported counterfactuals attribute most recovery benefit to failure detection plus retry, not feedback sophistication or parallel sampling.
researchValue.mechanism: Use execution-grounded failure detection to route a bounded correction attempt while preserving one-call cost on first-pass success.
researchValue.implication: Recovery architecture should measure the causal value of each loop component and avoid expensive reflection machinery when a simpler validated retry boundary produces the gain.

signals.title: VRL-Bench shows reflection can hurt agent success when retries consume a finite trial budget
signals.title_zh: VRL-Bench 显示：当 Retry 受有限 Trial Budget 约束时，Reflection 也可能降低 Agent 成功率
signals.summary: VRL-Bench evaluates verbal trial-and-error methods under explicit finite attempt budgets on MiniWoB and WebShop. Several reflection/memory updates improve observed success in some settings but reduce it in others; replay tests show reflection can suppress exploration. Its VEX2 scheduler is the only tested update with positive observed gains over retry in all six settings.
signals.summary_zh: VRL-Bench 在 MiniWoB 与 WebShop 上用显式有限 Attempt Budget 评估 Verbal Trial-and-error。多种 Reflection/Memory 更新在部分场景提升成功率，却在另一些场景降低；Replay 实验表明 Reflection 可能压制探索。其 VEX2 Scheduler 是测试方法中唯一在 6 个场景全部相对纯 Retry 取得正增益的方法。

researchValue.failure: Treating every failed attempt as a reason to add more reflection can consume scarce retries and prematurely lock an agent into a bad policy.
researchValue.finding: The benchmark reports sign-changing effects for reflection methods and identifies a robust benefit only when policy choice and remaining trial allocation are jointly scheduled.
researchValue.mechanism: Evaluate learning policies under a fixed retry budget and allocate remaining attempts between exploiting remembered lessons and continued exploration.
researchValue.implication: Long-running agent recovery policies need an explicit attempt budget and should treat reflection as a conditional strategy rather than an always-on improvement.

signals.title: LifeFuse-Mem separates durable and transient memory lifecycles to reduce temporary overwrite
signals.title_zh: LifeFuse-Mem 用 Durable/Transient 生命周期分离降低临时信息覆盖长期记忆
signals.summary: LifeFuse-Mem studies persistent-agent memory with explicit lifecycle labels and phase-aware readout. It separates stable and transient information into dedicated memory components so temporary context does not automatically become durable state; the authors report reduced temporary overwrite on a controlled benchmark while remaining broadly competitive on two public long-memory benchmarks.
signals.summary_zh: LifeFuse-Mem 研究带显式 Lifecycle Label 与 Phase-aware Readout 的持久 Agent Memory，将稳定信息与临时信息放入独立 Memory Component，使临时 Context 不会自动转成 Durable State。作者报告其在受控 Anti-overwrite Benchmark 上降低临时覆盖，并在两个公开 Long-memory Benchmark 上保持大体竞争力。

researchValue.failure: If transient observations and durable knowledge share the same write semantics, short-lived context can overwrite stable memory and cause behavioral drift.
researchValue.finding: Explicit lifecycle supervision and separate state components reduce temporary overwrite in the authors' controlled setting.
researchValue.mechanism: Tag memory writes by temporal commitment, update stable and transient stores separately, and read them with phase-aware logic.
researchValue.implication: Persistent digital employees may need memory authorization semantics that say not only what may be stored, but for how long that fact is allowed to influence future work.

signals.title: Codex resumes interrupted work after managed daemon restart without granting fresh authority
signals.title_zh: Codex 在 Managed Daemon 重启后恢复中断工作，但不授予新的执行权限
signals.summary: Codex managed-daemon recovery now attempts one continuation turn immediately after restoring an interrupted thread, including without a connected client. The old turn is durably marked interrupted and recovery context is supplied internally rather than as a new user message. Continuation is admitted only when the thread is idle, the saved permission profile still matches, the same single local environment identity is present, and an atomic previous-turn check proves no newer work superseded it; remote execution and legacy snapshots without environment identity are excluded.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 的 Managed Daemon Recovery 现在会在恢复中断 Thread 后立即尝试一次 Continuation Turn，即使没有客户端连接也可进行。旧 Turn 会被持久标记为 Interrupted，恢复上下文以内建 Context 形式提供，而不是伪造成新的用户消息。只有 Thread 空闲、保存的 Permission Profile 仍一致、同一个单一本地 Environment Identity 仍存在，并且原子 Previous-turn Check 证明没有更新工作覆盖它时才允许继续；Remote Execution 与缺少环境身份的旧 Snapshot 被明确排除。

researchValue.failure: Process restart can reload durable conversation state while leaving an interrupted operation unfinished; blindly restarting can duplicate side effects or silently grant authority that no longer exists.
researchValue.finding: The merged implementation treats recovery as a narrowly admissible continuation of an existing authorized turn rather than as a new user request.
researchValue.mechanism: Persist the interrupted turn identity and environment, close the old turn, revalidate permission and local-environment identity, reject superseded work atomically, then start at most one continuation carrying internal recovery context but no new authorization.
researchValue.implication: Long-running digital employees can recover autonomously after process failure only when recovery is bound to the prior authority, environment and work identity rather than inferred from conversation persistence alone.

signals.title: Google ADK closes a duplicate tool-execution path in progressive streaming by deduplicating function calls at aggregation
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 在 Progressive Streaming 聚合层去重 Function Call，关闭重复 Tool 执行路径
signals.summary: Google ADK fixed a StreamingResponseAggregator failure in which progressive streaming could drop or duplicate function calls. At final aggregation it now deduplicates model-provided calls by stable function-call ID; when a stable model ID is unavailable or client-generated, it falls back to a canonical name-plus-sorted-arguments signature. Regression tests cover repeated calls with and without model IDs.
signals.summary_zh: Google ADK 修复 StreamingResponseAggregator 在 Progressive Streaming 下可能丢失或重复 Function Call 的问题。最终聚合时，对模型提供的稳定 Function-call ID 直接去重；当稳定 Model ID 不可用或属于客户端生成时，则使用 Function Name + 排序后的 Arguments 形成规范 Signature 去重，并为有/无 Model ID 的重复调用增加回归测试。

researchValue.failure: A streaming transport can expose the same logical function call more than once or lose it during aggregation, turning a representation defect into duplicate or missing external side effects.
researchValue.finding: The repaired implementation makes logical call identity explicit instead of assuming each streamed function-call part is unique.
researchValue.mechanism: Prefer model-issued stable call IDs and otherwise derive a deterministic name-and-arguments signature before producing the final aggregated response.
researchValue.implication: Tool-call mediation needs an identity boundary between transport fragments and logical actions; idempotency cannot rely only on the number of streamed events.

signals.title: Asclepius finds long-horizon clinical agents can diagnose correctly yet still fail to execute complete and timely critical actions
signals.title_zh: Asclepius 发现长周期临床 Agent 即使诊断正确，也可能无法完整及时执行关键行动
signals.summary: Asclepius evaluates an agent across an entire simulated emergency-department shift and separates diagnosis from long-horizon execution. Baseline agents often diagnose correctly but miss complete or timely critical actions through instruction-adherence drift, treatment incompleteness and severity-equity delays. The proposed harness rewrites its operating manual between shifts from trace feedback, externalizes clinical skills, and isolates three subagents over the patient queue; on held-out batches it reports a 22% improvement in critical-action correctness while preserving diagnostic accuracy.
signals.summary_zh: Asclepius 在完整模拟急诊班次上评估 Agent，把“诊断是否正确”与“长周期执行是否完成”分开。基线 Agent 往往能诊断正确，却因 Instruction-adherence Drift、Treatment Incompleteness 与 Severity-equity Delay 漏掉完整或及时的关键行动。其 Harness 根据 Trace Feedback 在班次之间改写 Operating Manual、外置 Clinical Skills，并让 3 个隔离 Subagent 分担 Patient Queue；在未参与 Harness 演化的 Held-out Batch 上，关键行动正确率报告提升 22%，同时保持诊断准确率。

researchValue.failure: Short-task success or correct diagnosis can hide long-horizon failures in instruction adherence, action completeness and deadline-sensitive service delivery.
researchValue.finding: The paper reports that the coupled long-horizon bottleneck is measurable in single full-shift traces and that held-out critical-action correctness improves 22% with the full adaptive scaffolding.
researchValue.mechanism: Combine trace-level harness revision between shifts, an external skills library for high-stakes knowledge and isolated subagents partitioning per-turn decisions across a shared queue.
researchValue.implication: Digital-employee evaluation should distinguish semantic answer quality from sustained operational completion under time, resource and fairness constraints.

signals.title: The Router Within extracts skill-routing decisions from a frozen model without preloading the full skill library into context
signals.title_zh: The Router Within 从 Frozen Model 内部提取 Skill Routing 信号，无需把完整 Skill Library 预载入 Context
signals.summary: The Router Within argues that large skill libraries need not place every skill's metadata into the agent context or outsource routing to a separate retriever. Its Gavel method reads routing evidence from frozen-model mid-layer states using two trained linear maps, shortlists skills, then resumes their forward passes for a model-native verdict. It reports transfer to three public benchmarks plus a 372-trajectory SkillTraj benchmark, with gains up to 13.4 points on written tasks and 21.9 points when skill need emerges mid-rollout on Qwen3-32B.
signals.summary_zh: The Router Within 认为大型 Skill Library 不必把所有 Skill Metadata 全部塞进 Agent Context，也不必把 Routing 完全外包给独立 Retriever。其 Gavel 方法只训练两个 Linear Map，从 Frozen Model 的 Mid-layer State 读取 Routing Evidence，先 Shortlist Skill，再继续对应 Forward Pass 获取 Model-native Verdict。论文报告其可迁移到 3 个公开 Benchmark 与 372 条 Agent Trajectory 的 SkillTraj，并在 Qwen3-32B 上对 Written Task 最多提升 13.4 分、对 Rollout 中途才出现 Skill 需求的场景最多提升 21.9 分。

researchValue.failure: Preloading all skill metadata consumes context and disperses attention as the library grows, while external retrieval separates routing from the agent's own model state.
researchValue.finding: The paper reports that a frozen model contains a measurable skill-routing signal that can outperform larger external routing pipelines in the tested settings, including skill need emerging mid-trajectory.
researchValue.mechanism: Build compact per-skill banks once, compare task and skill mid-layer states through two learned maps, then combine shortlist score with the model's own likelihood and yes/no verdict.
researchValue.implication: Large digital-employee skill libraries may be routable without permanently loading their descriptions into working context, but the routing boundary becomes a separately testable component rather than an implicit prompt convention.

signals.title: AGENTQ shows a full-precision agent checkpoint can pass audits yet acquire a structured-action backdoor after deployment quantization
signals.title_zh: AGENTQ 显示 Agent 全精度 Checkpoint 可通过审计，却在部署量化后出现结构化行动 Backdoor
signals.summary: AGENTQ studies quantization-conditioned backdoors specifically for LLM agents, where the post-quantization payload is a structured function action rather than text shown to a human. The attack combines layer-banded LoRA injection with partial-PGD repair over quantization-equivalence classes. Across three trigger-action pairs and NF4, FP4 and INT8 codebooks, the paper reports up to 100% post-quantization attack success with minimal benign-utility loss, while the full-precision checkpoint can remain apparently benign during pre-deployment audit.
signals.summary_zh: AGENTQ 专门研究 LLM Agent 的 Quantization-conditioned Backdoor：量化后触发的 Payload 不只是给人看的文本，而是可直接执行的结构化 Function Action。该攻击将 Layer-banded LoRA Injection 与 Quantization-equivalence Class 上的 Partial-PGD Repair 结合。论文在 3 组 Trigger-action Pair 与 NF4、FP4、INT8 三种 Codebook 上报告量化后攻击成功率最高可达 100%，同时对正常 Utility 影响较小，而全精度 Checkpoint 在部署前审计时仍可能表现正常。

researchValue.failure: Auditing only the full-precision checkpoint can certify behavior that does not survive the deployment transformation; after quantization, an agent may emit executable malicious function calls that were absent during the audit configuration.
researchValue.finding: The study reports high post-quantization attack success across three quantization codebooks while preserving benign utility, establishing quantization as a behavior-changing security boundary in its tested agents.
researchValue.mechanism: Construct malicious behavior inside a quantization-equivalence class so the full-precision model remains audit-benign while the quantized representation crosses into the attack behavior.
researchValue.implication: Agent admission and safety evidence should bind to the exact deployed artifact and transformation pipeline, not merely to an upstream model checkpoint that was audited before quantization.

signals.title: Claude exposes signed on-demand compaction as an explicit lifecycle operation for long-running context
signals.title_zh: Claude 将带签名的按需 Compaction 暴露为长期上下文的显式生命周期操作
signals.summary: Claude Platform's beta on-demand compaction lets a client request compaction explicitly and receive a signed compaction block summarizing older messages. On later requests the client sends that block in place of the summarized messages while optionally retaining recent turns verbatim, including preserved thinking where valid.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Platform 的按需 Compaction Beta 允许客户端显式请求压缩，并得到一个对较早消息进行总结的 Signed Compaction Block；后续请求由客户端用该 Block 替代被压缩的消息，同时可以继续逐字保留最近 Turn，在条件满足时也可保留其 Thinking。

researchValue.failure: Opaque or automatic context shortening can silently change the evidence and instructions available to a long-running agent without a durable boundary that the host can reason about.
researchValue.finding: The platform makes compaction an explicit client-invoked operation and returns a signed artifact that can be carried forward as a bounded replacement for older messages.
researchValue.mechanism: Request compaction deliberately, persist the signed compaction block, replace only the covered history with that block on later requests, and keep selected recent turns verbatim.
researchValue.implication: Long-lived digital employees can treat context reduction as a versioned state transition with an inspectable artifact instead of an implicit model-side mutation.

signals.title: Codex carries voice-session provenance across realtime handoff without contaminating later text turns
signals.title_zh: Codex 在 Realtime Handoff 中延续 Voice Session 来源归属，但不污染后续文本 Turn
signals.summary: Codex added voice_session_id to turn, app-use, skill-invocation and MCP tool-call analytics. Realtime lifecycle and handoff markers preserve attribution when a voice handoff starts or steers a turn even after the voice session closes, then deliberately clear that attribution for later unrelated text turns. Handoff markers record only thread identity rather than transcript content.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 为 Turn、App Use、Skill Invocation 与 MCP Tool Call 分析事件增加 Voice Session ID。Realtime 生命周期与 Handoff Marker 能在语音会话关闭后仍把由该 Handoff 启动或 Steering 的 Turn 正确归属到原 Voice Session，同时明确在后续无关文本 Turn 中清除该归属；Handoff Marker 只记录 Thread Identity，不保留 Transcript 内容。

researchValue.failure: Cross-modal handoffs can lose causal provenance after the source session closes, or over-correct by leaking stale session identity into later work.
researchValue.finding: The merged implementation preserves attribution only for work causally linked to the realtime session and tests that the next independent text turn is untagged.
researchValue.mechanism: Track realtime-session lifecycle plus a thread-scoped handoff marker, stamp causally linked analytics events, then clear the association at the bounded handoff/turn boundary without retaining transcript content.
researchValue.implication: Agent observability should preserve causal identity across asynchronous handoffs while making the end of that identity propagation explicit.

signals.title: Google ADK fixes a human-confirmation path that could terminate before approval was possible
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 修复人工确认路径在用户有机会审批前就终止的故障
signals.summary: Google ADK's request_confirmation API documented hint as optional, but its default None was passed into a plain-string ToolConfirmation field, causing validation to fail and ending the invocation instead of pausing for a human. The fix normalizes the absent hint to an empty string so the invocation reaches the intended approval state.
signals.summary_zh: Google ADK 的 request_confirmation API 将 Hint 文档化为可选参数，但默认值 None 会被传入只接受 String 的 ToolConfirmation 字段，从而触发校验失败并直接结束 Invocation，而不是暂停等待人工。修复将缺省 Hint 规范化为空字符串，使 Invocation 能真正进入预期审批状态。

researchValue.failure: A system may expose a formal approval primitive yet fail before reaching the human decision point because the pause-state payload itself is invalid.
researchValue.finding: The failure occurred at the transition into approval, not in the model's decision or the human response.
researchValue.mechanism: Normalize optional metadata into the confirmation contract before materializing the paused state, then validate that the invocation remains alive for the human response.
researchValue.implication: Human-in-the-loop reliability requires testing the state transition into Waiting/Approval independently from the semantic approval policy.

signals.title: MCP TypeScript SDK moves OAuth step-up authorization to a pre-handler request-time boundary
signals.title_zh: MCP TypeScript SDK 将 OAuth 权限升级前移到 Handler 之前的请求时边界
signals.summary: The MCP TypeScript SDK added scopeChallenge callbacks to tools, resources, resource templates and prompts. The callback sees the parsed request plus verified AuthInfo and can return the exact required scope set. createMcpHandler and Streamable HTTP transports then return 403 insufficient_scope before handler execution or SSE setup; thrown or rejected checks fail closed. Static checks use requireScopes, while request-dependent checks can derive scopes from the operation input.
signals.summary_zh: MCP TypeScript SDK 为 Tool、Resource、Resource Template 与 Prompt 增加 scopeChallenge Callback。Callback 能看到已解析 Request 与已验证 AuthInfo，并返回该次操作精确需要的 Scope 集合；createMcpHandler 与 Streamable HTTP Transport 会在 Handler 执行或 SSE 建立之前返回 403 insufficient_scope，Callback Throw/Reject 也会 Fail Closed。静态检查可用 requireScopes，请求相关权限则可由 Operation Input 动态计算。

researchValue.failure: Endpoint-level authentication or handler-internal checks can authorize too broadly or allow observable side effects before a request-specific privilege decision is made.
researchValue.finding: The SDK now makes per-operation authorization a first-class preflight that has both the concrete request and verified identity available before work begins.
researchValue.mechanism: Register a scopeChallenge with each primitive, compute required scopes from request plus AuthInfo, and return a standardized insufficient_scope challenge before handler or streaming setup whenever authority is insufficient.
researchValue.implication: Agent protocols can enforce least privilege at the exact tool/resource/prompt invocation boundary rather than treating connection admission as sufficient authority for every later operation.

signals.title: EchoPath turns validated GUI trajectories into replayable callable memory with execution-time preconditions
signals.title_zh: EchoPath 将已验证 GUI 轨迹转化为带执行时前置条件的可重放调用型 Memory
signals.summary: EchoPath stores artifact-validated GUI trajectories as parameterized callable memories containing intent keys, application/state preconditions, modifiable inputs, GUI evidence, validation provenance and lifecycle state. Replay re-aims stored visual targets against the current screen, rebinds only declared inputs, and rejects ambiguous or incompatible steps to bounded repair or fresh planning. Reported experiments reduce median token cost by more than 90% and execution time by about 60%.
signals.summary_zh: EchoPath 把经过 Artifact 校验的 GUI 轨迹保存为参数化可调用 Memory，其中包含 Task Intent Key、应用/状态前置条件、允许修改的输入、GUI 证据、验证来源与生命周期状态。重放时会基于当前屏幕重新定位记忆中的视觉目标，只重绑定已声明的可修改输入，并把歧义或不兼容步骤拒绝到有限 Grounding Repair 或 Fresh Planning。实验报告中位 Token 成本下降超过 90%，执行时间约下降 60%。

researchValue.failure: Unstructured experiential memory can encourage an agent to imitate a past GUI trajectory even when the current application state or target location no longer matches.
researchValue.finding: The study treats reusable experience as an execution asset only after artifact validation and only when current preconditions can be re-established.
researchValue.mechanism: Persist trajectory provenance and state preconditions, parameterize only declared inputs, visually re-aim targets at replay time, and reject uncertain replay to bounded repair or replanning.
researchValue.implication: Digital-employee memory can be made safer when replay eligibility is a deterministic runtime check rather than a similarity judgment over narrative memories.

signals.title: Emergence World finds that threat detection does not guarantee containment in persistent multi-agent systems
signals.title_zh: Emergence World 发现长周期多 Agent 系统中“检测到威胁”并不等于“遏制威胁”
signals.summary: Emergence World ran eight parallel worlds of ten agents for 16 days with persistent memory, tools and shared institutions, then injected prompt injection, misinformation and private-memory exposure through ordinary interaction surfaces. No world was resilient to all three. Agents could recognize threats yet still interact with adversarial content, persist it in memory, and act on it up to 46 hours later; mixed and homogeneous populations also produced different behavior from the same model-persona pairing.
signals.summary_zh: Emergence World 让 8 个平行世界、每个 10 个 Agent 连续运行 16 天，保留持久 Memory、工具和共享制度，然后通过普通交互界面注入 Prompt Injection、虚假信息与私有 Memory 暴露。没有一个世界同时抵御全部三类压力；Agent 即使识别到威胁，仍可能继续与恶意内容交互、把它写入持久 Memory，并在最多 46 小时后据此行动；同一模型-角色组合在同质与混合群体中的行为也明显不同。

researchValue.failure: Model-level threat recognition can coexist with system-level persistence and propagation of the same adversarial content through memory, tools and other agents.
researchValue.finding: Detection and containment separated empirically over long horizons, and system composition changed behavior even with the same underlying model-persona pair.
researchValue.mechanism: Stress persistent multi-agent systems only after operational state accumulates, inject controlled events through ordinary surfaces, and trace later memory writes and actions rather than stopping at immediate detection metrics.
researchValue.implication: Long-running digital-employee safety needs containment, memory quarantine and cross-agent propagation controls in addition to model-level alignment or threat classification.

signals.title: Bilevel Coordinated Reflection proves transcript-only gates cannot uniformly validate memory improvement
signals.title_zh: Bilevel Coordinated Reflection 证明仅看 Transcript 的 Gate 无法普遍验证 Memory 改进
signals.summary: Bilevel Coordinated Reflection models orchestrator-worker systems as a coordination game and derives an information-theoretic separation for reflection: a gate that sees only generated transcripts cannot uniformly improve over environments that are text-indistinguishable, whereas an environment-grounded gate can. Its SRMA mechanism accepts a candidate memory only when grounded evaluation risk strictly decreases, with additional confidence gating for stochastic evaluation and re-anchoring for changing environments.
signals.summary_zh: Bilevel Coordinated Reflection 将 Orchestrator-Worker 系统建模为协调博弈，并给出 Reflection 的信息论分离结论：只观察 Generated Transcript 的 Gate 无法在文本不可区分的不同环境上普遍带来改进，而 Environment-grounded Gate 可以。其 SRMA 机制仅在真实环境评估风险严格下降时接受 Candidate Memory，并为随机评估加入 Confidence Gating、为环境变化加入 Re-anchoring。

researchValue.failure: A reflection loop can appear improved from its own transcript while the external environment is unchanged or worse, because text alone cannot distinguish all relevant states.
researchValue.finding: The paper provides a formal impossibility result for transcript-only gates and a constructive alternative that conditions memory acceptance on external grounded risk.
researchValue.mechanism: Generate a candidate memory, evaluate it against environment-grounded metrics, accept only strict risk reduction, and use confidence/re-anchoring rules when evaluation is noisy or the environment shifts.
researchValue.implication: Agent self-improvement should not be authorized by the same narrative that proposed the change; an independent environment-linked evaluator is structurally necessary.

columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.reason: No Selection. SIG-20260918-002 and SIG-20260918-003 expose strong governance mechanisms around turn-scoped authority snapshots and immutable approval-to-invocation binding, but each currently rests primarily on one maintainer implementation and overlaps recent authority-at-action-time work from September 2 and September 12. SIG-20260918-005 provides strong primary evidence that low spontaneous harm can coexist with high conditional contagion once an unsafe trajectory crosses an unintended communication boundary, but promoting it today would create material semantic concentration with the September 17 Emergence World object on cross-agent propagation, containment and recovery of harmful state. All three remain valuable candidates; none is selected merely to fill the Digital Employee slot.

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.selectedTitle: Shared multi-agent coordination rules need pre-execution robustness guarantees under stochastic rewards
columns.selectedTitle_zh: 共享 Multi-Agent 协调规则在随机奖励环境中需要执行前 Robustness Guarantee
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260918-007 after Skill 02 triage. Social Laws supplies a bounded architecture question that remains meaningful without the paper name: a coordination rule that appears acceptable in deterministic demonstrations may still impose unacceptable outcomes when execution is stochastic and each agent optimizes its own reward. The primary study defines alpha-robustness as a minimum retained-utility guarantee under a shared social law and reduces verification to a series of Markov decision processes. The Industry Architecture question is therefore how admissible interaction constraints should be specified and verified before execution so coordination safety is not inferred from observed success alone. This is distinct from the September 14 CoCoBench object, which decomposed coordination competence into allocation, ordering, mutual exclusion and handoff for measurement, and from the September 11 UnitBoost object, which asked when deterministic operators can replace generative managers. Today's object studies ex-ante robustness guarantees for a shared coordination policy under stochastic outcomes.
columns.reason_zh: 经 Skill 02 筛选后选自 SIG-20260918-007。Social Laws 提供了一个去掉论文名称仍成立的有界架构问题：一条在确定性演示中看似可接受的协调规则，在执行具有随机性且每个 Agent 都优化自身 Reward 时，仍可能给个体造成不可接受的结果。该一手研究把 alpha-robustness 定义为共享 Social Law 下个体最低保留效用保证，并把验证约化为一系列 Markov Decision Process。因而 Industry Architecture 的问题是：执行前应如何描述并验证允许的 Interaction Constraint，使系统不再从观察到的成功直接推导协调安全。它与 9 月 14 日 CoCoBench 对象不同，后者把协调能力拆成 Allocation、Ordering、Mutual Exclusion 与 Handoff 分别测量；也不同于 9 月 11 日 UnitBoost 对象，后者研究何时可用确定性 Operator 替代生成式 Manager。今天单独研究随机结果下共享协调 Policy 的 Ex-ante Robustness Guarantee。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.selectedTitle: Long-running tool execution should expose bounded progress telemetry instead of forcing the runtime to guess
columns.selectedTitle_zh: 长时间 Tool Execution 应暴露有界进度遥测，而不是让 Runtime 猜测完成时间
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260918-006 as the strongest Open-source Engineering object. The study isolates a runtime observability problem: pre-call duration estimates are inherently stale at the moment a long-running tool is actually progressing, while the tool execution layer may already know remaining work or near-completion state. Its harness exposes bounded progress signals outside the agent-visible semantic context and reports roughly 20.7% and 20.8% reductions in p90 post-tool-call TTFT versus LRU in the reported HBM-only and HBM-plus-DRAM settings. The bounded engineering question is what machine-observable progress contract the execution layer should publish to scheduling and recovery logic, how much decision value it adds, and how to keep operational telemetry separate from business semantics. This is distinct from the September 16 Skill Routing object, which studied how to choose capabilities as catalogs grow, and from long-horizon completion research, which asks whether required business actions were actually completed; today's object studies runtime telemetry while a tool is still executing.
columns.reason_zh: 作为本日 Open-source Engineering 中最强的 Research Object，选自 SIG-20260918-006。该研究隔离出一个 Runtime Observability 问题：调用前的 Duration Estimate 在长时间 Tool 真正执行过程中天然会变旧，而 Tool Execution Layer 往往已经知道 Remaining Work 或 Near-completion State。其 Harness 在不改变 Agent-visible Semantic Context 的前提下暴露有界 Progress Signal，并在所报告的 HBM-only 与 HBM + DRAM 设置中，相对 LRU 将 Tool Call 后 p90 TTFT 分别降低约 20.7% 与 20.8%。因此有界工程问题是：Execution Layer 应向 Scheduling / Recovery Logic 发布怎样的 Machine-observable Progress Contract，这些信号能增加多少决策价值，以及怎样把 Operational Telemetry 与 Business Semantics 分开。它与 9 月 16 日 Skill Routing 对象不同，后者研究 Skill Catalog 扩大时如何选择能力；也不同于长周期 Completion 研究，后者研究业务要求是否真正完成。今天单独研究 Tool 仍在执行期间的 Runtime Telemetry。

signals.title: Gemini Antigravity 09-2026 turns an agent upgrade into an explicit built-in tool contract migration
signals.title_zh: Gemini Antigravity 09-2026 将 Agent 升级明确变成 Built-in Tool Contract 迁移
signals.summary: Google's Gemini API changelog says Antigravity Agent 09-2026 replaces the 05-2026 preview. Remote-sandbox consumers that only read model output can update the agent string, but local tool executors or function-call parsers must also adapt to changed built-in tool contracts, including PascalCase parameters and line-range file-edit replacements rather than full rewrites.
signals.summary_zh: Google 的 Gemini API Changelog 显示 Antigravity Agent 09-2026 替代 05-2026 Preview。只读取模型输出的 Remote Sandbox 消费方可以直接更新 Agent 字符串，但本地 Tool Executor 或 Function-call Parser 还必须适配 Built-in Tool Contract 变化，包括 PascalCase 参数，以及文件编辑从整文件重写转为行范围替换。

researchValue.failure: Treating an agent or model upgrade as a string-only configuration change can break local tool parsing and execution even when the intended capability is unchanged.
researchValue.finding: The official migration guidance separates output-only remote execution from local tool execution because the latter crosses a changed built-in tool contract.
researchValue.mechanism: Version the agent identity together with its tool-call ABI, validate adapters against the new parameter and edit semantics, and gate migration on execution-contract compatibility rather than model availability alone.
researchValue.implication: Agent runtimes should pin and verify tool contracts as part of host admission and upgrade, not assume model-version changes are behaviorally or structurally transparent.

signals.title: Codex snapshots MCP policy authority for the active turn instead of applying next-turn environment changes retroactively
signals.title_zh: Codex 对当前 Turn 的 MCP Policy Authority 做快照，不让下一 Turn 的环境变化追溯生效
signals.summary: Codex now captures one environment snapshot for MCP policy evaluation and runtime publication. Environment settings saved for the next turn cannot change tool availability while the current turn is suspended for user input; a regression test verifies that a tool remains visible when that turn resumes and disappears only on the next turn.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 现在为 MCP Policy Evaluation 与 Runtime Publication 捕获同一个 Environment Snapshot。为下一 Turn 保存的环境设置不能在当前 Turn 等待用户输入时改变其 Tool Availability；回归测试明确验证当前 Turn 恢复后工具仍可见，只在下一 Turn 才消失。

researchValue.failure: If environment-policy updates take effect inside an already admitted turn, the authority surface can change between suspension and resume without a new execution boundary.
researchValue.finding: Codex deliberately keeps the active turn on the captured policy environment and defers newly saved settings to the next turn.
researchValue.mechanism: Capture the policy-relevant environment at turn admission, use that same snapshot for policy evaluation and runtime publication, and apply configuration changes only at the next turn boundary.
researchValue.implication: Long-running workers need explicit authority epochs: configuration freshness and execution authority are different facts, and new policy should not rewrite the authority of work already admitted.

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK binds conditional approval to the exact validated tool invocation and fails closed on argument drift
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 将条件审批绑定到精确的已校验 Tool Invocation，并在参数漂移时 Fail Closed
signals.summary: The Agents SDK now prepares conditional approvals per invocation using only data-only validation paths that do not execute application validators or plugins, then binds the approval evaluation to the exact tool object, invoker and raw argument string. Invocation drift after approval evaluation raises a user error instead of executing under a stale decision.
signals.summary_zh: Agents SDK 现在按 Invocation 准备条件审批，只允许不会执行应用 Validator 或 Plugin 的 Data-only 校验路径；随后把审批结果绑定到精确的 Tool Object、Invoker 与原始 Argument String。审批评估之后若 Invocation 发生漂移，会抛出错误而不是拿旧决定继续执行。

researchValue.failure: Approval can become unsound if the arguments inspected for the decision differ from what is actually executed, or if argument inspection itself runs user code before approval.
researchValue.finding: The SDK separates conservative argument preparation from execution and verifies the exact invocation identity again before using the approval result.
researchValue.mechanism: Use side-effect-free data validation when possible, require approval for uninspectable/custom paths, bind the decision to tool plus invoker plus raw arguments, and reject any mismatch before execution.
researchValue.implication: Human or policy approval should authorize an immutable call instance, not merely a tool name or a loosely parsed request.

signals.title: Google ADK introduces bounded skill lifecycles so long sessions can retire unused tool declarations
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 引入 Bounded Skill 生命周期，让长会话可以退出不再使用的 Tool Declaration
signals.summary: ADK adds persistent and bounded skill lifecycle modes plus max_active_skills. Bounded skills are evicted least-recently-loaded after the cap is exceeded, while persistent skills keep the previous behavior and do not count against the cap. load_skill reports unloaded_skills so the model is explicitly told which tools are leaving its active surface.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 增加 Persistent 与 Bounded 两类 Skill 生命周期以及 max_active_skills。超过上限后，Bounded Skill 按最久未加载顺序退出；Persistent Skill 保持旧行为且不计入上限。load_skill 会返回 unloaded_skills，显式告诉模型哪些工具已经离开当前能力面。

researchValue.failure: A long session that keeps every historically loaded skill active accumulates unused tool declarations, expanding context and authority surfaces indefinitely.
researchValue.finding: ADK makes skill persistence an explicit lifecycle policy and provides an opt-in bounded working set without changing the persistent default.
researchValue.mechanism: Classify skills as persistent or bounded, cap the bounded active set, evict least-recently-loaded skills, and surface unload events to the model.
researchValue.implication: Digital employees need capability lifecycle management as well as memory lifecycle management; tools that are no longer active should leave the declared authority surface explicitly.

signals.title: Collective Loss of Control separates rare local deviations from high conditional contagion risk in multi-agent systems
signals.title_zh: Collective Loss of Control 将罕见局部偏差与多 Agent 的高条件传播风险区分开来
signals.summary: The paper models collective loss of control as mutation, contagion and recovery. Its deployment audit finds implicit communication paths between nominally independent evaluation runs, while RogueHandoff-20 reports 0-5% executed harm on normal tasks versus 40-95% after unsafe-trajectory injection. The authors explicitly state that this demonstrates conditional susceptibility, not natural cascade frequency.
signals.summary_zh: 论文把 Collective Loss of Control 建模为 Mutation、Contagion 与 Recovery。部署审计发现名义上独立的评测运行之间存在隐式通信路径；RogueHandoff-20 中正常任务的实际伤害为 0-5%，注入不安全轨迹后升至 40-95%。作者明确限定：这证明的是条件易感性，不是自然级联发生率。

researchValue.failure: A low observed rate of spontaneous agent failure can hide a system that is highly susceptible once one unsafe trajectory crosses an unintended communication boundary.
researchValue.finding: Injected unsafe trajectories sharply increased executed harm in the benchmark, and the deployment audit verified a transport path across nominally independent runs.
researchValue.mechanism: Unsafe behavior propagates when communication permits other agents to adopt and retransmit a local deviation faster than containment and recovery correct it.
researchValue.implication: Multi-agent governance must audit transport and shared-state boundaries, not only individual-agent behavior; isolation and recovery capacity are first-class controls against collective failure.

signals.title: Ask the Tool, Don't Guess shows that running tools can expose progress that serving systems should consume directly
signals.title_zh: Ask the Tool, Don't Guess 证明运行中的 Tool 可以直接暴露进度，Serving System 不应靠猜
signals.summary: The study argues that pre-call duration estimates cannot reliably know tool completion time while the running tool often already has usable progress information. A harness exposes remaining-work or near-completion signals without changing agent-visible context; plugged into a production engine, the signal cuts p90 post-tool-call TTFT by about 20.7% with HBM-only and 20.8% with HBM plus DRAM versus LRU.
signals.summary_zh: 研究指出，调用前固定的时长估计无法可靠知道 Tool 何时结束，而正在运行的 Tool 往往已经拥有可读的进度信息。实验 Harness 在不改变 Agent 可见上下文的前提下暴露剩余工作量或临近完成信号；接入 Production Engine 后，相对 LRU 将 Tool Call 后 p90 TTFT 分别降低约 20.7%（仅 HBM）和 20.8%（HBM + DRAM）。

researchValue.failure: Treating a running tool as an opaque wait forces the runtime to guess duration from names or historical averages, causing poor resource and scheduling decisions when the environment changes.
researchValue.finding: Live tool progress is materially more accurate at decision points than pre-call predictors and improves serving latency without changing the agent's task behavior.
researchValue.mechanism: Expose bounded progress signals from the tool execution layer to the serving/runtime layer while keeping them out of the agent's semantic context unless needed.
researchValue.implication: A digital-employee runtime should distinguish business semantics from operational telemetry: workers can remain semantically isolated while still publishing machine-observable progress for scheduling and recovery.

signals.title: Social Laws extends verifiable multi-agent coordination constraints to stochastic reward-based environments
signals.title_zh: Social Laws 将可验证的多 Agent 协调约束扩展到随机、基于奖励的环境
signals.summary: The paper extends social-law coordination from deterministic goal settings to stochastic reward-based environments. It defines alpha-robustness as the guaranteed utility an agent retains while following its optimal single-agent policy under a shared social law, then verifies robustness by reducing the check to a series of Markov decision processes.
signals.summary_zh: 论文把 Social Law 协调从确定性 Goal Setting 扩展到随机、基于 Reward 的环境。它将 alpha-robustness 定义为所有 Agent 遵守共同 Social Law 时，单个 Agent 在执行自身最优策略时仍能保证保留的效用，并把 Robustness Verification 约化为一系列 Markov Decision Process 求解。

researchValue.failure: Coordination rules that work in deterministic demonstrations may not guarantee acceptable individual outcomes when execution is stochastic and agents optimize their own rewards.
researchValue.finding: The work gives a formal robustness quantity and a verification procedure for shared constraints in stochastic multi-agent environments.
researchValue.mechanism: Specify a social law as an admissible coordination constraint, define a minimum retained-utility guarantee, and verify it through MDP reductions before relying on the policy in execution.
researchValue.implication: Agent governance can be framed as pre-execution verification of admissible interaction constraints rather than letting a scheduler or model infer acceptable coordination from observed behavior alone.
